ops.value: 蕴含元件有方向。把两个方向用「或者」接在一起，会出现哪几行为假？
把「下雨」和「地面湿」按相反的顺序接入两个蕴含元件。
对调条件与结果，只有在「地面湿、没下雨」这一行，新句子为假。蕴含元件的两个输入有顺序。
先看「如果」后面是哪件事，把它接到蕴含元件的第一个输入。
「地面湿」直接接到或者元件，只有「下雨」需要先过否定元件。
「或者」只需要至少一边为真。下雨又刮风时，或者元件也输出真。
「下雨或者地面湿」只在没下雨、地面也不湿时为假。先用手头的门接出同样的真值，再把电路封装成「或者」元件。
最后一个否定元件接在并且元件的输出上，再把否定元件的输出接到「这句话」。

value.zh: 把两个相反方向的若则用或者元件接在一起。无论 a 和 b 取什么值，输出都是真。
value.en: The two directions of If–then joined by Or. The output is true for every pair of inputs.
The two directions of If–then joined by Or. The output is true for every pair of inputs.
value.zh: 把两个相反方向的若则用或门接在一起。无论 a 和 b 取什么值，输出都是真。

value.en: Feed the And output into the last Not gate, then wire its output to “The sentence”.
value.zh: 最后一个非门接在与门的输出上，再把非门的输出接到「这句话」。

value.en: “It rains or it’s wet” is false only when there’s no rain and the ground is dry. Build that behavior with the gates you have, then pack the circuit into an Or gate.
value.zh: 「下雨或者地面湿」只在没下雨、地面也不湿时为假。先用手头的门接出同样的真值，再把电路封装成「或」门。

value.en: Or needs at least one true input. The gate still outputs true when it’s both raining and windy.
value.zh: 「或者」只需要至少一边为真。下雨又刮风时，或门也输出真。

value.en: Wire “it’s wet” straight into Or. Only “it rains” goes through Not first.
value.zh: 「地面湿」直接接到或门，只有「下雨」需要先过非门。

value.en: Wire the condition that follows “if” into the first input of the If–then gate.
value.zh: 先看「如果」后面是哪件事，把它接到若则门的第一个输入。

value.en: With the condition and result swapped, the new claim is false only when it’s wet and it didn’t rain. Input order matters for an If–then gate.
value.zh: 对调条件与结果，只有在「地面湿、没下雨」这一行，新句子为假。若则门的两个输入有顺序。

value.en: Wire “it rains” and “it’s wet” into the two If–then gates in opposite orders.
value.zh: 把「下雨」和「地面湿」按相反的顺序接入两个若则门。

value.en: An If–then gate has a direction. If you join the two directions with Or, which rows can come out false?
value.zh: 若则门有方向。把两个方向用「或者」接在一起，会出现哪几行为假？

value.en: Which part does the negation cover?
Wire a board that works out the value of “it is not the case that it both rains and is windy” on every row.
value.zh: 接一块电路，算出「不是『又下雨又刮风』」在每一行的真值。

value.en: The layered structure of a sentence is its syntax tree.
value.zh: 一句话一层层的结构，叫它的语法树。

value.en: “It is not raining and it’s windy” and “it is not the case that it both rains and is windy” sound alike but mean different things: the negation covers a different stretch. In symbols, brackets mark that stretch.
value.zh: 「不下雨，并且刮风」和「不是『又下雨又刮风』」听着相近，意思不同：否定管的范围不一样。写成符号时，范围用括号标出。

t.en: The new part , written \mark{and}, outputs true only when both inputs are true.
t.zh: 新元件，符号 \mark{and}：两个输入都为真，才输出真。

value.en: Two things must hold at once: “it rains” and “it is not windy”.
value.zh: 两件事要同时成立：「下雨」和「不刮风」。

value.en: Wire a board that works out the value of “it rains and it is not windy” on every row.
value.zh: 接一块电路，算出「下雨，并且不刮风」在每一行的真值。

value.en: The two directions of Implies joined by Or. The output is true for every pair of inputs.
The two directions of If–then joined by Or. The output is true for every pair of inputs.
value.zh: 把两个相反方向的若则用或者元件接在一起。无论 a 和 b 取什么值，输出都是真。

value.zh: 先看「如果」后面是哪件事，把它接到蕴含元件的第一个输入。

value.en: With the condition and result swapped, the new claim is false only when it’s wet and it didn’t rain. Input order matters for an If–then gate.
value.zh: 对调条件与结果，只有在「地面湿、没下雨」这一行，新句子为假。蕴含元件的两个输入有顺序。

value.en: Wire “it rains” and “it’s wet” into the two If–then gates in opposite orders.
value.zh: 把「下雨」和「地面湿」按相反的顺序接入两个蕴含元件。

value.zh: 蕴含元件有方向。把两个方向用「或者」接在一起，会出现哪几行为假？

why: Name both tasks in the scope lesson
Build always true and false gates in two tasks

desc.zh: 否定永真元件的输出。无论输入取什么值，输出都是假。
desc.en: Negates the output of Always True. The output is false for every pair of inputs.

value.zh: 第一句话在每一行都为真，是<wiki-ref to="tautology"></wiki-ref>；它的否定在每一行都为假，是<wiki-ref to="contradiction"></wiki-ref>。它们的真值分别与 \mark{top} 和 \mark{bottom} 一致。两块电路已封装成「永真」和「矛盾」元件。
value.en: The first sentence is true on every row: it is a <wiki-ref to="tautology"></wiki-ref>. Its negation is false on every row: it is a <wiki-ref to="contradiction"></wiki-ref>. Their truth values match \mark{top} and \mark{bottom}, respectively. Both circuits are now available as Always True and Contradiction parts.

t.zh: 刚才的说法在每一行都成立。现在看看，如果说它不成立，真值表会怎样。
t.en: The previous statement holds on every row. What happens if we say it does not hold?

brief.zh: 接一块电路，判断上一段的说法不成立时的真值。运行后看看每一行的结果。
brief.en: Wire a circuit to evaluate the claim that the previous statement does not hold. Run it and inspect every row.

hint.zh: 上一段封装的「永真」元件给出原来说法的真值。怎样表示它不成立？
hint.en: The Always True part you just built gives the original statement’s value. How can you say it does not hold?

value.zh: 之前用「或者」要求两个方向至少有一个成立。现在看看，换成「并且」要求两个方向都成立时，输出会怎样。
value.en: Earlier, Or required at least one direction to hold. Now use And to require both directions and see what happens to the output.
Or required at least one direction to hold. This time, use And to require both directions and see what happens to the output.
value.zh: 刚才用「或者」要求两个方向至少有一个成立。现在看看，换成「并且」要求两个方向都成立时，输出会怎样。

value.en: At least one conditional is true in every case, so the output column is all true. A sentence like this is a <wiki-ref to="tautology"></wiki-ref>. Your circuit is now available as an Always True gate.
value.zh: 两条条件句至少有一条为真，所以输出列全是真。这种句子叫<wiki-ref to="tautology"></wiki-ref>。你搭的电路现在可以作为「永真」门使用。

desc.en: Build circuits that evaluate the truth of a proposition.
desc.zh: 用逻辑门搭建判断命题真假的电路。

why: Recall the original truth table before introducing implication

value.zh: 还记得<level-ref to="table"></level-ref>里的天气预报吗？「如果下雨，地面就会湿」只在下了雨、地面却不湿时为假。没下雨，或者地面是湿的，这条条件句就为真。
value.en: Remember the forecast in <level-ref to="table"></level-ref>? “If it rains, it’s wet” is false only when it rains and the ground stays dry. The conditional is true whenever it doesn’t rain or it’s wet.
“If it rains, it’s wet” is false only when it rains and the ground stays dry. The conditional is true whenever it doesn’t rain or it’s wet.
value.zh: 「如果下雨，地面就会湿」只在下了雨、地面却不湿时为假。没下雨，或者地面是湿的，这条条件句就为真。

ops.value: Eq. substitution leaves the rest of the proved sentence in place. Next, you will use the same rule to rewrite a goal on the machine board.
Use Eq. substitution to replace \(A\) in \(\neg A\) with \(B\) and prove \(\neg B\).
A rule can apply even when the resulting goal cannot be proved. Join candidates preserves the other route, so Backtracking can return to it if the first route fails.

Use Join candidates to send both routes to Backtracking. Try ① first. If it reaches a dead end, return to the fork and try ②. Switch the run report to the branch tree to see which path finishes the proof.
Wire Input and Expected to the outside of the box. Inside, wire Each step to both backward cards, then connect Assume to ① and Cite a given to ②. Wire the join to the box’s inner result port.
A card marked \mark{backward} takes a proof state directly. \mark{backward} Assume adds the condition of an implication to the givens. \mark{backward} Cite a given closes a goal that matches a given.
Start with \mark{backward} Assume, then finish with \mark{backward} Cite a given.

In <level-ref to="au-refute"></level-ref> you chose which pair to cancel at each step. A proof assistant does not choose: the new card “Resolution round” cancels every pair that can be cancelled, once, adding each new clause along with the two it came from. When clauses have variables, a pair of literals is unified first, then cancelled: “\(\lnot x\; \text{is human}\lor x\; \text{is mortal}\)” and “Socrates is human”, with x unified to Socrates.

value.en: In <level-ref to="au-refute"></level-ref> you chose which pair to cancel at each step. A proof assistant does not choose: the new card “a round of resolution” cancels every pair that can be cancelled, once, adding each new clause along with the two it came from. When clauses have variables, a pair of literals is unified first, then cancelled: “\(\lnot x\; \text{is human}\lor x\; \text{is mortal}\)” and “Socrates is human”, with x unified to Socrates.
value.zh: 在<level-ref to="au-refute"></level-ref>里，每一步消哪一对由你挑。证明器不挑：新元件「一轮归结」把能消的每一对都消一次，新子句加进来，并记下它由哪两条得出。子句里有变量时，一对文字先合一再消：「\(\lnot \text{x是人}\lor \text{x会死}\)」和「苏格拉底是人」，x 合一为苏格拉底。

value.en: Start with \mark{backward} Assumption box, then finish with \mark{backward} Cite a given.
value.zh: 先用 \mark{backward} 假设框拆开目标，再用 \mark{backward} 引用已知证完。

value.en: A card marked \mark{backward} takes a proof state directly. \mark{backward} Assumption box adds the condition of an implication to the givens. \mark{backward} Cite a given closes a goal that matches a given.
value.zh: 名字带 \mark{backward} 的元件可以直接接一个证明状态。\mark{backward} 假设框把「若…则…」的条件加入已知，\mark{backward} 引用已知可以证完与已知相符的目标。

value.en: Wire Input and Expected to the outside of the box. Inside, wire Each step to both backward cards, then connect Assumption box to ① and Cite a given to ②. Wire the join to the box’s inner result port.
value.zh: 把「输入」和「预期」接到框外。框里的「每一步」同时接给两张逆用卡，假设框接 ①，引用已知接 ②，再把汇合候选的输出接回框内的结果口。

value.en: Use Join candidates to send both routes to Backtracking search. Try ① first. If it reaches a dead end, return to the fork and try ②. Switch the run report to the branch tree to see which path finishes the proof.
value.zh: 用「汇合候选」把两条路线交给「回溯搜索」。先走 ①。走不下去时，回到分岔处再试 ②。切换到运行报告的分支树，可以看出哪条路证完了。

value.en: A rule can apply even when the resulting goal cannot be proved. Join candidates preserves the other route, so Backtracking search can return to it if the first route fails.
value.zh: 能用一条规则展开目标，只说明这条路可以先走一步。汇合候选保留了另一条路，回溯搜索才能在第一条路走不通时返回去试。

value.en: Use Equivalent substitution to replace \(A\) in \(\neg A\) with \(B\) and prove \(\neg B\).
value.zh: 用「等价代换」把 \(\neg A\) 中的 \(A\) 换成 \(B\)，证出 \(\neg B\)。

value.en: Equivalent substitution leaves the rest of the proved sentence in place. Next, you will use the same rule to rewrite a goal on the machine board.
value.zh: 等价代换保留已证句子的其余部分。接下来，你会用同一条规则直接改写机器板上的待证目标。

t.en: On the machine board, Input shows each case’s givens and goal. Expected shows the state you need to reach. The same circuit handles every case.

t.en: If the goal appears among the givens, Cite a given can close it immediately.

t.zh: 把证明板上的代换规则用到机器板上。改写卡从已知中找一条用得上的等价式，如 \(A \leftrightarrow B\)，把目标里的一处 \(A\) 换成 \(B\)。
t.en: Use the substitution rule from the proof board on the machine board. The rewrite card finds an applicable equivalence, such as \(A \leftrightarrow B\), among the givens and replaces one occurrence of \(A\) in the goal with \(B\).
On the machine board, Input shows each case’s givens and goal. Expected shows the state you need to reach. The same circuit handles every case.
t.zh: 机器板的「输入」给出每个案例的已知和待证目标，「预期」显示这次要得到的状态。同一块电路会处理每个案例。

t.en: Use the substitution rule from the proof board on the machine board. The rewrite card finds an applicable equivalence, such as \(A \leftrightarrow B\), among the givens and replaces one occurrence of \(A\) in the goal with \(B\).
t.zh: 把证明板上的代换规则用到机器板上。改写卡从已知中找一条用得上的等价式，如 \(A \leftrightarrow B\)，把目标里的一处 \(A\) 换成 \(B\)。

t.zh: 如果待证目标已经在已知里，就可以用「照抄」直接证完它。

why: Explain backward proof search and remove internal board terms

t.zh: 之前，你从已知出发，连接规则，一步步推到要证明的结论。现在，你要设计一个证明器，让它从待证目标出发，倒着寻找能证明它的规则。
t.en: Earlier, you connected rules from the givens until you reached the conclusion. Now you will design a proof assistant that starts with a goal and works backwards to find rules that can prove it.

t.zh: 最简单的情况是：目标已经在已知里。这时「照抄」就能直接证完它。
t.en: The simplest case is a goal already among the givens. Cite a given can prove it immediately.

t.zh: 「输入」给出每个案例的已知和待证目标，「预期」显示要达到的结果。接好电路后，同一个证明器会处理每个案例。
t.en: Input gives the givens and goal for each case; Expected shows the required result. Once wired, the same proof assistant handles every case.

value.zh: 证明器从目标出发，只要找到完全相同的已知，就能确定这一目标已证完。按目标匹配规则，机器可以逐步寻找要证的内容，并对不同案例重复同一套步骤，更适合自动化；遇到复杂目标时，还需要更多规则。
value.en: The proof assistant starts from the goal and closes it when it finds an identical given. Matching rules to goals lets a machine work through what remains to be proved and repeat the same steps across cases, making automation easier. More complex goals still need more rules.

value.zh: 之前用代换规则改写已证的句子；现在用同一条规则改写待证目标。改写卡从已知中找一条用得上的等价式，如 \(A \leftrightarrow B\)，把目标里的一处 \(A\) 换成 \(B\)。
value.en: Earlier, you used substitution to rewrite a proved sentence. Now use the same rule on a goal. The rewrite card finds an applicable equivalence, such as \(A \leftrightarrow B\), among the givens and replaces one occurrence of \(A\) in the goal with \(B\).

value.zh: 用来证明的规则也一一对上：套用是函数应用，假设框是 λ，拼起来和拆开是造一对和取分量，分情况是按标签分支。所以检查证明就是检查类型。
value.en: The rules used in a proof match one for one: Apply is function application, the assumption box is λ, joining and splitting are making a pair and taking a component, and cases is branching on the tag. So checking a proof is checking a type.

value.zh: 推理规则说明怎样从前提推导结论。例如，套用由 \(A\to B\) 和 A 推出 B。规则的字母表示命题模式，可以按规则允许的方式一致替换。证明时使用的规则元件以输入端表示前提、输出端表示结论。
value.en: An inference rule specifies how conclusions follow from premises. For example, Apply derives B from \(A\to B\) and A. Letters represent proposition schemata and can be consistently instantiated as the rule permits. In a proof, a rule part’s inputs represent premises and its output represents the conclusion.

value.zh: <level-ref to="decl-and"></level-ref>声明了「并且」，证明时随之多了两块元件：<part-ref to="part:andI"></part-ref>是它唯一的引入规则；<part-ref to="part:andE"></part-ref>是由它生成的消去规则，两个输出口分别给出左边和右边。每个连接词都有一组引入规则和一组消去规则，这样组织的规则体系叫<wiki-ref to="natural"></wiki-ref>。
value.en: <level-ref to="decl-and"></level-ref> declared “and”, and two parts became available for proofs: <part-ref to="part:andI"></part-ref>, its one introduction rule, and <part-ref to="part:andE"></part-ref>, the elimination rule made from it, whose two outputs give the left and the right. Every connective has its introduction and elimination rules; a system of rules organised this way is called <wiki-ref to="natural"></wiki-ref>.

value.zh: 按照证明器的证书，重新搭建证明。
value.en: Rebuild the proof from the proof assistant’s certificate.

value.zh: 等价代换保留已证句子的其余部分。接下来，你会用同一条规则直接改写待证目标。
value.en: Eq. substitution leaves the rest of the proved sentence in place. Next, you will use the same rule to rewrite a goal.

value.zh: <level-ref to="m-counter"></level-ref>里，一个世界就说明了推不出。要说一句话在所有世界里都成立，世界却检查不完：只能用规则来证明。
value.en: In <level-ref to="m-counter"></level-ref>, one world showed that something does not follow. To show a sentence holds in every world, the worlds cannot all be checked: use rules to prove it instead.

value.zh: <level-ref to="dist"></level-ref>里，证明这句话时用了好几个框。这一次，从目标往回推。
value.en: In <level-ref to="dist"></level-ref> proving this sentence took several boxes. This time, reason back from the goal.

value.zh: 之前，你从已知出发连接规则。证明器反过来，从目标往回走，这叫<wiki-ref to="backward"></wiki-ref>。新元件<part-ref to="part:rule"></part-ref>：从「R」口接入一条规则，它把第一个目标对上规则的结论，再把这个目标换成规则的前提，每条前提一个新目标。之前用来证明的每个元件，在这里都对应一个给出相应规则的元件；几个规则元件可以串起来接入。
value.en: Earlier, you connected rules starting from the givens. A proof assistant works the other way, from the goal back: <wiki-ref to="backward"></wiki-ref>. A new part, <part-ref to="part:rule"></part-ref>: wire a rule into its port “R”; it fits the first goal to the rule’s conclusion and replaces that goal with the rule’s premises, one new goal for each. Each part used in a proof has a corresponding part here that supplies its rule, and several rule parts can be chained into one list.

value.zh: 「\(\text{刮风}\land \lnot \lnot \text{下雨}\)」里的 \mark{not}\mark{not}下雨 换成下雨，从已证的句子中替换时，要先拆开外面的「并且」，换掉里面那一句，再拼回去。
value.en: To turn the \mark{not}\mark{not}it rains in “it’s windy \mark{and} \mark{not}\mark{not}it rains” into it rains, rewriting a proved sentence requires taking the outer “and” apart, replacing the part inside, and putting it back together.

To turn the \mark{not}\mark{not}it rains in “it’s windy \mark{and} \mark{not}\mark{not}it rains” into it rains, the proof board must take the outer “and” apart, replace the part inside, and put it back together.
value.zh: 「\(\text{刮风}\land \lnot \lnot \text{下雨}\)」里的 \mark{not}\mark{not}下雨 换成下雨，在证明板上要先拆开外面的「并且」，换掉里面那一句，再拼回去。

value.en: On the proof board a proof is wired downwards from the givens. A proof assistant works the other way, from the goal back: <wiki-ref to="backward"></wiki-ref>. A new part, <part-ref to="part:rule"></part-ref>: wire a rule into its port “R”; it fits the first goal to the rule’s conclusion and replaces that goal with the rule’s premises, one new goal for each. Every proof-board part is, on this board, a part that gives its rule, and several rule parts can be chained into one list.

value.zh: <level-ref to="dist"></level-ref>里，这句话在证明板上用了好几个框。这一次，从目标往回推。

value.en: In <level-ref to="m-counter"></level-ref>, one world showed that something does not follow. To show a sentence holds in every world, the worlds cannot all be checked: it is back to the proof board and its rules.
value.zh: <level-ref to="m-counter"></level-ref>里，一个世界就说明了推不出。要说一句话在所有世界里都成立，世界却检查不完：只能回到证明板上，靠规则。

value.en: Eq. substitution leaves the rest of the proved sentence in place. Next, you will use the same rule to rewrite a goal on the machine board.
value.zh: 等价代换保留已证句子的其余部分。接下来，你会用同一条规则直接改写机器板上的待证目标。

value.en: Replay the proof assistant’s certificate on the proof board.
value.zh: 按照证明器的证书，在证明板上重放。

value.en: <level-ref to="decl-and"></level-ref> declared “and”, and the proof board gained two parts: <part-ref to="part:andI"></part-ref>, its one introduction rule, and <part-ref to="part:andE"></part-ref>, the elimination rule made from it, whose two outputs give the left and the right. Every connective has its introduction and elimination rules; a system of rules organised this way is called <wiki-ref to="natural"></wiki-ref>.
value.zh: <level-ref to="decl-and"></level-ref>声明了「并且」，证明板上随之多了两块元件：<part-ref to="part:andI"></part-ref>是它唯一的引入规则；<part-ref to="part:andE"></part-ref>是由它生成的消去规则，两个输出口分别给出左边和右边。每个连接词都有一组引入规则和一组消去规则，这样组织的规则体系叫<wiki-ref to="natural"></wiki-ref>。

value.en: An inference rule specifies how conclusions follow from premises. For example, Apply derives B from \(A\to B\) and A. Letters represent proposition schemata and can be consistently instantiated as the rule permits. On the proof board, inputs represent premises and the output represents the conclusion.
value.zh: 推理规则说明怎样从前提推导结论。例如，套用由 \(A\to B\) 和 A 推出 B。规则的字母表示命题模式，可以按规则允许的方式一致替换。证明板上的规则元件以输入端表示前提、输出端表示结论。

value.en: The proof board’s rules match one for one: Apply is function application, the assumption box is λ, joining and splitting are making a pair and taking a component, and cases is branching on the tag. So checking a proof is checking a type.
value.zh: 证明板上的规则也一一对上：套用是函数应用，假设框是 λ，拼起来和拆开是造一对和取分量，分情况是按标签分支。所以检查证明就是检查类型。

value.en: Use the substitution rule from the proof board on the machine board. The rewrite card finds an applicable equivalence, such as \(A \leftrightarrow B\), among the givens and replaces one occurrence of \(A\) in the goal with \(B\).
value.zh: 把证明板上的代换规则用到机器板上。改写卡从已知中找一条用得上的等价式，如 \(A \leftrightarrow B\)，把目标里的一处 \(A\) 换成 \(B\)。

value.en: Once a given matches, the goal disappears from the list of remaining goals.
value.zh: 匹配成功后，这个目标就从待证列表里消失了。

t.en: On the machine board, Input shows each case’s givens and goal. Expected shows the state you need to reach. The same circuit handles every case.
t.zh: 机器板的「输入」给出每个案例的已知和待证目标，「预期」显示这次要得到的状态。同一块电路会处理每个案例。

t.en: If the goal appears among the givens, Cite a given can close it immediately.
t.zh: 如果待证目标已经在已知里，就可以用「照抄」直接证完它。

value.en: Goal gives the givens and goal for each case; Expected shows the required result. Once wired, the same proof assistant handles every case.

value.zh: 把逆用假设框接在「目标」和「预期」之间。运行后，看看 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 分别去了哪里。
value.en: Wire the backward assumption box between Goal and Expected, then run the board and see where \(A\) and \(B\) ended up.

value.zh: 从「目标」的输出口连到改写卡的输入口，再把卡片的输出接到「预期」。
value.en: Connect the output of Goal to the card’s input, then connect the card’s output to Expected.

value.zh: 把「目标」和「预期」接到框外。框里的「每一步」同时接给两张逆用卡，假设框接 ①，照抄接 ②，再把汇合候选的输出接回框内的结果口。
value.en: Wire Goal and Expected to the outside of the box. Inside, wire Each step to both backward cards, then connect Assume to ① and Cite a given to ②. Wire the join to the box’s inner result port.

value.en: Connect the output of Input to the card’s input, then connect the card’s output to Expected.

t.zh: 已知里给出了「并且」的交换律。它可以换掉整个合取式，即使合取式只是长句的一部分。
t.en: The givens include conjunction commutativity. It swaps the two sides of a conjunction even when that conjunction is part of a longer sentence.

after.zh: 换掉的是一整个合取式。它在条件或结论中的位置不影响这条等价式的用法。
after.en: The rewrite replaces the whole conjunction. The same equivalence works in a condition or a conclusion.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，把每个目标改成「预期」里的形式。
brief.en: Build a proof assistant that rewrites each goal into the form under Expected.

hint.zh: 在改写卡上找包含两项的「并且」，检查替换后的句子。
hint.en: Find the conjunction with both conjuncts on the rewrite card and check the result.

t.zh: 已知给出了「并且」对「或者」的分配律。展开后，两种选择都要满足原来的共同条件。
t.en: The givens include the law for distributing conjunction over disjunction. After expansion, each alternative includes the original shared condition.

after.zh: 分配律把共同条件复制到两个选项中。改写只换与等价式左边匹配的那一段。
after.en: Distribution puts the shared condition into both alternatives. The rewrite replaces the subformula that matches the left side of the equivalence.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，把每个目标改成「预期」里的形式。
brief.en: Build a proof assistant that rewrites each goal into the form under Expected.

hint.zh: 先找「预期」中重复的条件，再在原句中找包含整个「或者」的那一段。
hint.en: Find the condition that appears twice under Expected. Then find the part of the original sentence containing the entire disjunction.

becomes: (Exam ∧ (Coffee ∨ Tea)) ↔ ((Exam ∧ Coffee) ∨ (Exam ∧ Tea)) ⊢ Slip → ((Exam ∧ Coffee) ∨ (Exam ∧ Tea))

t.zh: 德摩根律把「并非（A 或者 B）」写成「并非 A 并且并非 B」。这里同一个否定式出现了两次，预期只展开其中一次。
t.en: De Morgan’s law expresses the negation of a disjunction as a conjunction of negations. Here the same negation occurs twice, and only one occurrence should expand.

after.zh: 点选的是等价式的第二处匹配。即使两个案例的联结词不同，证明器也会在各自的目标中改写第二处。
after.en: You selected the second match. The assistant rewrites that occurrence in each goal, even when the cases use different connectives.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，把每个目标改成「预期」里的形式。
brief.en: Build a proof assistant that rewrites each goal into the form under Expected.

hint.zh: 对照「预期」，在改写卡的目标公式中点选第二处匹配。
hint.en: Compare with Expected and select the second match in the rewrite card’s goal formula.

t.zh: 要证明「下雨并且刮风」，两个部分都得成立。把「拼接」倒过来用，看看证明器会留下几个目标。
t.en: To prove that it rains and it is windy, you need both claims. Use Join backwards and see how many goals the assistant leaves.

after.zh: 逆用「拼接」会按合取式的顺序生成两个目标。每次「照抄」证完一个与已知相同的目标。
after.en: Using Join backwards creates two goals in the order the conjuncts appear. Each Cite a given closes one goal that matches a given.

brief.zh: 逆用「拼接」，再证完留下的两个目标。
brief.en: Use Join backwards, then prove both remaining goals.

hint.zh: 把两张「照抄」依次接到逆用「拼接」之后。可以用步进观察每次少了哪个目标。
hint.en: After backward Join, connect two Cite a given cards in sequence. Step through the run to see which goal closes each time.

t.zh: 证明「坐公交或者骑车」时，证成其中一项就够了。逆用「补充」要先决定留下哪一项。
t.en: To prove that you take the bus or ride a bike, one alternative is enough. When you use Add alternative backwards, choose which claim remains.

after.zh: 逆用「补充」只留下选定的那一项。应根据已知选择规则，留下可以证出的目标。
after.en: Using Add alternative backwards leaves just the chosen disjunct. Look at the givens to choose a rule that leaves a goal you can prove.

brief.zh: 选「补充」中保留左项的规则，再证完目标。
brief.en: Choose the Add alternative rule that leaves the left disjunct, then close the goal.

hint.zh: 已知包含「或者」的左项。选结论为 A ∨ B、前提为 A 的规则。
hint.en: The left disjunct is given. Choose the rule with conclusion A ∨ B and premise A.

brief.zh: 这一次，选保留右项的规则，再证完目标。
brief.en: This time choose the rule that leaves the right disjunct, then close the goal.

hint.zh: 选结论为 A ∨ B、前提为 B 的规则，再用「照抄」。
hint.en: Choose the rule with conclusion A ∨ B and premise B, then cite the given.

t.zh: 如果已知里有矛盾 ⊥，「爆炸」能推出任意结论。现在把它逆用，观察不同的目标会变成什么。
t.en: If contradiction ⊥ is given, Explosion derives any conclusion. Apply it backwards and see what different goals turn into.

after.zh: 逆用「爆炸」把原目标换成 ⊥。只有当矛盾能证出时，这条路线才完成证明。
after.en: Using Explosion backwards replaces the original goal with ⊥. The proof succeeds when you can prove that contradiction.

brief.zh: 逆用「爆炸」，再根据已知证完剩下的目标。
brief.en: Use Explosion backwards, then use the givens to close the remaining goal.

hint.zh: 「爆炸」的前提是 ⊥。逆用之后，用「照抄」关闭这个目标。
hint.en: Explosion has premise ⊥. After applying it backwards, cite the given to close that goal.

value.zh: 在「并且」一关，你用「拆解」和「拼接」交换了两项。现在用那条证明得到的「合取交换律」改写长句中的一段。
value.en: In the conjunction lesson, you used Split and Join to swap the conjuncts. Now use the commutativity card from that proof to rewrite part of a longer sentence.

value.zh: 「合取交换律」能匹配任意两项组成的合取式。它可以直接改写条件或结论中的一段。
value.en: Conjunction commutativity matches a conjunction of any two claims. It can rewrite a subformula in either a condition or a conclusion.

value.zh: 把「改写·合取交换律」接到目标，检查哪一段「并且」可以交换。
value.en: Connect the conjunction commutativity rewrite card to the goal and inspect the conjunction it can swap.

value.zh: 在第 3 章的「条件」里，你证明了「同时满足 A 和 B 就有 C」可写成两层条件，也可以合回去。用「合取条件」卡把目标中的一个合取条件拆成两层。
value.en: In the Conditions lesson, you proved that a single conjunctive condition can be split into two nested conditions and combined again. Use the Conjunctive conditions card to split one condition in the goal.

value.zh: 「合取条件」只改写匹配的那一段。用「拆成两层」时，原来的共同条件变成依次引入的两个条件。
value.en: Conjunctive conditions rewrites the matching subformula. Splitting it turns the two conjuncts into two successive conditions.

value.zh: 在「选择规则」里选 (A ∧ B) → C 改写为 A → (B → C) 的方向。
value.en: Under Choose rules, select the direction that rewrites (A ∧ B) → C to A → (B → C).

value.zh: 在第 3 章的「交换律」里，你已经证明「或者」的两项可以互换。这次目标里有两处可以交换，预期只交换其中一处。
value.en: In the commutativity lesson, you proved that the two sides of a disjunction can trade places. Here the goal contains two matches, and Expected swaps just one.

value.zh: 两处都符合析取交换律。点选第二处，让证明器在每个案例中保留第一处的顺序。
value.en: Both occurrences match disjunction commutativity. Selecting the second leaves the first in its original order in each case.

value.zh: 用「改写·析取交换律」，在目标公式里点选第二处匹配。
value.en: Use the disjunction commutativity rewrite card and select the second match in the goal formula.

t.zh: 两个案例的目标形状相同，已知却不一样。
t.en: The two goals have the same shape, but the givens differ.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.zh: 比较两个案例一开始的已知和目标。哪个案例一开始就能证完？
hint.en: Compare the givens and the goal each case starts with. Which case can be finished right away?

t.zh: 逆用「套用」时，机器只知道结论 \(B\)，还不知道条件 \(A\) 是哪一句。它先把这一句记成 \(?A\)，等后面的步骤来确定。
t.en: Used backwards, Apply knows the conclusion \(B\) but not yet which sentence the condition \(A\) is. It writes \(?A\) for now and lets later steps settle it.

after.zh: \(?A\) 是一个还没定下来的句子。一个目标定下它之后，其余含 \(?A\) 的目标也同时换成这一句。
after.en: \(?A\) stands for a sentence not yet settled. Once one goal settles it, every other goal containing \(?A\) changes with it.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.zh: 步进观察带 \(?A\) 的目标：它在哪一步变成了具体的句子，其他目标又跟着变成了什么？
hint.en: Step through and watch the goals containing \(?A\): at which step does it become a concrete sentence, and what happens to the other goals?

t.zh: 这一回，两个待证目标里出现了同一个 \(?B\)。
t.en: This time the same \(?B\) appears in two open goals.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.zh: \(?B\) 可以由不同的目标来确定。比较每种确定方式之后，剩下的目标还能不能证。
hint.en: Different goals can settle \(?B\). Compare what is left to prove after each choice.

t.zh: 已知是一条「或者」，目标是另一条「或者」。
t.en: The given is an “or”, and the goal is a different “or”.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.zh: 每种情况里多了哪条已知？对照它和那时的目标。
hint.en: Which given does each case add? Compare it with the goal at that point.

t.zh: \(\lnot A\) 就是 \(A \to \bot\)。证明板上处理「如果」和 ⊥ 的规则，在这里同样可用。
t.en: \(\lnot A\) means \(A \to \bot\). The rules the proof board uses for “if” and ⊥ work here as well.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.zh: 把目标和已知里的 \(\lnot\) 都读成「… → ⊥」，再看当前目标是什么形状。
hint.en: Read every \(\lnot\) in the goal and the givens as “… → ⊥”, then look at the shape of the current goal.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.zh: 对照已知，看它落在目标的哪一项里。卡上选的规则决定留下哪一项。
hint.en: Check the givens to see which part of the goal they sit in. The rule chosen on a card decides which side stays.

value.zh: 证明一条「或者」时，证成其中一项就够了。这一回，「或者」里还套着「或者」。
value.en: To prove an “or”, one side is enough. This time an “or” sits inside another.

value.zh: 步进观察逆用之后的已知和目标，看看目标能与哪条已知对上。
value.en: Step through and compare the givens and the goal after the rule is used backwards.

value.zh: 要证明「下雨并且刮风」，两个部分都得成立。
value.en: To prove “it rains and it is windy”, both parts must hold.

value.zh: 步进观察每一步之后还剩几个目标。
value.en: Step through and count the goals left after each step.

value.zh: 两个案例的目标形状不同。它们的已知有什么共同点？
value.en: The two goals have different shapes. What do their givens have in common?

value.zh: 对照目标和已知里的整句，看它们差在哪一处。
value.en: Compare the goal with the full sentence among the givens and find where they differ.

value.zh: 「条件顺序」一关证出的规则，两个方向都成立。这一回，要对调的两层条件有时只是目标的一部分。
value.en: The rule proved in “Order of conditions” holds in both directions. This time the two nested conditions are sometimes only part of the goal.

value.zh: 同一条规则有逆用和改写两张卡。比较它们在第二个案例里各自能不能用上。
value.en: The same rule comes as a backward card and a rewrite card. Compare whether each one fits the second case.

value.zh: 已知里有等价式，目标里同一个词出现了两次。
value.en: The givens include an equivalence, and the same word appears twice in the goal.

value.zh: 运行后对照目标和已知里的整句，看还有哪里不同。
value.en: Run it, then compare the goal with the full sentence among the givens to see what still differs.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.zh: 对照目标和已知里的整句，找出它们不同的那一处。改写卡上可以看到每一处匹配。
hint.en: Compare the goal with the full sentence among the givens and find the one place they differ. The rewrite card shows every match.

value.zh: 这一回，等价式在已知里，目标是一条「如果…那么…」。
value.en: This time the equivalence is among the givens, and the goal is an “if … then …”.

value.zh: 改写卡只改目标。步进观察每一步之后，要换的那个词在目标里还是在已知里。
value.en: A rewrite card changes only the goal. Step through and see whether the word to replace sits in the goal or among the givens after each step.

value.zh: 这一回，等价式写在目标的条件里。
value.en: This time the equivalence is a condition inside the goal.

value.zh: 改写卡用的等价式要在已知里。步进观察每一步之后的已知。
value.en: A rewrite card needs its equivalence among the givens. Step through and watch the givens after each step.
Open each of the two implications once. After opening the outer one, inspect the new given and the remaining goal.
value.zh: 两层「如果」各要打开一次。打开外层后，检查等价式和仍待证明的句子。

value.en: This time the equivalence is a condition in the goal. Which step makes it available to the rewrite card as a given?
value.zh: 这一回，等价式写在目标的条件里。想一想，哪一步能让它成为改写卡可用的已知？

value.en: Opening the assumption box moves the original condition into the givens. When can the rewrite card still reach that condition?
value.zh: 若先逆用假设框，原来的条件就进了已知。把改写卡放在哪一步，才能改到这个条件？

value.en: This time the equivalence is already given. See whether you can first rewrite the condition of the implication to match its conclusion.
value.zh: 这次等价式已经在已知里。看看能不能先把「如果」后的条件换成与结论相同的句子。

value.en: Each rewrite card replaces one occurrence. Cite the complete given once the goal matches it. After running the board, check which step replaced each occurrence.
value.zh: 每张改写卡只换一处。等目标和已知里的整句一致，再引用它。运行后，看看两处分别在哪一步被改写。

value.en: The givens contain an equivalence and the complete sentence you need to reach. The goal has two occurrences to replace.
value.zh: 已知里有等价式，也有改写后的整句。目标里出现了两处要换的内容。

value.en: Find the two nested conditions in the goal. Use Swap to exchange them, then connect Cite a given.
value.zh: 找出目标里嵌套的两层条件。用「交换」对调它们，再接上「照抄」。

value.en: You built Swap in the Order lesson. Use it to rewrite the goal by exchanging two consecutive conditions.
value.zh: 在「条件顺序」一关，你造出了「交换」卡。现在用它改写目标，把相邻两层条件对调。

value.en: Connect Eq. substitution to Cite a given. Look for the given that matches the rewritten goal.
value.zh: 把「等价代换」接到「照抄」，看看改写后的目标能与哪条已知对上。

value.en: Explosion has premise ⊥. After applying it backwards, cite the given to close that goal.
value.zh: 「爆炸」的前提是 ⊥。逆用之后，用「照抄」关闭这个目标。

value.en: After backward Join, connect two Cite a given cards in sequence. Step through the run to see which goal closes each time.
value.zh: 把两张「照抄」依次接到逆用「拼接」之后。可以用步进观察每次少了哪个目标。

value.en: To prove that it rains and it is windy, you need both claims. Use Join backwards and see how many goals the assistant leaves.
value.zh: 要证明「下雨并且刮风」，两个部分都得成立。把「拼接」倒过来用，看看证明器会留下几个目标。

value.en: Apply the Assumption box backwards, then use Cite a given. Step through the run to see which given matches the remaining goal.
value.zh: 先逆用「假设框」，再用「照抄」。步进观察剩下的目标能与哪条已知对上。

value.en: Using the assumption box backwards changes both the available givens and the current goal. Whether a rewrite can run depends on the proof state it receives.
value.zh: 逆用假设框会改变可用的已知，也会改变当前目标。改写能否进行，就取决于卡片收到的证明状态。

value.en: Rewriting the condition before opening the assumption box lets you close the goal with the new given.
value.zh: 先改写整条目标中的条件，再打开假设框，引用新增的已知即可得证。

value.en: Each card replaces one occurrence. Select a boxed subformula in the original sentence to choose where. The default is the first match, from the outside in and left to right.
value.zh: 每张改写卡只换一处。可以在原句中点选要替换的子式。未点选时，先匹配整句，再从外往里、从左往右找第一处。

value.en: Swap uses the rule from the proof board: A → (B → C) becomes B → (A → C). The same rule can rewrite just part of a goal.
value.zh: 「交换」沿用证明板上的规则：把 A → (B → C) 改成 B → (A → C)。同一条规则可以用在目标的一部分。

value.en: Using Explosion backwards replaces the original goal with ⊥. The proof succeeds when you can prove that contradiction.
value.zh: 逆用「爆炸」把原目标换成 ⊥。只有当矛盾能证出时，这条路线才完成证明。

value.en: Using Join backwards creates two goals in the order the conjuncts appear. Each Cite a given closes one goal that matches a given.
value.zh: 逆用「拼接」会按合取式的顺序生成两个目标。每次「照抄」证完一个与已知相同的目标。

value.en: To prove that you take the bus or ride a bike, one alternative is enough. When you use Add alternative backwards, choose which claim remains.
value.zh: 证明「坐公交或者骑车」时，证成其中一项就够了。逆用「补充」要先决定留下哪一项。

value.en: Using Add alternative backwards leaves just the chosen disjunct. Look at the givens to choose a rule that leaves a goal you can prove.
value.zh: 逆用「补充」只留下选定的那一项。应根据已知选择规则，留下可以证出的目标。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。

hint.en: Choose the rule with conclusion A ∨ B and premise B, then cite the given.
hint.zh: 选结论为 A ∨ B、前提为 B 的规则，再用「照抄」。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。

hint.en: The left disjunct is given. Choose the rule with conclusion A ∨ B and premise A.
hint.zh: 已知包含「或者」的左项。选结论为 A ∨ B、前提为 A 的规则。

why: Rewire the prover chapter prerequisites for the new level arrangement
Remove the prover levels and per-level trays the new arrangement no longer uses

t.en: The goal is a conjunction. One side is already given, and the other needs an equivalence.
t.zh: 机器要证的是一条「并且」。一边已经在已知里，另一边要借助等价式。

after.en: Both goals left by backward Join must be proved. Each time a goal closes, the next one becomes current.
after.zh: 逆用拼接生出的两个目标都要完成。每证完一个，待证列表里的下一个就成为当前目标。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。

hint.en: Join used backwards splits the goal into two. The rewrite and citation cards act on the first remaining goal.
hint.zh: 「拼接」倒过来能把目标拆成两个。改写卡和照抄卡每次都处理当前的第一个目标。

t.en: Two parts of the goal match the Swap rule. Compare the goal with the given to decide which part to swap so Cite a given can finish the proof.
t.zh: 目标里有两段都符合「交换」的规则。对照已知里的句子，判断交换哪一段才能用「照抄」证完。

after.en: In both cases, swapping the nested conditions in the second occurrence makes the goal match the given, so Cite a given can finish the proof.
after.zh: 在两个案例中，交换第二段的两层条件就能让目标与已知相同，再用「照抄」完成证明。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。

hint.en: On the Swap card, select the second match in the goal formula, then connect Cite a given.
hint.zh: 在「交换」卡的目标公式中点选第二处匹配，再接上「照抄」。

t.en: This time, swap two conditions and use the given equivalence to replace one of them. Connect Swap and Eq. substitution and see what each card changes.
t.zh: 现在既要调换两层条件，也要用已知等价式换掉其中一项。把「交换」和「等价代换」接起来，看看每张卡各改了什么。

after.en: Swap changes the order of the conditions. Eq. substitution replaces the part that matches the given equivalence. Each step rewrites one occurrence.
after.zh: 「交换」改变两层条件的顺序，「等价代换」替换其中符合已知等价式的一项。两步各自改写一处。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。

hint.en: Compare the goal with the corresponding given to see which conditions to swap and what to replace. Finish with Cite a given.
hint.zh: 对照目标和已知中的对应句子，找出要对调的条件和要代换的一项，再用「照抄」收尾。

t.en: A goal can sometimes be rewritten in different places. Connect rewrite cards so the prover can try them in turn.
t.zh: 同一个目标有时能在不同位置改写。把改写卡接起来，让证明器逐一尝试。

after.en: When a card cannot apply, it passes the current goal on unchanged. Once the goal is proved, later cards pass the result through.
after.zh: 一张卡用不上时，证明器保留当前目标，继续交给下一张卡。目标证完后，后续卡也会直接传递结果。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。

hint.en: Compare each equivalence with its goal to find the position and direction to rewrite. Cite a given after rewriting.
hint.zh: 比较每个案例里的等价式和目标，找出要改写的位置及方向。改写后再用「照抄」。

why: Rewrite chapter four player copy

value.zh: 在<level-ref to="iffUse"></level-ref>，你亲手连接元件写证明。现在让证明器面对多个案例：每个案例都有已知和待证目标。
value.en: In <level-ref to="iffUse"></level-ref>, you connected parts to make a proof. Now a prover faces several cases, each with givens and a goal.

value.zh: 比较每个案例的目标和已知。
value.en: Compare each goal with its givens.

value.zh: 目标与一条已知完全相同时，就已经证出。证明器可以用同一组元件处理不同案例。
value.en: A goal is proved when it matches a given exactly. The same set of parts can handle different cases.

value.zh: <level-ref to="machine-cite"></level-ref>的证明器遇到了新的目标：一句「如果……那么……」。证明板上的规则能帮助它吗？
value.en: The prover from <level-ref to="machine-cite"></level-ref> now faces an “if … then …” goal. Can a rule from the proof board help?

value.zh: 对照目标的形状和元件上规则的结论。
value.en: Compare the shape of the goal with the conclusions on the parts.

value.zh: 逆用规则时，证明器从结论寻找要证的前提。<wiki-ref to="backward"></wiki-ref>让它从目标出发组织证明。
value.en: Working backwards, the prover takes a conclusion and looks for premises to prove. This is <wiki-ref to="backward"></wiki-ref>.

value.zh: 在<level-ref to="iffUse"></level-ref>，等价代换改变了已证句子的一部分。现在证明器面对的是待证目标和已知中的等价式。
value.en: In <level-ref to="iffUse"></level-ref>, equivalence substitution changed part of a proved sentence. The prover now has a goal and an equivalence among its givens.

value.zh: 比较目标和已知中的句子，留意它们的不同。
value.en: Compare the goal with the sentences among the givens. Where do they differ?

value.zh: 等价的两部分可以互相代换，句子的其余部分保持不变。
value.en: Equivalent expressions can replace one another while the rest of the sentence stays the same.

value.zh: <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref>让证明器处理了条件。现在目标换成了「并且」。
value.en: In <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref>, the prover dealt with a conditional. Its goal is now an “and”.

value.zh: 运行时留意待证目标的数量和内容。
value.en: As it runs, watch how many goals remain and what they say.

value.zh: <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref>中的目标有一层条件；这里各案例的条件层数不同。
value.en: The goals in <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref> had one condition. Here the cases have different numbers of nested conditions.

value.zh: 逐个案例步进，观察元件不适用时的证明状态。
value.en: Step through each case and watch the proof state when a part does not apply.

value.zh: 元件用不上时，证明状态会原样传下去。同一个证明器因此可以处理不同的案例。
value.en: When a part does not apply, it passes the proof state through unchanged. One prover can therefore handle different cases.

value.zh: <level-ref to="machine-rewrite"></level-ref>中的目标有可用等价式的地方。这次同一个词在目标里出现了两次。
value.en: In <level-ref to="machine-rewrite"></level-ref>, an equivalence applied to the goal. This time the same term appears twice in it.

value.zh: 对照目标和已知中的整句，留意各处的异同。
value.en: Compare the whole goal with the given sentence, including each occurrence.

value.zh: <level-ref to="machine-backward-and"></level-ref>里，逆用规则产生了多个目标。这次证明器面对的目标和已知又不同了。
value.en: In <level-ref to="machine-backward-and"></level-ref>, working backwards produced several goals. This time the prover faces different goals and givens.

value.zh: 步进观察运行结果中尚未确定的句子，以及包含它的目标。
value.en: Step through and watch any undetermined sentence in the result and the goals containing it.

value.zh: 运行结果中的 \(?A\) 代表还没定下来的句子。它确定后，其他出现同一未知句子的地方也随之确定。
value.en: In a result, \(?A\) stands for a sentence not yet determined. Once fixed, every occurrence of that same unknown is fixed too.

value.zh: <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref>中的证明器处理了条件；现在目标里的「或者」套着「或者」。
value.en: The prover in <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref> dealt with a conditional. Now an “or” sits inside another “or” in the goal.

value.zh: 比较目标各部分与已知，并留意可选的规则。
value.en: Compare the parts of the goal with the givens, and look at the available rules.

value.zh: <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref>和<level-ref to="machine-rewrite"></level-ref>让证明器以不同方式使用规则。这里，目标与已知的差异出现在不同位置。
value.en: In <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref> and <level-ref to="machine-rewrite"></level-ref>, the prover used rules in different ways. Here the difference between goal and given occurs in different places.

value.zh: 比较两个案例中目标和已知的结构，也看看元件上的规则。
value.en: Compare the structure of each goal and given, and look at the rules on the parts.

value.zh: 两个方向都成立的规则才有改写元件；只有一个方向的规则只能逆用。改写可以作用于句子的一部分。
value.en: A rule has a rewrite part only when it holds in both directions; a one-way rule can only be used backwards. Rewriting can apply to part of a sentence.

value.zh: 在<level-ref to="machine-meta"></level-ref>，运行结果中出现了尚未确定的句子。这次有多个目标涉及同一个未知。
value.en: In <level-ref to="machine-meta"></level-ref>, the result contained an undetermined sentence. This time several goals share one unknown.

value.zh: 观察某个未知确定后，其他目标发生了什么变化。
value.en: Watch what happens to the other goals when an unknown is fixed.

value.zh: <level-ref to="bot"></level-ref>中，你在证明板上用过矛盾。这次证明器面对的案例中也有矛盾。
value.en: In <level-ref to="bot"></level-ref>, you used a contradiction on the proof board. The prover now faces cases involving a contradiction.

value.zh: 比较各案例的已知和目标，留意共同之处。
value.en: Compare the givens and goals across the cases. What do they have in common?

value.zh: <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref>处理了条件，<level-ref to="machine-rewrite"></level-ref>处理了等价式。这次两者都出现了。
value.en: <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref> dealt with conditions, and <level-ref to="machine-rewrite"></level-ref> with equivalences. Here both appear together.

value.zh: 步进观察目标与已知的变化，留意等价式的位置。
value.en: Step through and watch the goal and givens change. Where is the equivalence?

value.zh: <level-ref to="cases"></level-ref>中，你在证明板上分情况推理。这次已知和目标都是「或者」，交给证明器试试。
value.en: In <level-ref to="cases"></level-ref>, you reasoned by cases on the proof board. Now both a given and the goal are “or” statements; let the prover try.

value.zh: 观察各情况中的已知，比较它们与目标。
value.en: Look at the givens in each case and compare them with the goal.

value.zh: <level-ref to="machine-skip"></level-ref>的证明器处理了不同层数的案例。这次目标形状相同，已知却不同。
value.en: The prover in <level-ref to="machine-skip"></level-ref> handled cases of different depths. Here the goals have the same shape, but the givens differ.

value.zh: 比较每个案例开始时的目标和已知。
value.en: Compare each goal with its givens at the start.

value.zh: <level-ref to="machine-rewrite-first"></level-ref>中，等价式在已知里。这次它出现在目标的条件中。
value.en: In <level-ref to="machine-rewrite-first"></level-ref>, the equivalence was among the givens. Here it appears in a condition in the goal.

value.zh: 步进观察已知和目标，留意等价式在哪里。
value.en: Step through the proof state and watch where the equivalence appears.

value.zh: 在<level-ref to="notI"></level-ref>，你在证明板上证明过否定。现在让证明器面对含有否定的目标和已知。
value.en: In <level-ref to="notI"></level-ref>, you proved a negation on the proof board. Now the prover faces negations in its goal and givens.

value.zh: 回看<level-ref to="notI"></level-ref>中否定的含义，观察运行中的目标。
value.en: Recall what negation means in <level-ref to="notI"></level-ref>, and watch the goals as the prover runs.

value.zh: 目标有时与已知完全相同。看看证明器怎样判断这样的目标。
value.en: Sometimes a goal exactly matches a given. See how the prover handles such a goal.

value.zh: 「目标」列出各案例的已知和目标，「预期」显示要达到的结果。同一个证明器会处理所有案例。
value.en: “Goal” lists each case’s givens and goal; “Expected” shows the required result. The same prover handles every case.

value.zh: 比较两组案例中目标和已知的异同。
value.en: Compare how the goals and givens differ across the two sets.

value.zh: 用规则元件处理待证目标。
value.en: Use rule parts to work on proof goals.
Apply rules directly, rewrite, or organize a proof with repetition and depth-first search.
value.zh: 直接逆用和改写规则，或用重复框和回溯搜索组织证明。

value.en: Compare the goal with the full sentence among the givens and find the one place they differ. The rewrite card shows every match.
value.zh: 对照目标和已知里的整句，找出它们不同的那一处。改写卡上可以看到每一处匹配。

value.en: Goal gives the givens and goal for each case; Expected shows the required result. Once wired, the same proof assistant handles every case.
value.zh: 「目标」给出每个案例的已知和待证目标，「预期」显示要达到的结果。接好电路后，同一个证明器会处理每个案例。

value.en: The simplest case is a goal already among the givens. Cite a given can prove it immediately.
value.zh: 最简单的情况是：目标已经在已知里。这时「照抄」就能直接证完它。

value.en: Read every \(\lnot\) in the goal and the givens as “… → ⊥”, then look at the shape of the current goal.
value.zh: 把目标和已知里的 \(\lnot\) 都读成「… → ⊥」，再看当前目标是什么形状。

value.en: \(\lnot A\) means \(A \to \bot\). The rules the proof board uses for “if” and ⊥ work here as well.
value.zh: \(\lnot A\) 就是 \(A \to \bot\)。证明板上处理「如果」和 ⊥ 的规则，在这里同样可用。

value.en: A rewrite card needs its equivalence among the givens. Step through and watch the givens after each step.
value.zh: 改写卡用的等价式要在已知里。步进观察每一步之后的已知。

value.en: This time the equivalence is a condition inside the goal.
value.zh: 这一回，等价式写在目标的条件里。

value.en: Compare the givens and the goal each case starts with. Which case can be finished right away?
value.zh: 比较两个案例一开始的已知和目标。哪个案例一开始就能证完？

value.en: The two goals have the same shape, but the givens differ.
value.zh: 两个案例的目标形状相同，已知却不一样。

value.en: Which given does each case add? Compare it with the goal at that point.
value.zh: 每种情况里多了哪条已知？对照它和那时的目标。

value.en: The given is an “or”, and the goal is a different “or”.
value.zh: 已知是一条「或者」，目标是另一条「或者」。

value.en: A rewrite card changes only the goal. Step through and see whether the word to replace sits in the goal or among the givens after each step.
value.zh: 改写卡只改目标。步进观察每一步之后，要换的那个词在目标里还是在已知里。

value.en: This time the equivalence is among the givens, and the goal is an “if … then …”.
value.zh: 这一回，等价式在已知里，目标是一条「如果…那么…」。

value.en: The two goals have different shapes. What do their givens have in common?
value.zh: 两个案例的目标形状不同。它们的已知有什么共同点？

value.en: If contradiction ⊥ is given, Explosion derives any conclusion. Apply it backwards and see what different goals turn into.
value.zh: 如果已知里有矛盾 ⊥，「爆炸」能推出任意结论。现在把它逆用，观察不同的目标会变成什么。

value.en: Different goals can settle \(?B\). Compare what is left to prove after each choice.
value.zh: \(?B\) 可以由不同的目标来确定。比较每种确定方式之后，剩下的目标还能不能证。

value.en: This time the same \(?B\) appears in two open goals.
value.zh: 这一回，两个待证目标里出现了同一个 \(?B\)。

value.en: The same rule comes as a backward card and a rewrite card. Compare whether each one fits the second case.
value.zh: 同一条规则有逆用和改写两张卡。比较它们在第二个案例里各自能不能用上。

value.en: The rule proved in “Order of conditions” holds in both directions. This time the two nested conditions are sometimes only part of the goal.
value.zh: 「条件顺序」一关证出的规则，两个方向都成立。这一回，要对调的两层条件有时只是目标的一部分。

value.en: Check the givens to see which part of the goal they sit in. The rule chosen on a card decides which side stays.
value.zh: 对照已知，看它落在目标的哪一项里。卡上选的规则决定留下哪一项。

value.en: To prove an “or”, one side is enough. This time an “or” sits inside another.
value.zh: 证明一条「或者」时，证成其中一项就够了。这一回，「或者」里还套着「或者」。

value.en: \(?A\) stands for a sentence not yet settled. Once one goal settles it, every other goal containing \(?A\) changes with it.
value.zh: \(?A\) 是一个还没定下来的句子。一个目标定下它之后，其余含 \(?A\) 的目标也同时换成这一句。

value.en: Step through and watch the goals containing \(?A\): at which step does it become a concrete sentence, and what happens to the other goals?
value.zh: 步进观察带 \(?A\) 的目标：它在哪一步变成了具体的句子，其他目标又跟着变成了什么？

value.en: Used backwards, Apply knows the conclusion \(B\) but not yet which sentence the condition \(A\) is. It writes \(?A\) for now and lets later steps settle it.
value.zh: 逆用「套用」时，机器只知道结论 \(B\)，还不知道条件 \(A\) 是哪一句。它先把这一句记成 \(?A\)，等后面的步骤来确定。

value.en: Run it, then compare the goal with the full sentence among the givens to see what still differs.
value.zh: 运行后对照目标和已知里的整句，看还有哪里不同。

value.en: The givens include an equivalence, and the same word appears twice in the goal.
value.zh: 已知里有等价式，目标里同一个词出现了两次。

value.en: Step through each case and watch what happens to the proof state when a card does not fit the goal.
value.zh: 逐个案例步进，看看一张卡对不上目标时，证明状态发生了什么。

value.en: This time the cases nest different numbers of “if”.
value.zh: 这一回，各个案例里「如果」的层数不一样。

value.en: Step through and count the goals left after each step.
value.zh: 步进观察每一步之后还剩几个目标。

value.en: To prove “it rains and it is windy”, both parts must hold.
value.zh: 要证明「下雨并且刮风」，两个部分都得成立。

value.en: The rewrite replaced one matching occurrence. Cite a given closed the goal once it matched a given.
value.zh: 改写换掉了目标里匹配的一处。改写后的目标与一条已知相同，就可以用「照抄」证完。

value.en: Compare the goal with the full sentence among the givens and find where they differ.
value.zh: 对照目标和已知里的整句，看它们差在哪一处。

value.en: Earlier, you used substitution to rewrite a proved sentence. Now use the same rule on a goal. The rewrite card finds an applicable equivalence, such as \(A \leftrightarrow B\), among the givens and replaces one occurrence of \(A\) in the goal with \(B\).
value.zh: 之前用代换规则改写已证的句子；现在用同一条规则改写待证目标。改写卡从已知中找一条用得上的等价式，如 \(A \leftrightarrow B\)，把目标里的一处 \(A\) 换成 \(B\)。

value.en: Applying the Assumption box backwards adds the condition to the givens and leaves its conclusion to prove. Cite a given can use the new assumption or a given that was already there.
value.zh: 逆用「假设框」把条件加入已知，留下结论待证。「照抄」可以引用刚加入的条件，也可以引用原有的已知。

value.en: Step through and compare the givens and the goal after the rule is used backwards.
value.zh: 步进观察逆用之后的已知和目标，看看目标能与哪条已知对上。

value.en: To prove \(A \to B\), you can add \(A\) to the givens and then prove \(B\). Applying the assumption-box rule backwards makes the machine take that step.
value.zh: 要证 \(A \to B\)，可以先把 \(A\) 放进已知，再证 \(B\)。把假设框规则倒着用，机器就会做这一步。

value.en: The proof assistant starts from the goal and closes it when it finds an identical given. Matching rules to goals lets a machine work through what remains to be proved and repeat the same steps across cases, making automation easier. More complex goals still need more rules.
value.zh: 证明器从目标出发，只要找到完全相同的已知，就能确定这一目标已证完。按目标匹配规则，机器可以逐步寻找要证的内容，并对不同案例重复同一套步骤，更适合自动化；遇到复杂目标时，还需要更多规则。

value.en: Cite a given looks for a sentence identical to the current goal.
value.zh: 「照抄」会找与当前目标相同的句子。

value.en: Earlier, you connected rules from the givens until you reached the conclusion. Now you will design a proof assistant that starts with a goal and works backwards to find rules that can prove it.
value.zh: 之前，你从已知出发，连接规则，一步步推到要证明的结论。现在，你要设计一个证明器，让它从待证目标出发，倒着寻找能证明它的规则。

why: Avoid linking a later encyclopedia entry

value.zh: 逆用规则时，证明器从结论寻找要证的前提。这种逆向推理让它从目标出发组织证明。
value.en: Working backwards, the prover takes a conclusion and looks for premises to prove. This lets it organise a proof starting from the goal.
Working backwards, the prover takes a conclusion and looks for premises to prove. This is <wiki-ref to="backward"></wiki-ref>.
value.zh: 逆用规则时，证明器从结论寻找要证的前提。<wiki-ref to="backward"></wiki-ref>让它从目标出发组织证明。

why: Keep the first case open to discovery

value.zh: 先看看每个案例里的目标和已知，想一想它们有什么关系。
value.en: Start by looking at each case’s goal and givens. How are they related?
Sometimes a goal exactly matches a given. See how the prover handles such a goal.
value.zh: 目标有时与已知完全相同。看看证明器怎样判断这样的目标。

why: Limit the prover chapter to one rule shape for apply and the two projections for split
Refine prover chapter names, introductions and observation hints

value.zh: 看看「目标」中每个案例的已知有哪些；案例之间有哪些变化？
value.en: In “Goal”, what givens does each case contain, and how do the cases differ?

value.zh: 运行时留意条件句里的哪一部分出现在已知中。
value.en: As the prover runs, notice which part of the conditional appears among the givens.

value.zh: 观察运行结果：目标里发生变化的部分与等价式有什么关系？
value.en: In the result, how does the changed part of the goal relate to the equivalence?

value.zh: <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref>中的目标是条件句；这次目标把两句话用「并且」连在一起。
value.en: In <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref> the goal was conditional; here it joins two sentences with “and”.

value.zh: 运行时留意待证目标的数量和内容。
value.en: As it runs, watch how many goals remain and what they say.

value.zh: 运行后看看目标中重复的词还有几处与原来相同。
value.en: After running, how many occurrences of the repeated term remain unchanged in the goal?

value.zh: <level-ref to="machine-backward-and"></level-ref>中的多个目标都由题目直接给出的句子组成。这次已知里有条件句，证明器要处理其中条件与结论的关系。
value.en: In <level-ref to="machine-backward-and"></level-ref>, the goals were made from sentences already in the problem. Here the givens include a conditional, and the prover faces the relation between its condition and conclusion.

value.zh: 步进观察运行结果中未定的字母何时变成具体句子。
value.en: Step through the result: when does an undetermined letter become a definite sentence?

value.zh: 观察运行结果中每层「或者」剩下的目标是什么。
value.en: In the result, watch what goal remains at each layer of “or”.

value.zh: <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref>和<level-ref to="machine-rewrite"></level-ref>用不同方式处理目标。这里两个案例里的条件句位置不同：一个是整个目标，另一个只是目标的一部分。
value.en: In <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref> and <level-ref to="machine-rewrite"></level-ref>, the prover handled goals in different ways. Here a conditional is the whole goal in one case, but only part of it in the other.

value.zh: 观察同一条规则的不同元件在第二个案例中是否起作用。
value.en: Watch whether the different parts for the same rule take effect in the second case.

value.zh: 观察同一个未定字母在多个目标中出现的位置，以及确定后各处的变化。
value.en: Notice where the same undetermined letter appears in the goals, and how those occurrences change when it is fixed.

value.zh: <level-ref to="bot"></level-ref>中，你在证明板上用过矛盾。这次各案例的目标形状不同，已知中都有矛盾。
value.en: In <level-ref to="bot"></level-ref>, you used a contradiction on the proof board. Here the goals have different shapes, and every case has a contradiction among its givens.

value.zh: 留意不同形状的目标，以及各案例已知中共同的符号。
value.en: Notice the differently shaped goals and the symbol shared by the givens in every case.

value.zh: <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref>处理了条件，<level-ref to="machine-rewrite"></level-ref>处理了等价式。这次等价式在已知中，目标则是一句条件。
value.en: <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref> dealt with a conditional, and <level-ref to="machine-rewrite"></level-ref> with an equivalence. Here the equivalence is given and the goal is conditional.

value.zh: 运行时留意目标的条件部分还在不在目标中。
value.en: As the prover runs, watch whether the condition is still part of the goal.

value.zh: <level-ref to="cases"></level-ref>中，你在证明板上分情况推理。这次已知和目标都是「或者」，但两边的句子换了位置。
value.en: In <level-ref to="cases"></level-ref>, you reasoned by cases on the proof board. Here both the given and the goal are “or” statements, with their sentences in opposite positions.

value.zh: 观察各情况新增的已知：它们分别对应目标的哪一边？
value.en: Look at the new given in each case. Which side of the goal does each correspond to?

value.zh: <level-ref to="machine-skip"></level-ref>的证明器处理了不同层数的案例。这次两个目标都是条件句，但只有一个案例一开始就有已知。
value.en: The prover in <level-ref to="machine-skip"></level-ref> handled cases of different depths. Here both goals are conditional, but only one case starts with a given.

value.zh: 观察两个案例各自的初始状态，以及运行后目标发生了什么变化。
value.en: Watch each case’s initial state and how its goal changes during the run.

value.zh: 观察运行结果中等价式何时出现在已知里。
value.en: Watch when the equivalence appears among the givens in the result.

value.zh: 在<level-ref to="notI"></level-ref>，你在证明板上证明过否定。这次目标和一条已知都含否定，另一条已知则是条件句。
value.en: In <level-ref to="notI"></level-ref>, you proved a negation on the proof board. Here both the goal and a given contain negation, while another given is conditional.

value.zh: 回看<level-ref to="notI"></level-ref>中否定的含义，留意运行结果中的矛盾符号。
value.en: Recall what negation means in <level-ref to="notI"></level-ref>, and watch for the contradiction symbol in the result.

value.zh: 一个案例的目标是单句，另一个是「并且」句。
value.en: One case has a single sentence as its goal; the other has an “and” statement.

value.zh: 对比两组案例的已知：重复的词有几处与目标不同？
value.en: Compare the givens across the two sets: how many occurrences differ from the goal?
Compare how the goals and givens differ across the two sets.
value.zh: 比较两组案例中目标和已知的异同。

value.en: Start by looking at each case’s goal and givens. How are they related?
value.zh: 先看看每个案例里的目标和已知，想一想它们有什么关系。

value.en: Recall what negation means in <level-ref to="notI"></level-ref>, and watch the goals as the prover runs.
value.zh: 回看<level-ref to="notI"></level-ref>中否定的含义，观察运行中的目标。

value.en: In <level-ref to="notI"></level-ref>, you proved a negation on the proof board. Now the prover faces negations in its goal and givens.
value.zh: 在<level-ref to="notI"></level-ref>，你在证明板上证明过否定。现在让证明器面对含有否定的目标和已知。

value.en: Step through the proof state and watch where the equivalence appears.
value.zh: 步进观察已知和目标，留意等价式在哪里。

value.en: Compare each goal with its givens at the start.
value.zh: 比较每个案例开始时的目标和已知。

value.en: The prover in <level-ref to="machine-skip"></level-ref> handled cases of different depths. Here the goals have the same shape, but the givens differ.
value.zh: <level-ref to="machine-skip"></level-ref>的证明器处理了不同层数的案例。这次目标形状相同，已知却不同。

value.en: Look at the givens in each case and compare them with the goal.
value.zh: 观察各情况中的已知，比较它们与目标。

value.en: In <level-ref to="cases"></level-ref>, you reasoned by cases on the proof board. Now both a given and the goal are “or” statements; let the prover try.
value.zh: <level-ref to="cases"></level-ref>中，你在证明板上分情况推理。这次已知和目标都是「或者」，交给证明器试试。

value.en: Step through and watch the goal and givens change. Where is the equivalence?
value.zh: 步进观察目标与已知的变化，留意等价式的位置。

value.en: <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref> dealt with conditions, and <level-ref to="machine-rewrite"></level-ref> with equivalences. Here both appear together.
value.zh: <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref>处理了条件，<level-ref to="machine-rewrite"></level-ref>处理了等价式。这次两者都出现了。

value.en: Compare the givens and goals across the cases. What do they have in common?
value.zh: 比较各案例的已知和目标，留意共同之处。

value.en: In <level-ref to="bot"></level-ref>, you used a contradiction on the proof board. The prover now faces cases involving a contradiction.
value.zh: <level-ref to="bot"></level-ref>中，你在证明板上用过矛盾。这次证明器面对的案例中也有矛盾。

value.en: Watch what happens to the other goals when an unknown is fixed.
value.zh: 观察某个未知确定后，其他目标发生了什么变化。

value.en: Compare the structure of each goal and given, and look at the rules on the parts.
value.zh: 比较两个案例中目标和已知的结构，也看看元件上的规则。

value.en: In <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref> and <level-ref to="machine-rewrite"></level-ref>, the prover used rules in different ways. Here the difference between goal and given occurs in different places.
value.zh: <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref>和<level-ref to="machine-rewrite"></level-ref>让证明器以不同方式使用规则。这里，目标与已知的差异出现在不同位置。

value.en: Compare the parts of the goal with the givens, and look at the available rules.
value.zh: 比较目标各部分与已知，并留意可选的规则。

value.en: Step through and watch any undetermined sentence in the result and the goals containing it.
value.zh: 步进观察运行结果中尚未确定的句子，以及包含它的目标。

value.en: In <level-ref to="machine-backward-and"></level-ref>, working backwards produced several goals. This time the prover faces different goals and givens.
value.zh: <level-ref to="machine-backward-and"></level-ref>里，逆用规则产生了多个目标。这次证明器面对的目标和已知又不同了。

value.en: Compare the whole goal with the given sentence, including each occurrence.
value.zh: 对照目标和已知中的整句，留意各处的异同。

value.en: As it runs, watch how many goals remain and what they say.
value.zh: 运行时留意待证目标的数量和内容。

value.en: In <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref>, the prover dealt with a conditional. Its goal is now an “and”.
value.zh: <level-ref to="machine-open"></level-ref>让证明器处理了条件。现在目标换成了「并且」。

value.en: Compare the goal with the sentences among the givens. Where do they differ?
value.zh: 比较目标和已知中的句子，留意它们的不同。

value.en: Compare the shape of the goal with the conclusions on the parts.
value.zh: 对照目标的形状和元件上规则的结论。

value.en: Compare each goal with its givens.
value.zh: 比较每个案例的目标和已知。

Drop the reference to a level that is no longer a prerequisite of the partial-rewrite level

value.en: <level-ref to="s-carroll"></level-ref> was proved by hand; this time, hand it to the proof assistant.

value.zh: 得到「\((Q(\text{晨星})\to Q(\text{晨星}))\to (Q(\text{昏星})\to Q(\text{晨星}))\)」：前一半的假设就是它要的结论，用一个假设框给出，再套用。
value.en: That gives “\((Q(\text{the Morning Star})\to Q(\text{the Morning Star}))\to (Q(\text{the Evening Star})\to Q(\text{the Morning Star}))\)”: the first half assumes just what it concludes; give it with an assumption box, then Apply.

t.zh: <level-ref to="decl-eq"></level-ref>把相等声明进了证明核。也可以不声明，用量词定义它：「a = b」就是「a 有的性质，b 都有」，写成 \mark{forall}P. \(P(a)\to P(b)\)。这里的 \mark{forall} 管的是性质：P(x) 是一句说 x 的话。
t.en: <level-ref to="decl-eq"></level-ref> declared equality into the kernel. It can also be defined with a quantifier instead: “a = b” is “every property a has, b has”, written \mark{forall}P. \(P(a)\to P(b)\). This \mark{forall} ranges over properties: P(x) is a sentence about x.

t.zh: 已知晨星 = 昏星，按定义写出来。<part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref>换掉 P 的是一句说 x 的话，每个 P(t) 都换成这句话，x 处填 t。
t.en: Given the Morning Star = the Evening Star, written out by the definition. <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref> puts in a sentence about x for P: each P(t) becomes that sentence with t in place of x.

t.zh: 已知里的 s(x) 不是一句话，而是由 x 算出的一样东西，可以读作「x 的下一个」。像 s 这样的记号叫函数符号。
t.en: In the given, s(x) is not a sentence but a thing worked out from x: read it as “the one after x”. A sign like s is a function symbol.

value.zh: 回溯搜索，直到证完：每一步或照抄已知，或逆用一条引入规则，或逆用一条消去规则再照抄；证不出时报告失败。
value.en: Searches with backtracking until done: each step cites a given, uses an introduction rule backwards, or uses an elimination rule backwards and then cites a given. It reports failure when there is no proof.
Searches depth first until done: each step tries Assumption, then Goal apart, then Use a given; a path back to an earlier state is not followed.
value.zh: 深度优先搜索，直到证完：每一步依次尝试由假设得证、分解目标、分解假设；回到原状态的路径不再继续。

body.en: When an expression is put in for a variable, a free variable in it that lands under a quantifier of the same name is captured, and the meaning changes completely: putting y in for x in \(\forall x.\, \exists y.\, \text{Likes}(x,y)\) must not give \(\exists y.\, \text{Likes}(y,y)\). The cure is to rename the first: \(\exists y\) becomes \(\exists z\), then put y in, giving \(\exists z.\, \text{Likes}(y,z)\). Provers rename automatically when they substitute.
body.zh: 把一个式子代进变量时，式子里的自由变量要是落进了同名量词的管辖，就被它捕获了，意思全变：\(\forall x\). \(\exists y\). 喜欢(x, y) 把 x 换成 y，不能得到 \(\exists y\). 喜欢(y, y)。办法是先给改名：\(\exists y\) 改成 \(\exists z\)，再代入，得到 \(\exists z\). 喜欢(y, z)。证明器替换时都会自动改名。

value.en: That gives “\((Q(\text{the Morning Star})\to Q(\text{the Morning Star}))\to (Q(\text{the Evening Star})\to Q(\text{the Morning Star}))\)”: the first half is what <level-ref to="h-eq-refl"></level-ref> proved; give it with an assumption box, then Apply.

hint.en: Is one use of the “for all” given enough?
hint.zh: 「对所有」那一句，用一次够吗？

t.en: <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref> as a rule is \mark{open-bracket}\(\forall x.\, P\)(x)\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} P(t). Backwards, its conclusion P(t) must fit “Socrates is mortal”, but P is followed by t, not by a bound variable. Is P “x is mortal” with t Socrates, or is P just “Socrates is mortal” with t anything? There is more than one solution, the unifier does not guess, and the part does not fit.
t.zh: <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref>写成规则是 \mark{open-bracket}\(\forall x.\, P\)(x)\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} P(t)。倒着用，结论 P(t) 要对上「苏格拉底会死」，而 P 后面跟的是 t，不是约束变量。P 是「x会死」、t 是苏格拉底？还是 P 就是「苏格拉底会死」、t 任意？解不止一个，合一器不猜，元件对不上。

t.en: Starting from the givens did not require going backwards: was wired after the “for all” given, and what it gave wired on. Getting a sentence on the way and then using it is, as a rule, Have: \mark{open-bracket}A; \mark{open-bracket}A\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} C\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} C. Used backwards it adds a goal ?A, and the ?A proved joins the next goal’s givens. comes in at the board’s input Rules; the proof assistant you design becomes a new part, “Forward”, and that input is its port Rules.
t.zh: 从已知出发时不必倒着走：接在「对所有」那条已知后面，得出的一句再接给别的元件。中途得出一句、再拿来用，写成规则是先证一句 \mark{open-bracket}A; \mark{open-bracket}A\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} C\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} C：倒着用它，多出一个目标 ?A，证出的 ?A 进入下一个目标的已知。从板上的「规则」输入接入；设计出的证明器会成为新元件「前向推理」，这个输入就是它的「规则」口。

after.en: Reasoning on from a given like this is <wiki-ref to="forward"></wiki-ref>.
after.zh: 像这样从已知往前推，叫<wiki-ref to="forward"></wiki-ref>。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that takes one from the “for all” given and adds it to the givens, turning each goal into the one wanted.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，从「对所有」那条已知取一个，加进已知，把每个目标变成要的样子。

hint.en: Have used backwards leaves a bare ?A as the first goal.
hint.zh: 先证一句倒着用，第一个目标是一个光秃秃的 ?A。

hint.en: ?A is settled from the “for all” given: <part-ref to="lemma:erule"></part-ref> with <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref>.
hint.zh: ?A 由「对所有」那条已知来定：<part-ref to="lemma:erule"></part-ref>接上<part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref>。

t.en: <part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref> as a rule is \mark{open-bracket}\(\exists x.\, P\)(x); \mark{meta-all}x. \mark{open-bracket}P(x)\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} C\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} C. It is an elimination rule too: its first premise fits a “there is”, and the \mark{meta-all}x in front of the second gives the new goal a thing a, with a given about it.
t.zh: <part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref>写成规则是 \mark{open-bracket}\(\exists x.\, P\)(x); \mark{meta-all}x. \mark{open-bracket}P(x)\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} C\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} C。它也是消去规则：第一条前提对上一条「存在」，第二条前提前面的 \mark{meta-all}x 让新目标多出一样东西 a，以及关于它的已知。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。

hint.en: The given contradicts itself, about the thing it says there is.
hint.zh: 已知自相矛盾，矛盾在它说存在的那样东西身上。

hint.en: <part-ref to="lemma:erule"></part-ref> with <part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref>, on the “there is” given.
hint.zh: <part-ref to="lemma:erule"></part-ref>接上<part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref>，对上「存在」那条已知。

t.en: <part-ref to="part:exI"></part-ref> as a rule is \mark{open-bracket}P(t)\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} \(\exists x.\, P\)(x). t stands for a thing: used backwards, the example cannot be read off the goal, so an unsettled ?t is left. In <level-ref to="q-exI"></level-ref>, with several “there is” sentences, you chose on the part which to conclude; with a rule used backwards, the goal says so itself.
t.zh: <part-ref to="part:exI"></part-ref>写成规则是 \mark{open-bracket}P(t)\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} \(\exists x.\, P\)(x)。t 代表一样东西：倒着用时，例子无法从目标读出，就留下一个未定的 ?t。<level-ref to="q-exI"></level-ref>里，有几句「存在」时要在元件上选得出哪一句；倒着用规则，目标自己就说明了。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。

hint.en: Who the example is, leave to a given.
hint.zh: 例子是谁，交给已知去定。

t.en: <part-ref to="part:allI"></part-ref> used backwards, \mark{open-bracket}\mark{meta-all}x. P(x)\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} \(\forall x.\, P\)(x): the unifier finds P, and the new goal is \mark{meta-all}a. P(a). \mark{meta-all} is the rules’ own “for all”, ruling over goals rather than sentences: a is any thing at all, and the goal must hold of it.
t.zh: 逆用<part-ref to="part:allI"></part-ref> \mark{open-bracket}\mark{meta-all}x. P(x)\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} \(\forall x.\, P\)(x)：合一器解出 P，新目标是 \mark{meta-all}a. P(a)。\mark{meta-all} 是规则自己的「对所有」，管的是目标而不是句子：a 是任取的一样东西，目标要对它成立。

desc.en: Moves the first goal to the end; the second becomes the first.
desc.zh: 把第一个目标移到最后，原来的第二个目标成为第一个。

desc.en: Takes rules: the rule’s conclusion is unified with the first goal and its first premise with one of that goal’s hypotheses; the goal is replaced by the remaining premises, one goal each. Given several rules, it uses the first that applies.
desc.zh: 接入规则：规则的结论与第一个目标合一，第一条前提与它的一条已知合一，这个目标换成其余的前提，每条一个目标。接入多条时用第一条适用的。

desc.en: Takes rules: the rule’s conclusion is unified with the first goal and its first premise with one of that goal’s hypotheses; the goal is replaced by the remaining premises, one goal each. Each rule wired in, and each hypothesis that fits, gives one result.
desc.zh: 接入规则：规则的结论与第一个目标合一，第一条前提与它的一条已知合一，这个目标换成其余的前提，每条一个目标。每一条规则、每一条合得上的已知都给出一种结果。

desc.en: Applies every elimination rule to the hypotheses: Split, Case analysis, applying an “if”, Explosion, the instance box, and choose an instance then use it. Each fit gives one result.
desc.zh: 把每条消去规则用于已知：拆解、分类讨论、套用「若…则…」、爆炸、实例框，以及选定一例后再使用。每种相合的用法给出一种结果。

solution: c0 = append[ways="6"](first: c1, second: c2, third: c3, fourth: c4, fifth: c5, sixth: c6)

desc.en: Takes rules: the rule’s first premise is unified with one of the first goal’s hypotheses and its conclusion is added to the hypotheses; each remaining premise becomes a goal, placed first. Given several rules, it uses the first that applies.
desc.zh: 接入规则：规则的第一条前提与第一个目标的一条已知合一，结论加入已知；其余前提各成一个目标，排在前面。接入多条时用第一条适用的。

t.en: Elimination rules look at the givens: a given’s shape says how it can be used. The proof assistant you design becomes a new part, “Use a given”.
t.zh: 消去规则看的是已知：已知是什么结构，就能怎样用它。设计出的证明器会成为新元件「分解假设」。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that applies every matching elimination rule to the givens and keeps every result. Report failure if none applies.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，用所有适用的消去规则处理已知，并保留每种结果。没有规则适用时报告失败。

hint.en: There are six elimination rules: Split, Case analysis, Apply, Explosion, the instance box, choose an instance.
hint.zh: 消去规则有六条：拆解、分类讨论、套用、爆炸、实例框、选定一例。

hint.en: Start each route with the same goal and givens. Bring the results of <part-ref to="lemma:erule"></part-ref> together.
hint.zh: 每种办法都从同一个目标和已知出发。把<part-ref to="lemma:erule"></part-ref>各路的结果接到一起。

t.en: Until now, the rule for each step was chosen by you after looking at the goals. Introduction rules look at the goal: a goal’s shape says which introduction rule made it. The proof assistant you design becomes a new part, “Goal apart”.
t.zh: 到这里，每一步用哪条规则，都是你看过目标后选定的。引入规则看的是目标：目标是什么结构，就是哪条引入规则造出来的。设计出的证明器会成为新元件「分解目标」。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that applies every matching introduction rule backwards and keeps every result. Report failure if none applies.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，用所有适用的引入规则展开目标，并保留每种结果。没有规则适用时报告失败。

hint.en: There are six introduction rules: Join, the assumption box, Add alternative left and right, the for-any box, and Generalise.
hint.zh: 引入规则有六条：拼接、假设框、补充左右两条、任取框、概括。

hint.en: Fan the goal out to all six ways of unpacking it. Set the number of routes on <part-ref to="part:append"></part-ref> and connect each result.
hint.zh: 同一个目标可以分给六种拆法。调整<part-ref to="part:append"></part-ref>的路线数，再把各路结果接进来。

t.en: When two goals share a placeholder, the goal you prove first can settle it. After Generalise and Join backwards, you still need to prove “?t is human” and “?t likes Ann”. Using the <part-ref to="part:logic/assumption"></part-ref> card on the first goal chooses Cy, but “Cy likes Ann” is not a given.
t.zh: 一个 ? 留在两个目标里时，先证哪一个，就由哪一个来定它。逆用<part-ref to="part:exI"></part-ref>和拼接后，还要证「?t 是人」和「?t 喜欢安」。先用<part-ref to="part:logic/assumption"></part-ref>证第一句，会选中茜，可已知里没有「茜喜欢安」。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。

hint.en: Some goals need a given taken apart, some do not.
hint.zh: 有的目标要拆开一条已知，有的不用。

hint.en: Try unpacking a given, then cite it. If no given can be unpacked, the goal continues unchanged.
hint.zh: 先尝试拆解已知，再用「照抄」。没有可拆解的已知时，目标会原样继续。

after.en: A row of parts like this is a proof script, one part to a line.
after.zh: 这样一串元件就是一段证明脚本，每个元件一行。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。

hint.zh: 先拆开能拆的已知。

hint.en: Then split into two cases, and in each choose a side of the “or”.
hint.zh: 再分两种情况，每种情况各选「或者」的一边。

t.zh: 目标和已知毫不相干，已知里却有一对互相矛盾的句子。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。

hint.en: Going backwards, what should the goal become first?
hint.zh: 倒着走，第一步该把目标换成什么？

hint.en: Apply as an elimination rule: which given does it fit?
hint.zh: 套用当消去规则用，对得上哪一条已知？

t.en: <part-ref to="lemma:erule"></part-ref> takes apart more than “and”: any elimination rule can be chosen on it. Case analysis as a rule is \mark{open-bracket}\(A\lor B\); \mark{open-bracket}A\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} C; \mark{open-bracket}B\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} C\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} C.
t.zh: <part-ref to="lemma:erule"></part-ref>不只拆「并且」，元件上能选任何一条消去规则。分类讨论写成规则是 \mark{open-bracket}\(A\lor B\); \mark{open-bracket}A\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} C; \mark{open-bracket}B\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} C\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} C。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。

hint.en: Take the “or” given apart first.
hint.zh: 先拆「或者」那条已知。

hint.en: In each case, which side of the goal is among the givens?
hint.zh: 每种情况里，目标的哪一边在已知里？

t.en: The rules used so far all look at the goal: the conclusion fits it, the premises become new goals. Split as a rule is \mark{open-bracket}\(A\land B\); \mark{open-bracket}A; B\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} C\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} C: its conclusion C fits any goal, but its first premise \(A\land B\) cannot be read off the goal, and becomes a goal made of ?-letters.
t.zh: 到这里用过的规则都看目标：结论对上目标，前提成为新目标。拆解写成规则是 \mark{open-bracket}\(A\land B\); \mark{open-bracket}A; B\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} C\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} C：结论 C 对得上任何目标，第一条前提 \(A\land B\) 却无法从目标读出，成了一个全是 ? 的目标。

t.en: The rules come in at the board’s input Rules; the proof assistant you design becomes a new part, <part-ref to="lemma:erule"></part-ref>, and that input is its port Rules.
t.zh: 规则从板上的「规则」输入接入；设计出的证明器会成为新元件<part-ref to="lemma:erule"></part-ref>，这个输入就是它的「规则」口。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that takes the “and” given apart, turning each goal into the one wanted.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，拆开「并且」那条已知，把每个目标变成要的样子。

hint.en: What can settle a goal made of ?-letters?
hint.zh: 全是 ? 的目标，什么能确定它？

hint.en: After the first backward step, try closing the goal with the <part-ref to="part:logic/assumption"></part-ref> card.
hint.zh: 倒着用规则后，再逆用<part-ref to="part:logic/assumption"></part-ref>试着证完目标。

t.en: <level-ref to="decl-eq"></level-ref> declared equality into the kernel. It can also be defined with a quantifier instead: “a = b” is “every property a has, b has”, written \mark{forall}P. \(P(a)\to P(b)\).
t.zh: <level-ref to="decl-eq"></level-ref>把相等声明进了证明核。也可以不声明，用量词定义它：「a = b」就是「a 有的性质，b 都有」，写成 \mark{forall}P. \(P(a)\to P(b)\)。

t.en: This \mark{forall} ranges over properties: P(x) is a sentence about x. The <part-ref to="part:allI"></part-ref> takes the upper-case P. By this definition, the Morning Star = the Morning Star is this level’s goal.
t.zh: 这里的 \mark{forall} 管的是性质：P(x) 是一句说 x 的话。<part-ref to="part:allI"></part-ref>取大写的 P。按这个定义，晨星 = 晨星 写出来就是这一关的目标。

after.en: The reflexivity a declaration gives is, under the definition, a conclusion proved.
after.zh: 声明给出的自反律，在定义下是一条证出来的结论。

brief.en: From nothing, prove: for every property, if the Morning Star has that property, then the Morning Star has it.
brief.zh: 不用任何已知，证明：对于任意性质，如果晨星具有该性质，那么晨星具有该性质。

hint.en: Take the name P in the for-any box: inside, P is any property at all.
hint.zh: 任取框取的名字选 P：框里 P 是任意一种性质。

hint.en: Inside goes an assumption box whose assumption is just the conclusion it wants.
hint.zh: 框里是一个假设框：它的假设就是它要的结论。

t.en: “Or” can be defined the same way: “A or B” is “for every sentence R, if R follows from A and R follows from B, then R”, written \mark{forall}R. \((A\to R)\to ((B\to R)\to R)\).
t.zh: 「或者」也可以这样定义：「A 或者 B」就是「对任何一句话 R，只要从 A 推得出 R、从 B 也推得出 R，就有 R」，写成 \mark{forall}R. \((A\to R)\to ((B\to R)\to R)\)。

after.en: A declaration gives the intro rules and the elimination rule is made from them; a definition like this writes down the elimination rule, and the intro rules are proved from it. Both roads give the same rules.
after.zh: 声明给出引入规则，由它生成消去规则；这样的定义写下的是消去规则，引入规则要从它证出来。两条路得到的规则一样。

hint.en: A for-any box takes R; inside, the goal has two layers of “if … then …”.
hint.zh: 任取框取 R；框里的目标有两层「若…则…」。

hint.en: The conclusion wanted is C: put C in for R, then hand it the two moves in turn.
hint.zh: 要的结论是 C：把 R 换成 C，再把两个办法依次交给它。

hint.en: Take out the pet that is a cat; it is the example.
hint.zh: 拿出那只是猫的宠物，它就是例子。

premises.t: ∀x. ∀y. ∀z. R(x, y) ∧ R(y, z) → R(x, z)

hint.en: Three \(\forall s\), taken one at a time: x is Ann, y is Bo, z is Cy.
hint.zh: 三个 \mark{forall}，一个一个取：x 是安，y 是博，z 是茜。

brief.en: Given “the Morning Star = Venus” and “Venus = the Evening Star”, prove “the Morning Star = the Evening Star”.
brief.zh: 已知「晨星 = 金星」和「金星 = 昏星」，证明「晨星 = 昏星」。

hint.en: Replace Venus in the first.
hint.zh: 把第一句里的金星换掉。

t.en: <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref> puts a thing in for x. If what goes in is the variable y and x sits inside an “\(\exists y\)”, that y is caught by the quantifier (<wiki-ref to="capture"></wiki-ref>), and the meaning changes completely: putting y in for x in “everything likes something” seems to give “something likes itself”.
t.zh: <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref>把 x 换成一样东西。要是换进去的是变量 y，而 x 恰好在一个「\(\exists y\)」里面，这个 y 就被那个量词抓走（<wiki-ref to="capture"></wiki-ref>），意思全变了：在「每样东西都喜欢某样东西」里把 x 换成 y，好像得到「有一样东西喜欢自己」。

after.en: So the quantifier’s variable is renamed before substituting; the prover’s <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref> does this by itself.
after.zh: 所以代入前要先给量词的变量改名；证明器的<part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref>会自动这样做。

say.en: Everything likes something, so something likes itself.
say.zh: 每样东西都喜欢某样东西，所以有一样东西喜欢自己。

brief.en: Here is a lemma someone wrote for the reasoning above. Build a counterexample: every premise holds and the goal fails.
brief.zh: 这是别人照上面这段推理写的引理。造一个反例：前提都成立，结论不成立。

hint.en: Two things that like each other and not themselves.
hint.zh: 两样东西，互相喜欢，都不喜欢自己。
