why: 消除重名并修订推理词条

ops.value: 从已知出发推出新的句子，叫正向推理。这些句子可以用于后续证明。则从待证目标出发。
Deriving new statements from givens is called forward reasoning. Those statements can be used later in a proof. starts from a goal instead.
从目标出发倒着用规则，叫反向推理：把目标对上规则的结论，目标便换成规则的前提。对上没有前提的规则，目标就证完了。
Using a rule backwards from a goal is backward reasoning: match the goal to the rule’s conclusion and replace it with the rule’s premises. A matching rule with no premises finishes the goal.

value.en: Using rules backwards from the goal is backward reasoning: the goal is fitted to the rule’s conclusion (working out which sentences the rule’s letters A and B are; this step is called unification), and the goal is replaced by the rule’s premises, a new goal for each. A rule with no premises that fits finishes the goal. Proof assistants’ apply and rule use rules this way.
value.zh: 从目标出发倒着用规则，叫反向推理：把目标对上规则的结论，目标便换成规则的前提。对上没有前提的规则，目标就证完了。

value.en: Using rules backwards from the goal is backward reasoning: the goal is fitted to the rule’s conclusion (working out which sentences the rule’s letters A and B are; this step is called unification), and the goal is replaced by the rule’s premises, a new goal for each. A rule with no premises that fits finishes the goal. Proof assistants’ apply and rule use rules this way.
value.zh: 从目标出发倒着用规则，叫反向推理：把目标对上规则的结论（求出规则里的字母 A、B 各是哪一句，这一步叫合一），目标就换成规则的前提，每条前提一个新目标。没有前提的规则对上了，目标就证完了。证明器里的 apply、rule 都是这样用规则的。

value.en: Reasoning onwards from what is known is forward reasoning: a rule’s first premise fits a given, and its conclusion joins the givens. Unlike , it does not look at the goal. Some rules only go backwards (), some only forwards (): it depends on which side carries the bound variable when unifying.
value.zh: 从已知出发推出新的句子，叫正向推理。这些句子可以用于后续证明。则从待证目标出发。

body.en: Isabelle’s Isar (Wenzel, from 1999) writes proofs as text for people, a structured proof: have proves a sentence on the way, show the one wanted, assume, fix and obtain bring in an assumption, an arbitrary thing and a thing taken out, and proof … qed is a block. The method after each by does one small step, and the system checks every row. Lean writes much the same: have h : A := by …, show B, intro, obtain ⟨x, h⟩ := …, and calc for a chain of equations.
body.zh: Isabelle 的 Isar（Wenzel，1999 年起）把证明写成给人读的文本，叫结构化证明：have 先证一句，show 证出要证的那句，assume、fix、obtain 开出假设、任取的东西和拿出来的东西，proof … qed 是一块。每一句后面 by 的那个方法只负责一小步，系统检查每一句。Lean 的写法相近：have h : A := by …，show B，intro，obtain ⟨x, h⟩ := …，再加上把一串等式连起来的 calc。

body.en: A script, a proof term and a proof circuit are one proof: each row a part, each block a box. Large formalisations (the four colour theorem, the Kepler conjecture, the libraries mathlib and the AFP) are written this way: people write the structure and the lemmas, automation fills in the small steps.
body.zh: 脚本和证明项、证明电路是同一个证明：每一行是一个元件，块是框。大型的形式化（四色定理、开普勒猜想、数学库 mathlib 和 AFP）都是这样写成的：人写结构和引理，自动化补中间的小步。

body.en: LCF (Milner, from 1972) set a design: a theorem is an abstract type only the kernel can make, and tactics are ordinary programs that make theorems only by calling the kernel’s rules. So however intricate a or clever the automation, none of it need be trusted, only the kernel. To write tactics Milner invented the language ML. Isabelle, HOL4 and HOL Light all descend from it.
body.zh: LCF（Milner，1972 年起）定下了一个设计：定理是一种只有核能造的抽象类型，策略是普通的程序，只能调核的规则来造定理。所以再复杂、自动化再聪明，都不必可信，只要核可信。为了写策略，Milner 还发明了 ML 语言。Isabelle、HOL4、HOL Light 都是它的后代。

body.en: Following one path to its end (done, or stuck) before going back for the next is depth-first search. It saves space, remembering only the current path; the price is that it may follow an endless path forever. So automatic tactics often bound the depth, or deepen it a level at a time.
body.zh: 把一条路走到头（证完，或者做不下去）再退回来换下一条，叫深度优先搜索。它省地方，只记着眼下这一条路；代价是可能顺着一条没有尽头的路一直走下去。所以自动的策略常常限制深度，或者一层层加深再搜。

body.en: A tactic is a program that turns a into new ones. It can only change it a rule at a time, so however intricate tactics get, what they prove goes through the kernel. Isabelle’s auto and Lean’s simp and omega are tactics.
body.zh: 策略是把一个变成新证明状态的程序。它只能用规则一步步地变，所以策略组合得再复杂，证出的东西都经过核。Isabelle 的 auto、Lean 的 simp、omega 都是策略。

body.en: Tactics can be combined: run them in sequence or repeatedly, or let later steps work on candidate results.
body.zh: 策略可以组合：依次运行、重复运行，或让后续步骤处理候选结果。

body.en: When a step can go several ways, keep every one, and when stuck go back to the latest place with another choice and take the next: this is backtracking. each tactic in Isabelle gives a run of results that the tactics after it try one by one; Prolog is the same proof assistant, where the order rules are written in and which subgoal is asked first decide whether the search stops.
body.zh: 一步有几种走法时，把每一种都留着，走错了就退回最近一个还有别的选择的地方，换下一种：这叫回溯。Isabelle 的策略给出的是一串结果，后面的策略对每一种都试；Prolog 也是这个证明器：规则写的次序、子目标先问哪个，决定了搜索停不停得下来。

body.en: A solution of is a unifier. The most general unifier settles only what must be settled and leaves every other metavariable open; every other unifier can be had from it by substituting further. When first-order unification has a solution it has a most general one, unique up to renaming.
body.zh: 的解叫合一子。最一般合一子只定下非定不可的部分，别的元变量都留着；任何别的合一子都能从它再往下代得到。一阶合一有解，就有最一般的那一个，而且只有一个（不计改名）。

body.en: Isabelle (Paulson, from 1986) takes the LCF road: a theorem is an abstract type thm, and only a few functions in the kernel (one per rule of inference) can make one, with no proof term to keep. Its most used logic, HOL, is classical higher-order logic. Rules are written \mark{open-bracket}premises\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} conclusion, each in them filled in by unification, and tactics and the simplifier put rules together to use them automatically; sledgehammer calls on outside automatic provers.
body.zh: Isabelle（Paulson，1986 年起）走 LCF 的路：定理是一种抽象类型 thm，只有核里的几个函数（每条推理规则一个）能造出 thm，不必留下证明项。它最常用的逻辑 HOL 是经典的高阶逻辑。规则写成带的 \mark{open-bracket}前提\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} 结论，由合一来填，再由策略和化简器把规则组合起来自动地用；sledgehammer 请外面的自动证明器帮忙。

body.en: Unification solves equations \(s\doteq t\): it finds what to put in for each so that both sides become the same. First-order unification is solved by a few rules (Martelli and Montanari’s form: decompose, delete, clash, swap, occurs check, eliminate). Robinson invented it in 1965 for resolution proofs; it became the heart of Prolog, type inference and proof assistants.
body.zh: 合一是解等式 \(s\doteq t\)：给找一组替换，让两边变得一模一样。一阶的合一由几条规则解到底（Martelli 和 Montanari 的写法：分解、删除、冲突、定向、出现检查、消元）。合一在 1965 年由 Robinson 为归结证明发明，后来成了 Prolog、类型推导和证明器的心脏。

body.en: The letters of a rule stand for any sentence. When a rule is used backwards those letters are not yet settled; they are metavariables, written ?A and ?B, with ?t for any thing and ?P(x) for any sentence about x. Unification fills them in. Isabelle also writes the letters of a proved theorem as ?A (in its metalogic Pure, \mark{entails} is “yields” and \mark{meta-all} “for any”); the holes ?m Lean’s apply leaves are metavariables too.
body.zh: 规则里的字母代表任何一句话。倒着用规则时，这些字母还没有定下来，叫元变量，写作 ?A、?B；?t 是任何一样东西，?P(x) 是任何一句关于 x 的话。元变量由合一填上。Isabelle 证完一条定理后，也把其中的字母写成 ?A（它的元逻辑 Pure 里，\mark{entails} 是「推出」，\mark{meta-all} 是「对任何」）；Lean 的 apply 留下的空位 ?m 也是元变量。

body.en: Lean (de Moura, from 2013) is built on dependent type theory. Every proof written ends up as a proof term, and the kernel checks that its type is the sentence to prove. The terms are kept, so anyone can recheck them with another checker: the de Bruijn criterion. Lean’s logic is intuitionistic at heart, classical reasoning coming from the axiom Classical.em; the mathematics library mathlib is written in it.
body.zh: Lean（de Moura，2013 年起）基于依赖类型论。写下的每个证明最后都变成一个证明项，核检查它的类型是不是要证的那句话。项留着，谁都可以拿另一个检查器复查，这叫 de Bruijn 准则。Lean 的逻辑本身是直觉主义的，经典推理靠公理 Classical.em；数学库 mathlib 是用它写成的。

body.en: Using a rule backwards from a goal is backward reasoning: match the goal to the rule’s conclusion and replace it with the rule’s premises. A matching rule with no premises finishes the goal.
body.zh: 从目标出发倒着用规则，叫反向推理：把目标对上规则的结论，目标便换成规则的前提。对上没有前提的规则，目标就证完了。

body.en: The goals still open, each with what it has to work from, are the proof state. A proof starts with a single goal, every rule used changes the state, and when no goal is left it is done. In Isabelle a proof state is itself a theorem \mark{open-bracket}subgoals\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} goal, one premise fewer for each subgoal proved; in Lean it is a set of metavariables still to fill.
body.zh: 还没证完的目标，连同每个目标手里的已知，叫证明状态。证明从「只有一个目标」开始，每用一次规则，状态就变一次，目标都没了就证完了。Isabelle 的证明状态本身就是一条定理 \mark{open-bracket}子目标\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} 目标，证完一个子目标就少一个前提；Lean 的证明状态是一组还没填的元变量。

body.en: A proof assistant is a program in which a person and the machine write proofs together, every step checked by the machine. Each has a small : only the kernel can declare a theorem proved, and however clever the automation around it, everything goes through the kernel, so it cannot make a false theorem.
body.zh: 证明器是让人和机器一起写证明、由机器逐步检查的程序。它们都有一个很小的：只有核能认定一条定理成立，其余的自动化无论多聪明，最后都要经过核，所以造不出假定理。

body.en: This game’s prover is built that way from its first part: a kernel of a few rules, and lemmas proved with them. It borrows only proof assistants’ way of building a kernel and its parts; its own parts and notation are fitted to the game.
body.zh: 这个游戏的证明器从第一块元件起，就按这个思路搭：核只有几条规则，引理都是用规则证出来的。它只借证明器搭核、搭元件的思路，自己的元件和写法都按游戏的需要来定。

why: Open two entries where the levels and entries that link them can already reach them

body.en: When an inductive type is declared, Lean’s kernel checks its constructors (its s) and then makes its recursor, its : one case for each constructor, the constructor’s type with its conclusion put as any motive (R here). And.rec, Or.rec and False.rec come of it so; Isabelle’s conjE and disjE have the same shape. A recursor also comes with a rule of computation: met with a constructor, it computes on (ι-reduction).
body.zh: 声明一种归纳类型时，Lean 的内核检查过它的构造子（），就生成它的递推子，也就是它的：每个构造子一个情况，那个构造子的类型把结论换成任意的 motive（这里的 R）。And.rec、Or.rec、False.rec 都是这样来的；Isabelle 的 conjE、disjE 是同样的形状。递推子还带一条计算规则：它遇到构造子就算下去（ι 规约）。

body.en: Why the elimination rule can only be so: a declaration says “these are the only ways”, and the elimination rule writes that as a rule. It gives no more (introduce, then eliminate, is a detour that can always be taken out: what the rule hands back is what was handed in), and no less (take apart and put together, and the sentence is back). Proof theory calls this the harmony of introduction and elimination. If elimination rules could simply be written, one could write Prior’s tonk: introduced as “or”, eliminated as “and”, proving anything at all.
body.zh: 消去规则为什么只能是这个样子：声明说的是「只有这几条来路」，消去规则把这句话写成规则。它不多给（先引入、再消去的弯路总能拆掉：消去规则还回的，正是引入时交进去的），也不少给（拆开再拼起，拿回原来那句）。证明论把这叫引入规则和消去规则的和谐。消去规则要是能随手写，就能写出 Prior 的 tonk：引入照「或者」，消去照「并且」，什么都证得出。

body.en: A proposition false on every row of a classical truth table is a contradiction, for example “\(\text{it rains}\land \lnot \text{it rains}\)”. The prover uses \mark{bottom} as a distinguished false proposition; a contradictory formula is not necessarily syntactically identical to \mark{bottom}.
body.zh: 在经典真值表的每一行都为假的命题称为矛盾式，例如「\(\text{下雨}\land \lnot \text{下雨}\)」。证明器中的 \mark{bottom} 是一个表示矛盾的特殊命题；不能把任意矛盾式都当作与 \mark{bottom} 语法相同。

body.en: In this prover, \(\lnot A\) is defined as \(A\to \bot\). To prove \(\lnot A\), one can assume A and derive \mark{bottom}.
body.zh: 在本证明器中，\(\lnot A\) 定义为 \(A\to \bot\)。因此，证明 \(\lnot A\) 可以通过假设 A 并从中推出 \mark{bottom} 完成。

why: Remove eleven levels that are in no chapter, and the data only they used

t.en: Givens lead into givens: how many times Apply is used backwards, and which given each time, is not known beforehand. The repeat frame follows only the first result, and stops in a dead end.
t.zh: 已知一条接一条，要倒着套用几次、每次选哪条已知，事先都不知道。重复框只顺着第一种结果走，进了死胡同就停下。

t.en: A new part, <part-ref to="part:search"></part-ref>: the parts inside take a step, and each result is stepped on again; one path is followed to its end (done, or stuck) before going back for the next. This is <wiki-ref to="dfs"></wiki-ref>. It gives every finished state it finds.
t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:search"></part-ref>：框里的元件做一步，得到的每一种结果再接着做；一条路走到头（证完，或者做不下去），再退回来换下一条。这叫<wiki-ref to="dfs"></wiki-ref>。它送出找到的每一个证完的状态。

after.en: This is a simple proof assistant: three kinds of step and a backtracking search. Every proof it finds uses only the kernel’s rules, so it is just as trustworthy. There is also what it cannot do: when a given has another “if” inside it (like “\(\text{it rains}\to (\text{it’s windy}\to \text{it’s wet})\)”, which Swap needs), Apply used backwards once does not reach the goal. And it only knows “if … then …”: next the kernel learns new connectives, and the proof assistant will learn to use them too.
after.zh: 这就是一台简单的证明器：三种步骤，加上回溯搜索。它找到的每个证明都只用了证明核的规则，所以照样可信。它也有做不到的：已知里还套着「若」时（像交换要用的「\(\text{下雨}\to (\text{刮风}\to \text{地湿})\)」），倒着套用一次对不上目标。而且它只认识「若…则…」：接下来证明核要认识新的连接词，证明器也会跟着学会用它们。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。

hint.en: What can each step do?
hint.zh: 每一步有哪几种做法？

hint.en: How many steps is the search’s business.
hint.zh: 走几步，交给搜索。

hint.en: If the search does not stop, look for the step that leaves an ?A unsettled, and for what could settle it at once.
hint.zh: 搜索停不下来时，看看哪一步留下了没定下来的 ?A，又是什么能马上定下它。

solution: c1 = append[ways="3"](first: c2, second: c3, third: c4)
naive: c1 = append[ways="3"](first: c2, second: c3, third: c4)

t.en: In the first case, two givens can help prove “it’s slippery”. Using “if it rains, it’s slippery” leaves “it rains” to prove, and this route gets stuck. The other case offers a similar choice.
t.zh: 第一个案例里，两条已知都能帮助证明「路滑」。先用「\(\text{下雨}\to \text{路滑}\)」会留下「下雨」要证，可这条路走不通。另一个案例也有同样的选择。

t.en: From here on, <part-ref to="part:rule"></part-ref> keeps every matching result. With the <part-ref to="part:logic/assumption"></part-ref> card, each matching given gives a route to continue. Later steps show which routes can finish.
t.zh: 从这一关起，<part-ref to="part:rule"></part-ref>保留所有对得上的结果。用<part-ref to="part:logic/assumption"></part-ref>时，每条匹配的已知都可以继续走，后续步骤会检验哪些路线能走完。

after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="backtracking"></wiki-ref>.
after.zh: 这叫<wiki-ref to="backtracking"></wiki-ref>。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。

hint.en: The wiring can stay the same. Use Apply backwards once, then use the <part-ref to="part:logic/assumption"></part-ref> card twice.
hint.zh: 接法不用变。先倒着用一次套用规则，再用两次<part-ref to="part:logic/assumption"></part-ref>。

t.en: So far a proof assistant’s parts have run in a fixed order, fit for goals of one structure; change the nesting and it must be rewired. A program that chooses and combines steps by the proof state is a <wiki-ref to="tactic"></wiki-ref>. Isabelle’s auto and Lean’s simp are tactics.
t.zh: 到这里，证明器的元件按固定顺序连接，只对一种结构的目标有效；嵌套层数一变，就得重新连线。按证明状态选择、组合步骤的程序叫<wiki-ref to="tactic"></wiki-ref>。Isabelle 的 auto、Lean 的 simp 都是策略。

t.en: The new <part-ref to="part:repeat"></part-ref> runs the parts inside again on each result, until the result stops changing or the goal is proved.
t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:repeat"></part-ref>：框里的元件做一圈，把结果送回框内继续做，直到结果不再变化或目标已经证完。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。

hint.en: How many levels of “if … then …” there are is not known beforehand.
hint.zh: 「若…则…」有几层，事先不知道。

t.en: A goal can be worth approaching in two ways. For an “if … then …” goal, take the condition as given. You can also work backwards from the conclusion to see which given helps. Fan the goal out to both routes, then bring their results into <part-ref to="part:append"></part-ref>.
t.zh: 同一个目标有时值得试两种做法。遇到「若…则…」，先把条件当作已知。也可以从要证的结论倒推，看看手头哪条已知用得上。把目标分线给两种做法，再用<part-ref to="part:append"></part-ref>接回它们的结果。

after.en: A tactic can only call the kernel’s rules, so however it is combined it cannot make a false theorem: the design of <wiki-ref to="lcf"></wiki-ref>.
after.zh: 策略只能调用核的规则，组合得再复杂，也造不出假定理：这是<wiki-ref to="lcf"></wiki-ref>的设计。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。

hint.en: The first step depends on the goal’s shape.
hint.zh: 第一步取决于目标的结构。

hint.en: Apply backwards can match any goal with its conclusion B. Think about which route uses the shape of the goal.
hint.zh: 倒着用套用时，结论 B 对得上任何目标。先看看哪条路能利用目标的结构。

t.en: This time goals nest level within level: some need several “if”s peeled off, some then need Apply used backwards a few times, in a different order each time.
t.zh: 这一回目标层层嵌套：有的要先剥掉几层「若」，有的还要倒着套用几次已知，次序各不相同。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。

hint.en: What kinds of goal must each round handle?
hint.zh: 每一圈要应付哪几种目标？

hint.en: Fan the same goal out to three routes on each round, then bring their results together.
hint.zh: 让每一轮的同一个目标分到三条路，再把三路结果接回去。

solution: c1 = append[ways="3"](first: c2, second: c3, third: c4)

t.en: A part only works on the first goal, so when several goals need the same done, the same parts would be wired several times. A new part, <part-ref to="part:each"></part-ref>: the parts inside run once on each goal, seeing only that goal each time.
t.zh: 元件只处理第一个目标，几个目标要做同样的事时，同样的元件得接几遍。新元件<part-ref to="part:each"></part-ref>：框里的元件对每个目标各做一遍，每次只看那一个目标。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal using at most 4 parts.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，用最多 4 个元件证完所有目标。

hint.en: The two goals after the join need the same thing done.
hint.zh: 拼成以后的两个目标，要做的是同一件事。

t.en: Join has two premises: used backwards, it turns one goal into two, in a row. A part always works on the first goal; when it is proved, the next moves up.
t.zh: 拼接有两条前提，倒着用它，一个目标变成两个，排成一列。元件总是处理第一个目标；证完一个，下一个顶上来。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。

hint.en: Are the two halves of the “and” each among the givens?
hint.zh: 「并且」的两半，各自在已知里吗？

t.en: Earlier, you connected rules starting from the givens. A proof assistant works the other way, from the goal back: <wiki-ref to="backward"></wiki-ref>. A new part, <part-ref to="part:rule"></part-ref>: wire a rule into its port “R”; it fits the first goal to the rule’s conclusion and replaces that goal with the rule’s premises, one new goal for each. Each part used in a proof has a corresponding part here that supplies its rule, and several rule parts can be chained into one list.
t.zh: 之前，你从已知出发连接规则。证明器反过来，从目标往回走，这叫<wiki-ref to="backward"></wiki-ref>。新元件<part-ref to="part:rule"></part-ref>：从「R」口接入一条规则，它把第一个目标对上规则的结论，再把这个目标换成规则的前提，每条前提一个新目标。之前用来证明的每个元件，在这里都对应一个给出相应规则的元件；几个规则元件可以串起来接入。

t.en: Recall the assumption box rule “\(\llbracket \llbracket A\rrbracket \Longrightarrow B\rrbracket \Longrightarrow A\to B\)”. Its conclusion matches an “if” goal. When a rule is used backwards, its letters are not yet settled and are written ?A and ?B. Used backwards, this rule replaces that goal with “assume ?A and prove ?B”. The wires carry a <wiki-ref to="proof-state"></wiki-ref>, the goals that remain to be proved.
t.zh: 还记得假设框的规则吗？「\(\llbracket \llbracket A\rrbracket \Longrightarrow B\rrbracket \Longrightarrow A\to B\)」的结论能和形如「若…则…」的目标对上。倒着用规则时，规则里的字母还没有定下来，写作 ?A、?B。倒着用它，就把目标换成「多一条假设 ?A，证出 ?B」。线上传的是<wiki-ref to="proof-state"></wiki-ref>，也就是尚未证完的目标。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that turns each goal into the one wanted.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，把每个目标变成要的样子。

hint.en: The three goals are all “if … then …”. Which of the kernel’s rules makes an “if … then …”?
hint.zh: 三个目标都是「若…则…」。证明核里，哪条规则造出「若…则…」？

t.en: Apply as a rule is \mark{open-bracket}\(A\to B\); A\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} B. Its conclusion B fits the goal “it’s wet”, but A cannot be read off the goal, and is left as ?A in both new goals. Whatever settles ?A later settles it in both.
t.zh: 套用写成规则是 \mark{open-bracket}\(A\to B\); A\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} B。结论 B 对上目标「地湿」，A 却无法从目标读出，在两个新目标里留作 ?A。之后什么确定了 ?A，两个目标里的 ?A 就一起确定。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。

hint.en: Use Apply backwards. Leave ?A open for a given to settle.
hint.zh: 倒着用套用。?A 先留着，交给已知去定。

t.en: A lemma you proved is itself a rule: <part-ref to="lemma:chain"></part-ref> is \mark{open-bracket}\(A\to B\); \(B\to C\)\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} \(A\to C\). It can be used backwards just like the kernel’s rules, and the part offers it too.
t.zh: 证出的引理本身就是一条规则：<part-ref to="lemma:chain"></part-ref>是 \mark{open-bracket}\(A\to B\); \(B\to C\)\mark{close-bracket} \mark{entails} \(A\to C\)。它和证明核的规则一样能倒着用，元件上都能选到。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal with <part-ref to="lemma:chain"></part-ref>.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，用<part-ref to="lemma:chain"></part-ref>证完所有目标。

hint.en: The middle sentence of <part-ref to="lemma:chain"></part-ref> cannot be read off the goal.
hint.zh: 目标里读不出<part-ref to="lemma:chain"></part-ref>的中间那一句。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal with <part-ref to="lemma:swap"></part-ref>.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，用<part-ref to="lemma:swap"></part-ref>证完所有目标。

hint.en: <part-ref to="lemma:swap"></part-ref> has one premise.
hint.zh: <part-ref to="lemma:swap"></part-ref>只有一条前提。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal with <part-ref to="lemma:merge"></part-ref>.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，用<part-ref to="lemma:merge"></part-ref>证完所有目标。

hint.en: Once <part-ref to="lemma:merge"></part-ref>’s conclusion fits the goal, what is left to prove?
hint.zh: <part-ref to="lemma:merge"></part-ref>的结论对上目标以后，还剩什么要证？

t.en: Use the assumption box backwards and one “if” comes off the goal. Its condition becomes a given. Sometimes the goal that remains is already one of those givens.
t.zh: 倒着用假设框，目标少了一层「若」，它的条件也成了已知。最后剩下的目标，有时已经在已知里。

t.en: Connect the <part-ref to="part:logic/assumption"></part-ref> card to <part-ref to="part:rule"></part-ref>. If the goal matches a current given, it is proved. The card reads Γ, \(A\vdash A\), where Γ stands for the other givens.
t.zh: 把<part-ref to="part:logic/assumption"></part-ref>接给<part-ref to="part:rule"></part-ref>。在当前已知里对上一句，就能证完这个目标。卡面写作 Γ, \(A\vdash A\)，其中 Γ 代表其余的已知。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。

hint.en: With every “if” peeled off, where is the goal that is left?
hint.zh: 剥掉所有的「若」之后，剩下的目标在哪里？

desc.en: The frame receives the input; its inner output goes to “Result” and back into the frame, round after round, until it stops changing, and the last round’s result is given. If a round fails, it stops at the round before. With several results, it goes on from the first only.
desc.zh: 框收到输入，框内的输出接到「结果」后再送回框内，逐轮重复，直到结果不再变化，输出最后一轮的结果；某一轮失败时，停在失败前的一轮。有几种结果时，只沿第一种继续。

desc.en: Keep every result that can still proceed, in route order, for later steps to check.
desc.zh: 按路线编号收集所有还走得通的结果，让后续步骤继续验证。

why: Address the QED chapters five to eight copy review

value.en: Design a proof assistant that proves the goals that follow and reports failure for the rest.

value.zh: 逆用<part-ref to="part:exI"></part-ref>时，运行结果里的 ?t 是未定的字母，代表一样还没定下来的东西；它可以在后续证明中确定。
value.en: Working backwards with <part-ref to="part:exI"></part-ref> leaves an undetermined letter, written ?t in the result, standing for a thing not yet fixed. It can be determined later in the proof.

value.zh: 对照各案例中已知的排列，观察目标两半分别与哪些已知有关。
value.en: Compare the arrangement of givens in each case with the two halves of the goal.

value.zh: <level-ref to="r-allI"></level-ref>中出现了新名字，<level-ref to="r-exI"></level-ref>中出现了未定的字母。这次两者都在证明器的运行中出现。
value.en: A new name appeared in <level-ref to="r-allI"></level-ref>, and an undetermined letter in <level-ref to="r-exI"></level-ref>. Both appear as the proof assistant runs here.

value.zh: 在<level-ref to="r-exE"></level-ref>，证明器处理了存在的已知。这次已知说的是所有东西，目标说的是某一样具体的东西。
value.en: In <level-ref to="r-exE"></level-ref>, the proof assistant handled an existential given. Here a given concerns every thing, while the goal concerns one particular thing.

value.zh: 观察运行结果：照抄作用在哪个目标上？
value.en: Watch the result: which goal does copying a given address?

value.zh: <part-ref to="part:rewrite"></part-ref>可以在目标或已知中替换相等的东西。
value.en: <part-ref to="part:rewrite"></part-ref> can replace equal things in a goal or a given.

value.zh: <part-ref to="part:append"></part-ref>汇合路线。这一关里几路可继续的结果都会留下，供后续步骤使用。
value.en: <part-ref to="part:append"></part-ref> joins routes. Here, the results that can continue are retained from each route for later steps.

value.zh: 观察汇合处：各案例留下了几个可以继续的结果？
value.en: At the join, how many results can continue in each case?

value.zh: <part-ref to="part:repeat"></part-ref>反复运行框内元件，直到结果不再变化；某轮失败时返回失败前的结果。这是一种<wiki-ref to="tactic"></wiki-ref>。
value.en: <part-ref to="part:repeat"></part-ref> runs its contents until the result stops changing; if a round fails, it returns the result from before that round. This is a <wiki-ref to="tactic"></wiki-ref>.

value.zh: <level-ref to="s-append"></level-ref>让路线汇合。这次各案例中与已知相同的句子藏在目标不同的深浅和位置，能放的元件数量也有限。<part-ref to="part:search"></part-ref>可以探索多条路线。
value.en: In <level-ref to="s-append"></level-ref>, routes came together. Here the sentence matching a given is at different depths and positions in each goal, and the number of parts is limited. <part-ref to="part:search"></part-ref> can explore several routes.

value.zh: <level-ref to="s-explore"></level-ref>让证明器探索多条路线。现在案例里有不同形状的目标和已知，有些案例预期证不出。搭建的证明器将成为<part-ref to="lemma:auto"></part-ref>。
value.en: In <level-ref to="s-explore"></level-ref>, the proof assistant explored several routes. These cases have goals and givens of different shapes, and some are expected to fail. The resulting proof assistant becomes <part-ref to="lemma:auto"></part-ref>.

value.zh: 观察第二组目标的条件部分：里面有哪些句子形式？
value.en: Look at the conditions in the second set of goals: what sentence forms occur there?

value.zh: <level-ref to="s-auto"></level-ref>的证明器能报告证不出的案例。这次年长关系的规则可能一直用下去；有些目标能推出，有些不能。
value.en: The proof assistant in <level-ref to="s-auto"></level-ref> could report cases it could not prove. Here a rule about age can keep applying; some goals follow and others do not.

value.zh: 不限层数时，运行结果给出了什么提示？
value.en: What does the result say when the number of layers is unlimited?

value.zh: 两种表示相等的做法给出同样的规则。
value.en: The two ways of representing equality give the same rules.

value.zh: 证不出来时，试着造一个反例，往往比硬证更快。
value.en: When a proof does not work, trying a counterexample can be quicker than forcing it.

value.zh: 句子里的「才」连接哪两部分？
value.en: Which two parts does “only if” connect?

value.zh: 想一想，只有一样东西的世界里，这句话对人和非人分别说了什么？
value.en: In a world with one thing, what does the sentence say if it is human? What if it is not?

value.zh: 这份译文与原句分别允许什么样的人？
value.en: What kinds of people do the translation and the original sentence allow?

value.zh: 这句话要求世界里有什么？那样东西需要满足哪些条件？
value.en: What does the sentence require in the world, and what must that thing satisfy?

value.zh: 苏格拉底这个名字一定指一个人吗？
value.en: Must the name Socrates refer to a human?

value.zh: 谁的父母？句子里提到了几样东西？
value.en: Whose parent is involved? How many things does the sentence mention?

value.zh: 在小世界里试试不同的喜欢关系，两句话的真假怎样变化？
value.en: Try different liking relations in a small world. How do the two sentences change in truth?
Which part of “only if” is the condition?

value.zh: 观察前提在你造的世界里是真是假。
value.en: Check whether the premise is true in the world you built.

value.zh: 观察前提中两个存在量词分别说了什么。
value.en: Look at what each existential quantifier in the premise says.

value.zh: 族谱中，父母关系的两个位置各指谁？
value.en: In the family tree, who occupies each position in the parent relation?

value.zh: 族谱里隔两代的关系经过谁？
value.en: Who lies between two generations in the family tree?

value.zh: 这句话对孩子的数量和上学情况分别有什么要求？
value.en: What does the sentence require about children and about school attendance?

value.zh: 框内的名字在框外有什么限制？
value.en: What restrictions apply to the name inside the box outside it?

value.zh: 已知里哪一句谈到具体的东西，目标又说了什么？
value.en: Which given concerns a particular thing, and what does the goal say?

value.zh: 观察实例框内提供了什么，以及目标要求什么。
value.en: Look at what the witness box provides and what the goal asks for.

value.zh: 引入规则中的任取名字与前提之间有什么关系？
value.en: How is the arbitrary name related to the premise in the introduction rule?

value.zh: 改写元件框出了等式中的哪些位置？
value.en: Which positions in the equality does the rewrite part highlight?

value.zh: 目标两边的名字与已知中的名字如何对应？
value.en: How do the names in the goal correspond to those in the given?

value.zh: 三个性质在前提和结论中分别出现在哪里？
value.en: Where do the three properties occur in the premises and conclusion?

value.zh: 三个前提分别谈到婴儿、讲道理、受尊重和驯鳄鱼之间的什么关系？
value.en: What relations do the three premises state between babies, reason, respect and taming crocodiles?

value.zh: 哪些前提谈到受尊重？它们之间有什么区别？
value.en: Which premises mention respect, and how do they differ?

value.zh: 在不同的小世界里，看看每样东西喜欢谁。
value.en: In different small worlds, look at whom each thing likes.

value.zh: 目标和已知中的量词各管哪些名字？
value.en: Which names are governed by the quantifiers in the goal and the given?

value.zh: 已知中的 x 与 s(x) 有什么关系？
value.en: What relation does the given state between x and s(x)?

value.zh: 已知里的 s(x) 不是一句话，而是由 x 算出的一样东西，可以读作「x 的下一个」。像 s 这样的记号叫函数符号。这次目标要求找到一个例子。
value.en: In the given, s(x) is not a sentence but a thing determined by x, read as “the next after x”. A symbol like s is called a function symbol. The goal asks for an example.

t.zh: 我们已经用量词描述过各种关系。这里有几句日常说法，要仔细区分它们各自说了什么。
t.en: We have used quantifiers to describe relations. These everyday sentences ask us to distinguish what each one says.

t.zh: 在<level-ref to="m-counter"></level-ref>，我们用世界检验过一段推理。这次推理涉及对所有东西的条件。
t.en: In <level-ref to="m-counter"></level-ref>, we tested an argument with a world. This argument involves conditions about all things.

t.zh: 在<level-ref to="p-split"></level-ref>，我们检验了含量词的推理。这次前提谈到存在的东西。
t.en: In <level-ref to="p-split"></level-ref>, we tested an argument with quantifiers. Here the premise concerns things that exist.

t.zh: 在<level-ref to="q-children"></level-ref>，我们查询了孩子。这次族谱的问题隔了两代。
t.en: In <level-ref to="q-children"></level-ref>, we queried children. This family-tree question spans two generations.

t.zh: 在<level-ref to="q-grand"></level-ref>，我们查询了族谱中的关系。这次要找孩子上学的人。
t.en: In <level-ref to="q-grand"></level-ref>, we queried family relations. Now we seek people whose children attend school.

t.zh: 在<level-ref to="q-exE"></level-ref>，取出的一样东西用了一个临时名字。这次有人声称它就是一个点名的东西。
t.en: In <level-ref to="q-exE"></level-ref>, a temporary name stood for a thing taken from an existential statement. Here someone claims it is a particular named thing.

t.zh: 在<level-ref to="q-eq"></level-ref>，两个名字指同一样东西。这次等式两边的名字交换了位置。
t.en: In <level-ref to="q-eq"></level-ref>, two names referred to the same thing. Here the names on the two sides of the equality have swapped places.

t.zh: 量词的次序会影响句子的意思。这里先检验一段推理，再证明另一个方向。
t.en: The order of quantifiers affects a sentence’s meaning. Here we test one argument and then prove the other direction.

value.en: In the given, s(x) is not a sentence but a thing worked out from x: read it as “the one after x”. A sign like s is a function symbol.
value.zh: 已知里的 s(x) 不是一句话，而是由 x 算出的一样东西，可以读作「x 的下一个」。像 s 这样的记号叫函数符号。

value.en: What relation does the given state between a and s(a)?
value.zh: 已知里的 s(a) 与 a 之间有什么关系？

value.en: Take any b; take out the one who likes everything and call them a; take b from what holds of a, then use a as the example.
value.zh: 任取一个 b；再拿出那个喜欢一切的人，叫他 a；从关于 a 的那句里取 b，再拿 a 举例。

value.en: Baby \mark{implies} illogical \mark{implies} not respected; tames crocodiles \mark{implies} respected: they clash.
value.zh: 婴儿 \mark{implies} 不讲道理 \mark{implies} 不受尊重；驯得了鳄鱼 \mark{implies} 受尊重：撞上了。

value.en: Take any a and assume it is a baby; to prove “\(\lnot a\) can tame a crocodile”, assume it can, and reach a contradiction.
value.zh: 任取一个 a，假设它是婴儿；要证「\(\lnot \text{a驯得了鳄鱼}\)」，就再假设它驯得了，推出矛盾。

value.en: Take any a, assume it is a cat, and apply all the way.
value.zh: 任取一个 a，假设它是猫，一路套用下去。

value.en: What do the two sides of a reflexive equality have in common?
value.zh: 自反等式两边有什么相同之处？

value.en: Compare the goal with the given equality: how have the two names changed places?
value.zh: 比较目标和已知等式：两个名字的位置有什么变化？

value.en: Under “Derivable from,” turn on “for any x” and add P(x) as a premise.
value.zh: 打开「可推导情形」中的「任取 x」，再添加前提 P(x)。

value.en: Inside the box, name the thing a, split, and use it as the example.
value.zh: 框里给那一样东西起名 a，拆开，再拿它举例。

value.en: Split out “Ann is mortal” and wire it into <part-ref to="part:exI"></part-ref>.
Inside the box take any thing, call it a, and prove “\(a\; \text{is human}\to a\; \text{is human}\)”; holding for any one at all, outside it is “for all x”.
value.zh: 框里随便取一样东西，叫它 a，证出「\(\text{a是人}\to \text{a是人}\)」；它对随便哪一样都成立，框外就是「对所有 x」。

value.en: Join two things with \mark{and}: “has children” with \mark{exists}, “all children at school” with \mark{forall}.
value.zh: 两件事用 \mark{and} 连起来：「有孩子」用 \mark{exists}，「孩子都在上学」用 \mark{forall}。

value.en: x is a parent of y, and y of z. Who are y and z? Some, that is all.
value.zh: x 是 y 的父母，y 又是 z 的父母。y 和 z 是谁？存在就行。

value.en: The two \(\exists s\) may point at two different things.
value.zh: 两个 \mark{exists} 可以指两样不同的东西。

value.en: The premise’s condition, “everything is a bird”, fails as soon as one thing is not a bird.
value.zh: 前提的条件「什么都是鸟」，只要有一样东西不是鸟，就不成立。

value.en: “Only birds fly”: whatever flies is a bird. Which side is the condition?
value.zh: 「只有鸟会飞」：会飞的，一定是鸟。哪边是条件？
每样东西各喜欢自己就行。

value.en: For every x, if x is human, then some y is a parent of x.
value.zh: 对所有 x，若 x 是人，则有一个 y 是 x 的父母。

value.en: Socrates could be a mortal dog.
value.zh: 苏格拉底也可以是一条会死的狗。

value.en: “Some bird flies”: there is a thing x that is a bird and flies.
value.zh: 「有会飞的鸟」：有一样东西 x，x 是鸟，并且 x 会飞。

value.en: A human who is not mortal.
“Every human is mortal”: for every thing x, if x is human then x is mortal.
value.zh: 「人都会死」：对每一样东西 x，如果 x 是人，那么 x 会死。

value.en: “Only if A, B” says: if B holds, A must hold. The condition is the second half.
value.zh: 「只有 A，才 B」说的是：B 成立，A 就一定成立。条件是后半句。

value.en: When a proof will not come, trying for a countermodel is often faster than pushing on.
value.zh: 证不出来时，先试着造一个反模型，往往比硬证更快。

value.en: With equality declared, symmetry is proved from reflexivity and substitution; with it defined, reflexivity and substitution come from the definition, and symmetry with them. Both ways give the same rules.
value.zh: 声明相等时，对称要用自反律和等量代换证出来；定义相等时，自反和代换由定义得来，对称也就跟着有了。两种做法给出同样的规则。

value.en: Watch the result when the search reaches its depth limit.
value.zh: 观察搜索深度达到设定上限时的结果。

value.en: The search in <level-ref to="s-explore"></level-ref> looked for proofs. Here some conclusions follow from the age relations and others do not; the prover must return a result in both cases.
value.zh: <level-ref to="s-explore"></level-ref>中的搜索寻找证明。这次给出的年长关系可以推出一些结论，也有不能推出的结论；证明器需要对两种情况都给出结果。

value.en: Compare the givens in the two sets: what sentence forms appear in the second set?
value.zh: 比较两组案例的已知：第二组多了哪些句子形式？

value.en: In <level-ref to="s-explore"></level-ref>, the prover explored several routes. Now the cases have goals and givens of different shapes. The resulting prover will become <part-ref to="lemma:auto"></part-ref>.
value.zh: <level-ref to="s-explore"></level-ref>让证明器探索多条路线。现在案例里有不同形状的目标和已知；搭建的证明器将成为<part-ref to="lemma:auto"></part-ref>。

value.en: In <level-ref to="s-append"></level-ref>, the prover faced two alternatives. Here an “or” contains another “or”. <part-ref to="part:search"></part-ref> can explore several routes.
value.zh: <level-ref to="s-append"></level-ref>中，证明器面对两种可能。这次「或者」里面还有「或者」。<part-ref to="part:search"></part-ref>可以探索多条路线。

value.en: <part-ref to="part:repeat"></part-ref> runs its contents repeatedly until they can make no further progress or reach the limit.
value.zh: <part-ref to="part:repeat"></part-ref>让框内的元件反复运行，直到不能再推进或达到上限。

value.en: Across the cases, which alternative in the goal matches a given?
value.zh: 对照各案例，已知对应目标中的哪一项？

value.en: <part-ref to="part:append"></part-ref> joins routes. In backtracking tasks it retains candidates from each route for further work; otherwise it outputs the first result that qualifies.
value.zh: <part-ref to="part:append"></part-ref>汇合路线。在回溯任务中，各路可继续的候选都会留下；普通任务只输出第一个符合条件的结果。

value.en: Equality rewriting can replace equal objects in a goal or a given.
value.zh: 等式改写可以在目标或已知中替换相等的对象。

value.en: Look at the givens in the result: which contain an undetermined thing?
value.zh: 观察运行结果中已知的句子：哪些含有未定的东西？

value.en: In <level-ref to="r-exE"></level-ref>, the prover dealt with an existence given. Here a given concerns everyone, while the goal concerns a particular person.
value.zh: 在<level-ref to="r-exE"></level-ref>，证明器处理了存在的已知。这次已知说的是所有人，目标说的是某个具体的人。

value.en: In <level-ref to="q-exE"></level-ref>, you dealt with an existence given. Here both the prover’s given and its goal contain “exists”.
value.zh: <level-ref to="q-exE"></level-ref>处理过存在的已知。这次证明器的已知和目标都含「存在」。

value.en: Watch when an undetermined thing becomes a name in the result, and what changes in the other goals.
value.zh: 观察运行结果里未定的东西何时变成具体名字，以及其他目标的变化。

value.en: Working backwards with <part-ref to="part:exI"></part-ref> leaves an object undetermined until later in the proof.
value.zh: 逆用<part-ref to="part:exI"></part-ref>时，尚未确定的对象可以在后续证明中确定。

value.zh: 观察前提和目标里的量词各管哪一部分。
value.en: Which parts of the premise and goal are governed by their quantifiers?

value.zh: 这个方向的目标与前提分别说了什么？
value.en: What do the goal and premise say in this direction?

value.zh: 目标中的 R 可以代表什么？
value.en: What can R stand for in the goal?
How many layers of conditions are in the sentence inside the box?

value.zh: 定义中的 R 可以换成什么样的句子？
value.en: What kind of sentence can replace R in the definition?

value.zh: 观察所选句子带来的新目标。
value.en: Look at the new goal produced by the sentence you chose.

value.zh: 选定一例时，定义中的 P 可以填什么？
value.en: What can be put in for P in the definition?

value.zh: 晨星与昏星在目标的性质中分别出现在哪里？
value.en: Where do the morning star and evening star occur in the property in the goal?

value.zh: 定义中的性质从哪个名字传向哪个名字？
value.en: In the definition, which name passes a property to the other?

value.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:allI"></part-ref>在框内取一样任意的东西，并在元件上为它起名，例如 a。框内证出关于 a 的命题，框外便得到对所有东西成立的命题。a 不能出现在未解除的假设中。从这里起，东西用 a、b、c 命名，x、y、z 留给量词使用。
value.en: The new <part-ref to="part:allI"></part-ref> takes an arbitrary thing inside the box and gives it a name such as a. Proving a statement about a inside yields a statement about all things outside. The name a cannot occur in an undischarged assumption. From here, things are named a, b, c; x, y, z are reserved for quantifiers.

value.zh: 在<level-ref to="h-and-make"></level-ref>，量词管的是一句话。<level-ref to="decl-eq"></level-ref>把相等声明进证明核；也可以用量词定义相等：「a = b」就是「a 有的性质，b 都有」，写成 \mark{forall}P. \(P(a)\to P(b)\)。这里量词管的是性质。
value.en: In <level-ref to="h-and-make"></level-ref>, the quantifier ranged over sentences. <level-ref to="decl-eq"></level-ref> declared equality in the kernel; equality can also be defined using a quantifier: “a = b” means “every property of a is also a property of b”, written \mark{forall}P. \(P(a)\to P(b)\). Here the quantifier ranges over properties.

value.zh: 一段推理也能写成一句话：前提用「并且」连起来，作为「如果……那么……」的条件。
value.en: An argument can be written as one sentence too: join its premises with “and” as the condition of an “if … then …”.

value.zh: 前面我们亲手构造过证明。这一次把目标交给证明器。
value.en: Earlier we built proofs by hand. This time the goals go to a proof assistant.

value.zh: 汇合不同路线的结果。按编号收集可继续的路线：需要多个结果时保留各路，否则输出第一条。
value.en: Join results from different routes in numbered order. When multiple results are needed, retain each route that can continue; otherwise output the first.

value.zh: 探索框内元件产生的路线，沿一条路线深入，再回溯探索其他路线；可设置最多搜索多少层。
value.en: Explore routes produced by the parts in the frame, following one route deeply before backtracking to others. The maximum number of layers can be set.

value.zh: 一步有几种走法时，把每一种都留着，走错了就退回最近一个还有别的选择的地方，换下一种：这叫回溯。Isabelle 的策略可以产生多个结果，后续策略逐一尝试；Prolog 的规则次序和子目标次序也会影响搜索能否停下来。
value.en: When a step has several choices, keep them and return to the most recent remaining choice if a route fails: this is backtracking. Isabelle tactics can produce multiple results for later tactics to try; in Prolog, rule and subgoal order can also affect whether a search terminates.

ops.value: 逆用<part-ref to="part:allI"></part-ref>时，任意东西在对应的目标范围内有一个新名字。
留意运行结果中新名字的范围，以及未定的字母能否变成这个名字。
观察运行结果中未定的字母确定之后，目标中两个名字各在哪里出现。
在<level-ref to="q-grand"></level-ref>，你查询过祖父母。这次族谱中的事实是已知，祖父母关系由规则描述；问题中的未定的字母代表要找的人。
观察每个答案中未定的字母变成了谁，并与族谱中的关系对照。
观察运行结果中两个待证关系，以及其中未定的字母的变化。

value.en: Watch the two relations left to prove and how the undetermined names in them change.
value.zh: 观察运行结果中两个待证关系，以及其中未定名字的变化。

value.en: In each answer, see who the undetermined name becomes and compare it with the family facts.
value.zh: 观察每个答案中未定名字变成了谁，并与族谱中的关系对照。

value.en: In <level-ref to="q-grand"></level-ref>, you queried grandparents. Here the family facts are givens, the relationship is described by a rule, and an undetermined name in the question stands for the person sought.
value.zh: 在<level-ref to="q-grand"></level-ref>，你查询过祖父母。这次族谱中的事实是已知，祖父母关系由规则描述；问题中的未定名字代表要找的人。

value.en: Once an undetermined thing is fixed in the result, where do the two names appear in the goals?
value.zh: 观察运行结果中未定的东西确定之后，目标中两个名字各在哪里出现。

value.en: Watch the scope of the new name in the result, and whether an undetermined thing can become that name.
value.zh: 留意运行结果中新名字的范围，以及未定的东西能否变成这个名字。

value.en: Working backwards with <part-ref to="part:allI"></part-ref> gives an arbitrary object a new name within the corresponding goal’s scope.
value.zh: 逆用<part-ref to="part:allI"></part-ref>时，任意对象在对应的目标范围内有一个新名字。

value.en: When a step can go several ways, keep every one, and when stuck go back to the latest place with another choice and take the next: this is backtracking. each tactic in Isabelle gives a run of results that the tactics after it try one by one; Prolog is the same proof assistant, where the order rules are written in and which subgoal is asked first decide whether the search stops.
value.zh: 一步有几种走法时，把每一种都留着，走错了就退回最近一个还有别的选择的地方，换下一种：这叫回溯。Isabelle 的策略给出的是一串结果，后面的策略对每一种都试；Prolog 也是这个证明器：规则写的次序、子目标先问哪个，决定了搜索停不停得下来。

value.en: Explore routes produced by the parts in the frame, following one deeply before backtracking to others. A maximum depth can be set.
value.zh: 探索框内元件产生的路线，沿一条路线深入，再回溯探索其他路线；可设置最大深度。

value.en: Bring results from different routes together. Ordinary tasks take the first viable route in numbered order; backtracking tasks retain all viable routes for further exploration.
value.zh: 汇合不同路线的结果。普通任务按编号取第一条可继续的路线；回溯任务保留各条可继续的路线，供后续探索。

value.en: <level-ref to="s-carroll"></level-ref> was proved by hand; this time, hand it to the proof assistant.
value.zh: <level-ref to="s-carroll"></level-ref>亲手证过，这一次交给证明器。

value.en: A part of reasoning can be written as one sentence too: the premises joined by “and”, as the condition of an “if … then …”.
value.zh: 一段推理也能写成一句话：前提用「并且」连起来，作为「如果……那么……」的条件。

value.en: <level-ref to="decl-eq"></level-ref> declared equality into the kernel. It can also be defined with a quantifier instead: “a = b” is “every property a has, b has”, written \mark{forall}P. \(P(a)\to P(b)\). This \mark{forall} ranges over properties: P(x) is a sentence about x.
value.zh: <level-ref to="decl-eq"></level-ref>把相等声明进了证明核。也可以不声明，用量词定义它：「a = b」就是「a 有的性质，b 都有」，写成 \mark{forall}P. \(P(a)\to P(b)\)。这里的 \mark{forall} 管的是性质：P(x) 是一句说 x 的话。

value.en: The new for-any box takes an arbitrary object inside the box and names it on the part, for example a. A statement proved about a inside becomes a statement about every object outside. a must not appear in any open assumption. From here on, objects are named a, b or c, while x, y and z are reserved for quantifiers.
value.zh: 新元件任取框在框内取一个任意对象，并在元件上为它起名，例如 a。框内证出关于 a 的命题，框外便得到对所有对象成立的命题。a 不能出现在未解除的假设中。从这里起，对象用 a、b、c 命名，x、y、z 留给量词使用。

value.en: Compare the expanded given and goal: in which direction does each transfer properties between the names?
value.zh: 比较定义展开后的已知与目标：性质从哪个名字传向哪个名字？

value.en: In the definition, P can stand for a property of an object.
value.zh: 定义中的 P 可以代表关于对象的一种性质。

value.en: Compare the given and the goal: what property is stated of the Morning Star and the Evening Star?
value.zh: 比较已知和目标：晨星与昏星分别具有什么性质？

value.en: To apply it, “\(A\to (B\to A)\)” is missing: <part-ref to="lemma:axK"></part-ref> gives it.
value.zh: 要套用它，还缺「\(A\to (B\to A)\)」：<part-ref to="lemma:axK"></part-ref>给得出。

value.en: Choose an instance: put “A” in for R, to get “\((A\to (B\to A))\to A\)”.
value.zh: 用选定一例把 R 换成「A」，得到「\((A\to (B\to A))\to A\)」。

value.en: Inside, the goal is an “if … then …”: assume “\(A\to (B\to R)\)” and Apply twice.
value.zh: 框里的目标是一句「若…则…」：假设「\(A\to (B\to R)\)」，套用两次。

value.en: The goal must hold for every sentence R: start with a for-any box, taking the name R.
value.zh: 目标对任何一句话 R 都要成立：先放一个任取框，取的名字选 R。

value.en: Take any a and assume they are late: they are the “someone”.
value.zh: 任取一个 a，假设他迟到了：他就是那个「有人」。

value.en: Assume someone is late, take them out, and take them from the given.
value.zh: 假设有人迟到了，把他拿出来，从已知里取他。

ops.value: <part-ref to="part:exI"></part-ref>使用<level-ref to="decl-ex"></level-ref>写下的引入规则：有东西满足某个条件，就可以说存在满足这个条件的东西。接入关于该东西的命题；若能得出多个存在命题，在元件上选择所需的结论。

<part-ref to="part:exI"></part-ref> uses the introduction rule written in <level-ref to="decl-ex"></level-ref>: an thing satisfying a condition shows that such an thing exists. Connect a statement about the thing; if several existential statements follow, choose the conclusion on the part.
<part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref>用来处理存在命题：接入「\(\exists x\). …」，在元件上为存在的东西取名 a，框内便可使用它满足条件这一假设。a 只是框内的临时名字，框外的结论不能提到它，未解除的其他假设也不能包含它。

<part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref> uses an existential statement: connect “\(\exists x\). …” and name the existing thing a on the part. Inside the box, you may assume that it satisfies the condition. The name a is temporary: it must not appear in the conclusion outside the box or in other open assumptions.
前提提到了鸟，结论提到了苏格拉底：它们一定指同一个东西吗？
The premise mentions a bird; the conclusion mentions Socrates. Must they refer to the same thing?
在<level-ref to="h-eq-subst"></level-ref>，相等的定义让我们比较两个东西的性质。这次已知与目标把晨星和昏星的位置交换了。
In <level-ref to="h-eq-subst"></level-ref>, the definition of equality let us compare properties of two things. Here the given and the goal exchange the Morning Star and the Evening Star.
Working backwards with <part-ref to="part:allI"></part-ref> gives an arbitrary thing a new name within the corresponding goal’s scope.
Watch the scope of the new name in the result, and whether an undetermined letter can become that name.
Once an undetermined letter is fixed in the result, where do the two names appear in the goals?

In <level-ref to="q-grand"></level-ref>, you queried grandparents. Here the family facts are givens, the relationship is described by a rule, and an undetermined letter in the question stands for the person sought.
In each answer, see who the undetermined letter becomes and compare it with the family facts.
Watch the two relations left to prove and how the undetermined letters in them change.

The new part “Into clauses” takes a proof state whose goal is \mark{bottom} apart, one <wiki-ref to="clause"></wiki-ref> for each string of “or”: from here on, the wire carries clauses, no longer proof states.
新元件「重放」把证书交给核：用到的子句要确实由已知拆出，每一步要由 <part-ref to="lemma:auto"></part-ref> 从它的两条来源证出。全部通过，子句所来自的目标就证完了。

The new part “Replay” hands the certificate to the kernel: each clause used must really come out of a hypothesis, and each step must be proved by <part-ref to="lemma:auto"></part-ref> from the two it came from. If all pass, the goal the clauses came from is proved.

In <level-ref to="au-refute"></level-ref> you chose which pair to cancel at each step. A proof assistant does not choose: the new part “Resolution round” cancels every pair that can be cancelled, once, adding each new clause along with the two it came from. When clauses have variables, a pair of literals is unified first, then cancelled: “\(\lnot x\; \text{is human}\lor x\; \text{is mortal}\)” and “Socrates is human”, with x unified to Socrates.

value.en: In <level-ref to="au-refute"></level-ref> you chose which pair to cancel at each step. A proof assistant does not choose: the new card “Resolution round” cancels every pair that can be cancelled, once, adding each new clause along with the two it came from. When clauses have variables, a pair of literals is unified first, then cancelled: “\(\lnot x\; \text{is human}\lor x\; \text{is mortal}\)” and “Socrates is human”, with x unified to Socrates.
value.zh: 在<level-ref to="au-refute"></level-ref>里，每一步消哪一对由你挑。证明器不挑：新元件「一轮归结」把能消的每一对都消一次，新子句加进来，并记下它由哪两条得出。子句里有变量时，一对文字先合一再消：「\(\lnot \text{x是人}\lor \text{x会死}\)」和「苏格拉底是人」，x 合一为苏格拉底。

value.en: The new card “Replay” hands the certificate to the kernel: each clause used must really come out of a hypothesis, and each step must be proved by auto from the two it came from. If all pass, the goal the clauses came from is proved.
value.zh: 新元件「重放」把证书交给核：用到的子句要确实由已知拆出，每一步要由 <part-ref to="lemma:auto"></part-ref> 从它的两条来源证出。全部通过，子句所来自的目标就证完了。

value.en: The new card “Replay” hands the certificate to the kernel: each clause used must really come out of a hypothesis, and each step must be proved by auto from the two it came from. If all pass, the goal the clauses came from is proved.

value.en: The new card “Into clauses” takes a proof state whose goal is \mark{bottom} apart, one <wiki-ref to="clause"></wiki-ref> for each string of “or”: from here on, the wire carries clauses, no longer proof states.

value.en: Find the premises and conclusion of the argument, then count the sentences in the premise.

value.zh: 已知里的量词管什么？目标提到了谁？
value.en: What does the quantifier in the given govern? Who appears in the goal?

value.zh: 观察框内目标和框外目标：名字有什么变化？
value.en: Compare the goals inside and outside the box: how do their names differ?

value.en: How do the outermost quantifiers in the goal and given differ?
From the outside in: the goal is a \mark{forall} outermost.
value.zh: 从外往里：目标最外面是 \mark{forall}。

value.en: Inside the box, prove the sentence with a in place of x.
value.zh: 框里要证的，是把 x 换成 a 的那句话。

value.en: What holds for every x holds for Ann: on the part, put Ann in for x.
value.zh: 「对所有 x」说的话，对安也成立：在元件上把 x 换成安。

value.en: The outermost part is “if … then …”; the condition is two sentences joined by “and”, the first a whole \mark{forall} sentence.
value.zh: 最外面是「如果……那么……」；条件是两句用「并且」连起来，第一句是一整句 \mark{forall}。

value.en: The condition is two sentences, each with its own \mark{exists}, joined by “and”.
value.zh: 条件是两句各带自己的 \mark{exists}，用「并且」连起来。

value.en: Outside, every x; inside, some y: the thing x likes takes another variable.
value.zh: 外面是对所有 x，里面是有一个 y：x 喜欢的那样东西，另用一个变量。

value.en: “Either … or …” has no “not” in it: at least one of the two holds, so it is \mark{or}.
value.zh: 「不是……就是……」里没有「并非」：它说的是两样里至少有一样，用「或者」\mark{or}。

value.en: In “\mark{circle-1} is a parent of \mark{circle-2}”, who is \mark{circle-1}, who is \mark{circle-2}? The \mark{not} covers only the second half.
value.zh: 「\mark{circle-1}是\mark{circle-2}的父母」里，谁是 \mark{circle-1}、谁是 \mark{circle-2}？\mark{not} 只管后半句。

value.en: “Yet”, “but” and “and” are all \mark{and} in logic: both halves hold.
value.zh: 「却」「但是」「而且」在逻辑里都是「并且」\mark{and}：两半句都成立。

ops.value: 证明助手是让人和机器一起写证明、由机器逐步检查的程序。它们都有一个很小的：只有核能认定一条定理成立，其余的自动化无论多聪明，最后都要经过核，所以造不出假定理。
这个游戏的证明器从第一块元件起，就按这个思路搭：核只有几条规则，引理都是用规则证出来的。它只借证明助手搭核、搭元件的思路，自己的元件和写法都按游戏的需要来定。
A new name appeared in <level-ref to="r-allI"></level-ref>, and an undetermined letter in <level-ref to="r-exI"></level-ref>. Both appear as the prover runs here.
In <level-ref to="r-exE"></level-ref>, the prover handled an existential given. Here a given concerns every thing, while the goal concerns one particular thing.

In <level-ref to="s-explore"></level-ref>, the prover explored several routes. These cases have goals and givens of different shapes, and some are expected to fail. The resulting prover becomes <part-ref to="lemma:auto"></part-ref>.
The prover in <level-ref to="s-auto"></level-ref> could report cases it could not prove. Here the Older passes on rule can keep applying to new goals; some follow and others do not.

value.zh: 在元件上为任意东西取名 \(a\)，在框内证明 \(P(a)\) 并接到「结论」，框外得到 \(\forall x.\, P(x)\)。\(a\) 不能出现在未解除的假设中。
value.en: Name an arbitrary thing \(a\) on the part. Prove \(P(a)\) inside the box and connect it to “Conclusion” to obtain \(\forall x.\, P(x)\) outside. \(a\) must not occur in any open assumption.

value.zh: 接入 \(\forall x.\, P(x)\)，选定东西 \(t\)，得到 \(P(t)\)。
value.en: Connect \(\forall x.\, P(x)\) and choose an thing \(t\) to obtain \(P(t)\).

value.zh: 接入 \(\exists x.\, P(x)\)，在元件上为存在的东西取名 \(a\)。框内可以假设 \(P(a)\)；证出 \(C\) 并接到「结论」后，框外得到 \(C\)。\(C\) 中不能出现 \(a\)，\(a\) 也不能出现在未解除的假设中。
value.en: Connect \(\exists x.\, P(x)\) and name the existing thing \(a\) on the part. Inside the box, \(P(a)\) may be assumed. Prove \(C\) and connect it to “Conclusion” to obtain \(C\) outside. \(a\) must not appear in \(C\) or in any open assumption.

value.en: Auto applies rules one at a time and bogs down as goals grow. An <wiki-ref to="automation"></wiki-ref> takes another road: to prove C, assume \(\lnot C\) and look for a contradiction among the hypotheses. Isabelle’s Sledgehammer hands goals to provers of this kind.

value.en: Connect \(\exists x.\, P(x)\) and name the existing object \(a\) on the part. Inside the box, \(P(a)\) may be assumed. Prove \(C\) and connect it to “Conclusion” to obtain \(C\) outside. \(a\) must not appear in \(C\) or in any open assumption.
value.zh: 接入 \(\exists x.\, P(x)\)，在元件上为存在的对象取名 \(a\)。框内可以假设 \(P(a)\)；证出 \(C\) 并接到「结论」后，框外得到 \(C\)。\(C\) 中不能出现 \(a\)，\(a\) 也不能出现在未解除的假设中。

value.en: Connect \(\forall x.\, P(x)\) and choose an object \(t\) to obtain \(P(t)\).

value.en: Name an arbitrary object \(a\) on the part. Prove \(P(a)\) inside the box and connect it to “Conclusion” to obtain \(\forall x.\, P(x)\) outside. \(a\) must not occur in any open assumption.

value.en: In <level-ref to="r-exE"></level-ref>, the proof assistant handled an existential given. Here a given concerns every thing, while the goal concerns one particular thing.

value.en: A new name appeared in <level-ref to="r-allI"></level-ref>, and an undetermined letter in <level-ref to="r-exI"></level-ref>. Both appear as the proof assistant runs here.

value.en: This game’s prover is built that way from its first part: a kernel of a few rules, and lemmas proved with them. It borrows only proof assistants’ way of building a kernel and its parts; its own parts and notation are fitted to the game.
value.zh: 这个游戏的证明器从第一块元件起，就按这个思路搭：核只有几条规则，引理都是用规则证出来的。它只借证明器搭核、搭元件的思路，自己的元件和写法都按游戏的需要来定。

value.en: A proof assistant is a program in which a person and the machine write proofs together, every step checked by the machine. Each has a small : only the kernel can declare a theorem proved, and however clever the automation around it, everything goes through the kernel, so it cannot make a false theorem.
value.zh: 证明器是让人和机器一起写证明、由机器逐步检查的程序。它们都有一个很小的：只有核能认定一条定理成立，其余的自动化无论多聪明，最后都要经过核，所以造不出假定理。

value.en: Wire in rewrite rules and select a spot in the first goal or one of its givens. By default, the card rewrites the first match in the goal, from the outside in and left to right. It tries rules in order. Conditions become new goals.
value.zh: 接入改写规则，在第一个目标或其已知里点选一处替换。未点选时，从外往里、从左往右改目标里的第一处。接入多条规则时，按顺序尝试。规则的条件会成为新目标。

value.en: Wire in rewrite rules and select a spot in the first goal or one of its givens. By default, the card rewrites the first match in the goal, from the outside in and left to right. It tries rules in order. Conditions become new goals.

desc.en: Try direct backward and rewrite cards.

desc.en: Build rules, unify terms, rewrite, and automate reasoning.

ops.value: 翻译一句话，先找出它的骨架：「却」是「并且」，「不是……就是……」是「或者」。「只要……就……」和「只有……才……」都能改说成「若……则……」。想一想，哪半句成立就足以推出另一半？这一章先不证明，只学怎样说一句话，怎样判断它在一个世界里的真假。

To translate a sentence, first find what joins its parts. “Yet” works like “and”, and “either … or …” works like “or”. You can restate both “as long as” and “only if” as “if … then …”. Which part is enough to conclude the other? No proofs in this chapter yet: first learn how to write a sentence and tell whether it is true in a world.

value.en: To translate a sentence, find its frame first: the connectives often hide in the wording, “yet” is “and”, “either … or …” is “or”, “only if” is “if … then …” with the condition at the end. why: Use scenario terminology throughout QED

ops.value: 要说明结论推不出，只需找到一种，其中前提都为真、结论为假。这叫反模型，是一阶逻辑里的。证明器常带一个在小规模情形中寻找反模型的工具，例如 Isabelle 的 Nitpick。游戏里的反模型检验沿用这个思路。

To show that a conclusion does not follow, find a where the premises are true and the conclusion is false. This is a countermodel, the first-order counterpart of a . Tools such as Isabelle’s Nitpick search small scenarios for countermodels. The game’s countermodel checks use the same idea.
谓词说一样或几样东西的性质或关系：「…是人」Human(x) 管一样，「…是…的父母」Parent(x, y) 管两样。谓词填上东西才成一句话：Human(h) 是真是假，看这种情形中的 h 是不是人。

A predicate says what one or more things are or how they relate: “… is human”, Human(x), takes one; “… is a parent of …”, Parent(x, y), takes two. A predicate filled with things makes a sentence: whether Human(h) is true depends on whether h is human in the scenario.
留着一个自由变量的句子是一个查询。在给定情形中，能代入变量并让句子成立的东西就是答案。数据库的 SQL、Datalog 也用到这个思路：表对应谓词，行列出使谓词成立的取值。

A sentence with a free variable is a query. In a given scenario, its answers are the things that make the sentence true when substituted for the variable. SQL and Datalog use the same idea: a table corresponds to a predicate, and its rows list the values that satisfy it.
一句话（或几句话一起）至少在一种情形中为真，就叫可满足。一种都没有，就是，也叫不可满足。命题逻辑里，一种情形对应的一行；一阶逻辑里，还要指定有哪些东西、名字指什么、谓词对什么成立。

A sentence (or several together) is satisfiable when it is true in at least one scenario. If none makes it true, it is a , also called unsatisfiable. In propositional logic, a scenario is a row of the . In first-order logic, it also specifies the things, what names refer to, and when predicates hold.
一阶逻辑中，情形（也叫结构或模型）说明有哪些东西、每个名字指哪一样，以及各个谓词对哪些东西成立。有了这些设定，就能判断句子的真假。

In first-order logic, a scenario (also called a structure or model) specifies what things there are, what each name refers to, and which things satisfy each predicate. These settings determine whether a sentence is true.
一句话在所有情形中都为真，才叫永远成立。情形有无穷多种，挨个检查不完，所以要靠证明。
A sentence that is always true holds in every scenario. There are infinitely many scenarios, so checking them one by one cannot replace a proof.
一句话永远成立，是说它在所有情形中都为真。情形有无穷多种，包含的东西数量也没有上限。
A sentence that always holds is true in every scenario. There are infinitely many scenarios, with no bound on how many things they can contain.
The universal \mark{forall} reads “for all”: \(\forall x.\, P(x)\) says every thing x in the scenario satisfies P.
先把一句话拼成公式。如果检查器找到了两者真假不同的情形，就会把它显示出来。接下来，试着自己构造一种情形，检查别人的译文。

First translate the sentence into a formula. If the checker finds a scenario where one is true and the other is false, it shows that scenario. Then construct a scenario yourself to check someone else’s translation.
假设只有一样东西。如果它是人，这句话要求什么？如果它不是人呢？
Suppose there is just one thing. What does the sentence require if it is human? What if it is not?
Writing “\(x\; \text{is human}\land x\; \text{is mortal}\)” says every thing in the scenario is human.
上一段你把这句话拼成了公式；这是别人拼的。构造一种情形，让两份译文真假不同。
You built this sentence as a formula; this is someone else’s. Construct a scenario where the two differ in truth.
这份译文要求每样东西都有什么性质？如果有一样东西不是人呢？
What does this translation require of every thing? What if one thing is not human?
命题逻辑里，句子的真假取决于真值表的哪一行。一阶逻辑里，真假取决于<wiki-ref to="world"></wiki-ref>：有几样东西，各有什么性质，彼此有什么关系。

In propositional logic, the truth of a sentence depends on the row of the truth table. In first-order logic, it depends on the <wiki-ref to="world"></wiki-ref>: how many things there are, what properties they have, and how they relate.

value.en: To translate a sentence, first find what joins its parts. “Yet” works like “and”, and “either … or …” works like “or”. You can restate both “as long as” and “only if” as “if … then …”. Which part is enough to conclude the other? No proofs in this chapter yet: first learn how to write a sentence and tell whether it is true in a world.
value.zh: 翻译一句话，先找出它的骨架：「却」是「并且」，「不是……就是……」是「或者」。「只要……就……」和「只有……才……」都能改说成「若……则……」。想一想，哪半句成立就足以推出另一半？这一章先不证明，只学怎样说一句话，怎样判断它在一种情形里的真假。

value.en: Whether a first-order sentence is true depends on the world (also called a structure or model): what things there are, which thing each name stands for, which things each predicate holds of. A row of propositional logic becomes a world here.
value.zh: 一阶逻辑中，情形（也叫结构或模型）说明有哪些东西、每个名字指哪一样，以及各个谓词对哪些东西成立。有了这些设定，就能判断句子的真假。

value.en: Whether a first-order sentence is true depends on the world (also called a structure or model): what things there are, which thing each name stands for, which things each predicate holds of. A row of propositional logic becomes a world here.
value.zh: 一阶逻辑的一句话是真是假，要看世界（也叫结构或模型）：有哪些东西，名字指哪一样，每个谓词对哪些东西成立。命题逻辑里的一行，到这里成了一个世界。

value.en: A sentence (or several together) is satisfiable when it is true in at least one case; when it is true in none it is a , also called unsatisfiable. In propositional logic a case is a row of the ; in first-order logic it is a world.
value.zh: 一句话（或几句话一起）至少在一种情形中为真，就叫可满足。一种都没有，就是，也叫不可满足。命题逻辑里，一种情形对应的一行；一阶逻辑里，还要指定有哪些东西、名字指什么、谓词对什么成立。

value.en: A sentence (or several together) is satisfiable when it is true in at least one case; when it is true in none it is a , also called unsatisfiable. In propositional logic a case is a row of the ; in first-order logic it is a world.
value.zh: 一句话（或几句话一起）至少在一种情况下为真，叫可满足；一种都没有，就是，也叫不可满足。命题逻辑里，情况是的一行；一阶逻辑里，情况是一个世界。

value.en: A sentence with a free variable left in is a query: the things of the world that make it true when put in are the answer. The core of SQL and Datalog is first-order logic like this: a table is a predicate, its rows the things it holds of.
value.zh: 留着一个自由变量的句子是一个查询。在给定情形中，能代入变量并让句子成立的东西就是答案。数据库的 SQL、Datalog 也用到这个思路：表对应谓词，行列出使谓词成立的取值。

value.en: A sentence with a free variable left in is a query: the things of the world that make it true when put in are the answer. The core of SQL and Datalog is first-order logic like this: a table is a predicate, its rows the things it holds of.
value.zh: 留着一个自由变量的句子是一个查询：世界里哪些东西放进去能让它成立，就是答案。数据库的 SQL、Datalog 的核心就是这样的一阶逻辑：表是谓词，行是让它成立的东西。

value.en: A predicate says what one or more things are or how they relate: “… is human”, Human(x), takes one; “… is a parent of …”, Parent(x, y), takes two. A predicate filled with things makes a sentence: whether Human(h) is true depends on whether h is human in the world.
value.zh: 谓词说一样或几样东西的性质或关系：「…是人」Human(x) 管一样，「…是…的父母」Parent(x, y) 管两样。谓词填上东西才成一句话：Human(h) 是真是假，看这种情形中的 h 是不是人。

value.en: A predicate says what one or more things are or how they relate: “… is human”, Human(x), takes one; “… is a parent of …”, Parent(x, y), takes two. A predicate filled with things makes a sentence: whether Human(h) is true depends on whether h is human in the world.
value.zh: 谓词说一样或几样东西的性质或关系：「…是人」Human(x) 管一样，「…是…的父母」Parent(x, y) 管两样。谓词填上东西才成一句话：Human(h) 是真是假，看世界里的 h 是不是人。

value.en: To show a conclusion does not follow, one is enough: the premises true and the conclusion false, a countermodel, the of first-order logic. Provers often come with a tool that searches small worlds for one, to check first whether the claim fails outright; Isabelle’s Nitpick is such a tool, and this game’s countermodel panel carries over its idea.
value.zh: 要说明结论推不出，只需找到一种，其中前提都为真、结论为假。这叫反模型，是一阶逻辑里的。证明器常带一个在小规模情形中寻找反模型的工具，例如 Isabelle 的 Nitpick。游戏里的反模型检验沿用这个思路。

value.en: To show a conclusion does not follow, one is enough: the premises true and the conclusion false, a countermodel, the of first-order logic. Provers often come with a tool that searches small worlds for one, to check first whether the claim fails outright; Isabelle’s Nitpick is such a tool, and this game’s countermodel panel carries over its idea.
value.zh: 要说明结论推不出，一个就够：前提都真、结论为假，这叫反模型，是一阶逻辑里的。证明器常带一个在小世界里找反模型的工具，先试试要证的话是不是根本不成立；Isabelle 的 Nitpick 就是这样的工具，这个游戏的反模型面板迁移的是它的思路。

brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

t.en: This time the goals have one, two or three places to replace, or none at all, and this level takes at most three cards.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，证完所有目标。

hint.en: A rewrite card replaces one place.

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that transforms each goal into the required form.

An <wiki-ref to="automation"></wiki-ref> takes another road: to prove C, assume \(\lnot C\) and look for a contradiction among the hypotheses. Isabelle’s Sledgehammer hands goals to provers of this kind.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，每个目标都变成 \mark{bottom}，要证的那句的否定放进已知。

hint.zh: <part-ref to="part:raa"></part-ref>把要证的 C 变成 \(\lnot \lnot C\)，也就是 \(\lnot C\to \bot\)。
hint.en: <part-ref to="part:raa"></part-ref> turns C into \(\lnot \lnot C\), that is, \(\lnot C\to \bot\).

t.zh: 要找矛盾的句子都在已知里。
t.en: The sentences in which to find a contradiction are all among the givens.

t.zh: 子句里只有「对所有」，没有「存在」。已知里的 \mark{exists} 外面没有 \mark{forall} 时，可以像<part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref>那样取出那一样东西；在 \mark{forall} 底下就不行：「每个人都有父母」，父母随人而变。新元件「Skolem 化」把这样的 \mark{exists} 换成一个<wiki-ref to="skolem"></wiki-ref>，比如 sk1(x)：x 的父母。它只认否定范式里的 \mark{exists}。
t.en: Clauses have only “for all”, no “there is”. An \mark{exists} in a hypothesis with no \mark{forall} outside it can be taken out as <part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref> does; one under a \mark{forall} cannot: “everyone has a parent”, and the parent depends on the person. The new card “Skolemise” replaces such an \mark{exists} with a <wiki-ref to="skolem"></wiki-ref>, say sk1(x), the parent of x. It takes only an \mark{exists} in negation normal form.

desc.zh: 把句子化成合取范式：去掉等价和蕴涵，把否定推到最里面，再把「或者」分配进「并且」。「改哪里」选「已知」时，改第一个目标的已知。
desc.en: Brings a sentence to conjunctive normal form: removes equivalences and implications, pushes negations all the way in, then distributes “or” over “and”. With “Where” set to the hypotheses, it rewrites the first goal’s hypotheses.

body.en: First , then distribute “or” over “and” until every “or” is under the “and”s: strings of “or” joined by “and”, the conjunctive normal form. Each string of “or” is a clause. Distributing makes a sentence longer, exponentially at worst; automatic provers often use another conversion (naming parts with new letters) to avoid it.
body.zh: 先化成，再把「或」分配到「与」上，直到所有「或」都在「与」底下：几串「或」用「与」连起来，叫合取范式。每一串「或」是一条子句。分配会让句子变长，最坏时长出指数倍；自动证明器常用另一种化法（给子句起新名字）避开这一点。

body.en: Each string of “or” in the is a clause, and each item in it (a sentence or its negation) a literal. For a set of clauses to hold together, each clause needs at least one true literal. The empty clause has none and can never be true: it is \mark{bottom}.
body.zh: 里的每一串「或」叫一条子句，里面的每一项（一句话或它的否定）叫一个文字。一组子句要同时成立，每条子句里至少有一个文字为真。空子句一个文字都没有，不可能为真，它就是 \mark{bottom}。

body.en: A simplifier takes a set of rules, each a , and replaces wherever one fits in a sentence, until none fits. Each rule is a proved equivalence or equation, so every step is accepted by the kernel. Isabelle’s and Lean’s simp are such programs, the automation used most every day.
body.zh: 化简器拿一组，在句子里哪一处对得上就换哪一处，一直换到哪一条都对不上。每条规则都是证过的等价或等式，所以每一步都由核认可。Isabelle 和 Lean 的 simp 都是这样的程序，是日常用得最多的自动化。

body.en: \(l\longmapsto r\) is a rewrite rule: a place in a sentence that fits the left side l is replaced by the right side r. It rests on l and r giving each other (equivalence), or on l = r. A rule may carry a condition, and the rewrite is right only once the condition is proved. A set of rules used to the end must make the sentence “simpler” each time, or it goes round in circles.
body.zh: \(l\longmapsto r\) 是一条改写规则：句子里对得上左边 l 的地方，换成右边 r。它靠的是 l 和 r 互相推得出（等价），或者 l = r。规则可以带条件：条件证出来了，这一处才算改对了。一组规则改到底，要靠每次都让句子变得「更简单」，否则会绕圈。

desc.en: Use rule parts to work on proof goals.
desc.zh: 用规则元件处理待证目标。
