after.zh: Isabelle 和 Lean 的 simp 做的也是这件事。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that rewrites each goal with the rules from the input Rules until none of them fits.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，用「规则」输入的改写规则把每个目标一直改下去，直到哪一条都对不上。

hint.en: As in <level-ref to="sp-repeat"></level-ref>, the rewriting goes on until nothing fits.
hint.zh: 和<level-ref to="sp-repeat"></level-ref>一样，要改到改不动为止。

value.en: Takes a list of rewrite rules: each round, the first that fits rewrites one place, round after round, until none fits.
value.zh: 接入改写规则列表：每一轮用第一条相合的规则改写一处，逐轮重复，直到没有规则相合。

desc.en: Takes a list of rewrite rules: each round, the first that fits rewrites one place, round after round, until none fits. With “Where” set to the hypotheses, it rewrites the first goal’s hypotheses.
desc.zh: 接入改写规则列表：每一轮用第一条相合的规则改写一处，逐轮重复，直到没有规则相合。「改哪里」选「已知」时，改写第一个目标的已知。

t.en: <wiki-ref to="cnf"></wiki-ref>: negation normal form, with every “or” under the “and”s, a few strings of “or” joined by “and”. Each string of “or” is a <wiki-ref to="clause"></wiki-ref>.
t.zh: <wiki-ref to="cnf"></wiki-ref>：否定范式，并且「或者」都在「并且」底下，几串「或者」用「并且」连起来。每一串「或者」叫一个<wiki-ref to="clause"></wiki-ref>。

after.en: Automatic provers usually bring a sentence to conjunctive normal form before anything else.
after.zh: 自动证明器动手之前，通常先把句子化成合取范式。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that transforms each goal into the required form.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，把每个目标变成要的样子。

hint.en: Start from negation normal form.
hint.zh: 从否定范式出发。

hint.en: What is left is to bring every “or” under the “and”s.
hint.zh: 还差的是让「或者」到「并且」底下去。

t.en: <part-ref to="part:rw"></part-ref> changes one place. Select a boxed subformula in the original sentence to choose where. The default is the first match, from the outside in and left to right.
t.zh: <part-ref to="part:rw"></part-ref>只换一处。可以在原句中点选要替换的子式。未点选时，它从外往里、从左往右找第一处。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that transforms each goal into the required form.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，把每个目标变成要的样子。

hint.en: Each goal has two \(\lnot \lnot s\).
hint.zh: 每个目标里有两处 \mark{not}\mark{not}。

t.en: <part-ref to="lemma:dm"></part-ref> has eight shapes, and each can serve as a rewrite rule.
t.zh: <part-ref to="lemma:dm"></part-ref>有八个形状，每一个都可以当改写规则。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that pushes the negation in each goal inside the brackets.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，把每个目标里的否定推进括号里。

hint.en: One goal holds \mark{not}(… \mark{or} …), the other \mark{not}(… \mark{and} …).
hint.zh: 一个目标里是 \mark{not}(… \mark{or} …)，另一个里是 \mark{not}(… \mark{and} …)。

hint.en: One rewrite rule fits only one shape; to try both, see <part-ref to="part:append"></part-ref>.
hint.zh: 一条改写规则只对得上一种样子；两种都要试，见<part-ref to="part:append"></part-ref>。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that pushes the negation in each goal past the quantifier.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，把每个目标里的否定推过量词。

hint.en: One goal holds \mark{not}\mark{forall}, the other \mark{not}\mark{exists}.
hint.zh: 一个目标里是 \mark{not}\mark{forall}，另一个里是 \mark{not}\mark{exists}。

t.en: <part-ref to="lemma:arrow"></part-ref> and <part-ref to="lemma:dist"></part-ref> are equivalences proved both ways too.
t.zh: <part-ref to="lemma:arrow"></part-ref>和<part-ref to="lemma:dist"></part-ref>也是两个方向都证过的等价式。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that turns the “if … then …” in each goal into an “or”.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，把每个目标里的「若…则…」换成「或者」。

hint.en: Look at the two shapes of <part-ref to="lemma:arrow"></part-ref>.
hint.zh: 看<part-ref to="lemma:arrow"></part-ref>的两个形状。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that distributes the “or” in each goal over the “and”.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，把每个目标里的「或者」分配到「并且」上。

hint.en: In one goal the “and” is on the right, in the other on the left.
hint.zh: 两个目标里，「并且」一个在右边，一个在左边。

hint.en: One rewrite rule fits only one shape; to try both, see <part-ref to="part:append"></part-ref>.
hint.zh: 一条改写规则只对得上一种样子；两种都要试，见<part-ref to="part:append"></part-ref>。

t.en: To turn the \mark{not}\mark{not}it rains in “it’s windy \mark{and} \mark{not}\mark{not}it rains” into it rains, rewriting a proved sentence requires taking the outer “and” apart, replacing the part inside, and putting it back together.
t.zh: 「\(\text{刮风}\land \lnot \lnot \text{下雨}\)」里的 \mark{not}\mark{not}下雨 换成下雨，从已证的句子中替换时，要先拆开外面的「并且」，换掉里面那一句，再拼回去。

t.en: Where two sentences are equivalent, one can be swapped for the other right inside a sentence. An equivalence used this way is a <wiki-ref to="rewrite"></wiki-ref>; the new part <part-ref to="part:rw"></part-ref> uses one to change one place in the goal.
t.zh: 两句话等价，句子里出现一句的地方就能直接换成另一句。这样用的等价式叫<wiki-ref to="rewrite"></wiki-ref>，新元件<part-ref to="part:rw"></part-ref>按一条改写规则在目标里换一处。

after.en: This is the basic move of a <wiki-ref to="simplifier"></wiki-ref>.
after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="simplifier"></wiki-ref>的基本动作。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that takes the \mark{not}\mark{not} out of each goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，去掉每个目标里的 \mark{not}\mark{not}。

hint.en: Both shapes of <part-ref to="lemma:dneg"></part-ref> can serve as rewrite rules.
hint.zh: <part-ref to="lemma:dneg"></part-ref>的两个形状都可以当改写规则。

t.en: The sentences to search now sit among the hypotheses, but the simplifier has only ever rewritten goals. With Where set to Hypotheses, Rewrite and Simp look through the first goal’s hypotheses from the top and change the first place that fits.
t.zh: 要找矛盾的句子都在已知里，化简器却只改过目标。「改哪里」设成「已知」，改写和化简就从上往下查第一个目标的已知，改第一处对得上的。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that brings every hypothesis of each goal to conjunctive normal form.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明器，把每个目标的已知都化成合取范式。

hint.en: The rules of <level-ref to="sp-cnf"></level-ref> cannot deal with \mark{iff}.
hint.zh: <level-ref to="sp-cnf"></level-ref>的那串规则对付不了 \mark{iff}。

hint.en: Put <part-ref to="lemma:iff"></part-ref> at the front of those rules.
hint.zh: 在那串规则最前面加上<part-ref to="lemma:iff"></part-ref>。

why: Q.E.D. reorder stage 1: every machine level uses the prover tray; remove the machine, auto and certificate trays

desc.en: Turn propositions into clauses and replay resolution certificates.
desc.zh: 把命题化为子句，再重放归结证书。

desc.en: Build rules, unify terms, rewrite, and automate reasoning.
desc.zh: 构造规则、合一、改写，并组织自动推理。

why: Remove the retired wired inference and rewrite cards after migrating the machine boards to bound cards

desc.en: Wire in rewrite rules and select a spot in the first goal or one of its givens. By default, the part rewrites the first match in the goal, from the outside in and left to right. It tries rules in order. Conditions become new goals.
desc.zh: 接入改写规则，在第一个目标或其已知里点选一处替换。未点选时，从外往里、从左往右改目标里的第一处。接入多条规则时，按顺序尝试。规则的条件会成为新目标。

desc.en: Wire in rewrite rules and select a spot in the first goal or one of its givens. By default, the part rewrites the first match in the goal, from the outside in and left to right. It tries rules in order. Conditions become new goals.
desc.zh: 接入改写规则，在第一个目标或其已知里点选一处替换。未点选时，从外往里、从左往右改目标里的第一处。接入多条规则时，按顺序尝试。规则的条件会成为新目标。

desc.en: Takes rules at its “R” port and uses the first that applies: the first goal is unified with the rule’s conclusion and replaced by its premises (one goal per premise, each premise’s own assumptions added to the hypotheses). Any ?-letter not yet fixed stays in the goals.
desc.zh: 从「R」口接入规则，用第一条适用的：第一个目标与规则的结论合一，换成规则的前提（每条前提一个目标，前提自带的假设加入已知）。尚未确定的 ?-字母留在目标中。

why: Polish stage one Q.E.D. level and part copy

ops.value: <level-ref to="raa"></level-ref>引入了<part-ref to="part:raa"></part-ref>。它的结论能对上任何目标，因此加入<part-ref to="lemma:auto"></part-ref>的搜索会让目标不断变长。这次的目标需要经典逻辑，现有证明器能处理吗？

<level-ref to="raa"></level-ref> introduced <part-ref to="part:raa"></part-ref>. Its conclusion matches any goal, so adding it to the search in <part-ref to="lemma:auto"></part-ref> would make goals grow without end. Can the existing prover handle these classical goals?
运行<part-ref to="lemma:auto"></part-ref>后，哪些目标还留在结果里？
After running <part-ref to="lemma:auto"></part-ref>, which goals remain in the result?
两道目标的最外层都是什么形式？
What form do both goals have at the outermost level?
你已经用等价关系证明过句子。这里已知给出一个等价式，目标和要求的结果里出现的是它不同的两边。
You have used equivalences in proofs. Here a given states an equivalence, and the goal and required result contain different sides of it.
设计一个证明器，用已知的等价式把每个目标改写成要求的样子。
Design a proof assistant that rewrites each goal into the required form using the given equivalence.
看已知等价式的两边，目标里出现的是哪一边？
Which side of the given equivalence appears in the goal?
在<level-ref to="sp-back"></level-ref>里，目标有一处需要改写。这次各个目标中相同的句子出现次数不同，有的甚至不需要改写。
In <level-ref to="sp-back"></level-ref>, one place in the goal needed rewriting. Here the same sentence appears a different number of times in each goal; one needs no rewriting at all.
对照各个案例，目标里有多少处与已知的等价式有关？
Across the cases, how many places in each goal relate to the given equivalence?
<level-ref to="sp-repeat"></level-ref>处理了重复出现的句子。这次已知里既有等式，也有等价式，目标可能同时涉及两者。本关搭出的证明器会成为元件<part-ref to="lemma:simp"></part-ref>。

<level-ref to="sp-repeat"></level-ref> dealt with repeated occurrences. Here the givens may contain both equations and equivalences, and a goal can involve both. The proof assistant you build will become the part <part-ref to="lemma:simp"></part-ref>.
设计一个证明器，用已知的等式和等价式把目标改写成要求的样子。
Design a proof assistant that rewrites each goal into the required form using the given equations and equivalences.
看第二个案例：要求的结果中，等价式和等式各影响了什么？
In the second case, what has changed in the required result through the equivalence and the equation?
化简用等式和等价式整理句子，让后续处理更方便。Isabelle 和 Lean 也有叫 simp 的化简工具。
Simplification uses equations and equivalences to put sentences in a form that is easier to work with. Isabelle and Lean also have a simplification tool called simp.
<level-ref to="sp-simp"></level-ref>用已知的等价式改写句子。等价本身也有其他表示方式；这次来证明它们之间的关系。
In <level-ref to="sp-simp"></level-ref>, a given equivalence helped rewrite sentences. Equivalence itself can also be expressed in another form. Here you will prove the relationship between the two.
目标中的两部分分别对应已知等价式的什么关系？
How do the two parts of the goal relate to the given equivalence?
已知的「并且」两边与目标里的两个方向有什么关系？
How do the two sides of the given “and” relate to the two directions in the goal?
在<level-ref to="au-iff"></level-ref>里，你证明了等价的另一种写法。现在要把不同形状的句子整理成统一形式：<wiki-ref to="nnf"></wiki-ref>里没有 \mark{iff} 和 \mark{implies}，\mark{not} 只贴在最小的句子上。

In <level-ref to="au-iff"></level-ref>, you proved another way to express equivalence. Now give sentences of different shapes a common form: in <wiki-ref to="nnf"></wiki-ref>, there is no \mark{iff} or \mark{implies}, and each \mark{not} applies to a smallest sentence.
还有一种形式叫<wiki-ref to="cnf"></wiki-ref>：它也是否定范式，由「并且」连接几串「或者」。每一串叫一个<wiki-ref to="clause"></wiki-ref>。这次的案例中，句子里的连接词位置各不相同。

Another form is <wiki-ref to="cnf"></wiki-ref>: it is also in negation normal form, with strings of “or” joined by “and”. Each string is a <wiki-ref to="clause"></wiki-ref>. In these cases, the connectives appear in different positions.
比较各案例要求的结果：哪些符号消失了，否定又在哪里？
Compare the required results: which symbols have disappeared, and where are the negations?
带量词的两个案例中，结果里的量词与原句有什么不同？
In the two quantified cases, how do the quantifiers in the results differ from those in the original sentences?
第二个案例的结果有几串「或者」？它们共有哪部分？
How many strings of “or” are in the second required result? What do they share?
比较后两个案例的运行结果与要求的结果：句子的形状有什么不同？
Compare the run results for the last two cases with the required results. How do their shapes differ?
合取范式把句子整理成子句的组合，便于自动证明器进一步处理。
Conjunctive normal form organises a sentence into clauses that an automated prover can process further.
<part-ref to="lemma:auto"></part-ref>逐条套用规则，目标变大时搜索可能很慢。<wiki-ref to="automation"></wiki-ref>还可以通过寻找矛盾来证明目标；Isabelle 的 Sledgehammer 就会把目标交给这样的证明器。

<part-ref to="lemma:auto"></part-ref> applies rules one at a time, and its search can slow down on larger goals. Another kind of <wiki-ref to="automation"></wiki-ref> proves goals by looking for contradictions. Isabelle’s Sledgehammer sends goals to provers of this kind.
比较每个案例的原目标和要求的已知：多出的句子与原目标有什么关系？
Compare the original goal with the extra given in each required result. How are they related?
在<level-ref to="au-negate"></level-ref>里，寻找矛盾所需的句子进入了已知。这里的已知有不同的形式，有些还包含量词；接下来要把它们整理成适合处理子句的形式。

In <level-ref to="au-negate"></level-ref>, the sentences needed to look for a contradiction became givens. These givens have different forms, and some contain quantifiers. They now need a form suitable for working with clauses.
子句里没有「存在」。例如「每个人都有父母」中，父母随人而变。新元件<part-ref to="part:skolem"></part-ref>可以用<wiki-ref to="skolem"></wiki-ref>表示这样的依赖，例如 sk1(x) 表示 x 的父母；它处理否定范式中的存在量词。

Clauses contain no existential quantifiers. For example, in “everyone has a parent”, the parent depends on the person. The new part <part-ref to="part:skolem"></part-ref> can express this dependence with a <wiki-ref to="skolem"></wiki-ref>, such as sk1(x) for the parent of x. It handles existential quantifiers in negation normal form.
设计一个证明器，把每个案例的已知变成要求的样子。
Design a proof assistant that transforms the givens in each case into the required form.
观察运行结果：目标仍是 \mark{bottom} 时，已知的形式发生了什么变化？
In the run result, how have the givens changed while the goal remains \mark{bottom}?
看「每个人都有父母」的案例：结果中的 sk1(x) 与哪个量词有关？
In the “everyone has a parent” case, which quantifier is associated with sk1(x) in the result?
<level-ref to="au-skolem"></level-ref>整理了已知中的句子。新元件<part-ref to="part:toClauses"></part-ref>能从目标为 \mark{bottom} 的证明状态中析出<wiki-ref to="clause"></wiki-ref>；之后线上传递的是子句。

<level-ref to="au-skolem"></level-ref> prepared the sentences among the givens. The new part <part-ref to="part:toClauses"></part-ref> extracts <wiki-ref to="clause"></wiki-ref> from a proof state whose goal is \mark{bottom}; the wire then carries clauses.
设计一个证明器，把每个案例变成要求的子句。
Design a proof assistant that produces the required clauses for each case.
查看要求的子句：原目标在其中以什么形式出现？
Look at the required clauses. In what form does the original goal appear?
带量词的案例中，要求的子句里出现了哪些名字？
In the quantified cases, which names appear in the required clauses?

ops.value: 用已知中的等式和等价式反复改写，直到用不上为止。

ops.name: simp
ops.value: Repeatedly rewrites using equations and equivalences among the givens until none applies.

ops.name: cnf
ops.value: Brings sentences into conjunctive normal form.

value.en: Brings a sentence to conjunctive normal form: removes equivalences and implications, pushes negations all the way in, then distributes “or” over “and”. With “Where” set to the hypotheses, it rewrites the first goal’s hypotheses.

Brings a sentence to conjunctive normal form: removes equivalences and implications, pushes negations all the way in, then distributes “or” over “and”. With “Where” set to the hypotheses, it rewrites the first goal’s hypotheses.
value.zh: 把句子化成合取范式：去掉等价和蕴涵，把否定推到最里面，再把「或者」分配进「并且」。「改哪里」选「已知」时，改第一个目标的已知。

value.en: Rewrites again and again with the equations and equivalences among the givens until none of them fits. With “Where” set to the hypotheses, it rewrites the first goal’s hypotheses.
value.zh: 用已知中的等式和等价式反复改写，直到用不上为止。

value.en: Rewrites again and again with the equations and equivalences among the givens until none of them fits. With “Where” set to the hypotheses, it rewrites the first goal’s hypotheses.
value.zh: 用已知里的等式和等价式反复改写，直到哪一条都对不上。「改哪里」选「已知」时，改第一个目标的已知。
带量词的案例中，要求的子句里出现了哪些名字？

value.en: The steps of this chapter so far, one after another.
value.zh: 查看要求的子句：原目标在其中以什么形式出现？

value.en: The steps of this chapter so far, one after another.
value.zh: 本章前面几关的步骤，依次接上。

value.en: Design a proof assistant that splits the givens and the negated goal into clauses.
value.zh: 设计一个证明器，把每个案例变成要求的子句。

value.en: Design a proof assistant that splits the givens and the negated goal into clauses.
value.zh: 设计一个证明器，把已知和目标的否定拆成子句。

value.en: The new part “Into clauses” takes a proof state whose goal is \mark{bottom} apart, one <wiki-ref to="clause"></wiki-ref> for each string of “or”: from here on, the wire carries clauses, no longer proof states.
value.zh: <level-ref to="au-skolem"></level-ref>整理了已知中的句子。新元件<part-ref to="part:toClauses"></part-ref>能从目标为 \mark{bottom} 的证明状态中析出<wiki-ref to="clause"></wiki-ref>；之后线上传递的是子句。

value.en: The new part “Into clauses” takes a proof state whose goal is \mark{bottom} apart, one <wiki-ref to="clause"></wiki-ref> for each string of “or”: from here on, the wire carries clauses, no longer proof states.
value.zh: 新元件「析出子句」把目标是 \mark{bottom} 的证明状态拆开，每一串「或者」一条<wiki-ref to="clause"></wiki-ref>：从这里起，线上传的是子句，不再是证明状态。

value.en: In one goal \(\exists y\) is under \(\forall x\): y depends on x.
value.zh: 看「每个人都有父母」的案例：结果中的 sk1(x) 与哪个量词有关？

value.en: In one goal \(\exists y\) is under \(\forall x\): y depends on x.
value.zh: 有一个目标里，\(\exists y\) 在 \(\forall x\) 底下：y 跟着 x 变。

value.en: \mark{not}\mark{forall} must become \mark{exists}\mark{not} first, before the \mark{exists} shows.
value.zh: 观察运行结果：目标仍是 \mark{bottom} 时，已知的形式发生了什么变化？

value.en: \mark{not}\mark{forall} must become \mark{exists}\mark{not} first, before the \mark{exists} shows.
value.zh: \mark{not}\mark{forall} 先要化成 \mark{exists}\mark{not}，\mark{exists} 才露出来。

value.en: Design a proof assistant that brings each goal’s hypotheses to conjunctive normal form, then takes the \(\exists s\) out.
value.zh: 设计一个证明器，把每个案例的已知变成要求的样子。

value.en: Design a proof assistant that brings each goal’s hypotheses to conjunctive normal form, then takes the \(\exists s\) out.
value.zh: 设计一个证明器，把每个目标的已知化成合取范式，再去掉 \mark{exists}。

value.en: Clauses have only “for all”, no “there is”. An \mark{exists} in a hypothesis with no \mark{forall} outside it can be taken out as <part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref> does; one under a \mark{forall} cannot: “everyone has a parent”, and the parent depends on the person. The new card “Skolemise” replaces such an \mark{exists} with a <wiki-ref to="skolem"></wiki-ref>, say sk1(x), the parent of x. It takes only an \mark{exists} in negation normal form.
value.zh: 子句里没有「存在」。例如「每个人都有父母」中，父母随人而变。新元件<part-ref to="part:skolem"></part-ref>可以用<wiki-ref to="skolem"></wiki-ref>表示这样的依赖，例如 sk1(x) 表示 x 的父母；它处理否定范式中的存在量词。

value.en: Clauses have only “for all”, no “there is”. An \mark{exists} in a hypothesis with no \mark{forall} outside it can be taken out as <part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref> does; one under a \mark{forall} cannot: “everyone has a parent”, and the parent depends on the person. The new card “Skolemise” replaces such an \mark{exists} with a <wiki-ref to="skolem"></wiki-ref>, say sk1(x), the parent of x. It takes only an \mark{exists} in negation normal form.
value.zh: 子句里只有「对所有」，没有「存在」。已知里的 \mark{exists} 外面没有 \mark{forall} 时，可以像<part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref>那样取出那一样东西；在 \mark{forall} 底下就不行：「每个人都有父母」，父母随人而变。新元件「Skolem 化」把这样的 \mark{exists} 换成一个<wiki-ref to="skolem"></wiki-ref>，比如 sk1(x)：x 的父母。它只认否定范式里的 \mark{exists}。

value.en: The sentences in which to find a contradiction are all among the givens.
value.zh: 在<level-ref to="au-negate"></level-ref>里，寻找矛盾所需的句子进入了已知。这里的已知有不同的形式，有些还包含量词；接下来要把它们整理成适合处理子句的形式。

value.en: The sentences in which to find a contradiction are all among the givens.
value.zh: 要找矛盾的句子都在已知里。

value.zh: 比较每个案例的原目标和要求的已知：多出的句子与原目标有什么关系？

value.en: <part-ref to="part:raa"></part-ref> turns C into \(\lnot \lnot C\), that is, \(\lnot C\to \bot\).
value.zh: <part-ref to="part:raa"></part-ref>把要证的 C 变成 \(\lnot \lnot C\)，也就是 \(\lnot C\to \bot\)。

value.en: <part-ref to="lemma:auto"></part-ref> applies rules one at a time and bogs down as goals grow. An <wiki-ref to="automation"></wiki-ref> takes another road: to prove C, assume \(\lnot C\) and look for a contradiction among the hypotheses. Isabelle’s Sledgehammer hands goals to provers of this kind.
value.zh: <part-ref to="lemma:auto"></part-ref>逐条套用规则，目标变大时搜索可能很慢。<wiki-ref to="automation"></wiki-ref>还可以通过寻找矛盾来证明目标；Isabelle 的 Sledgehammer 就会把目标交给这样的证明器。

value.en: <part-ref to="lemma:auto"></part-ref> applies rules one at a time and bogs down as goals grow. An <wiki-ref to="automation"></wiki-ref> takes another road: to prove C, assume \(\lnot C\) and look for a contradiction among the hypotheses. Isabelle’s Sledgehammer hands goals to provers of this kind.
value.zh: <part-ref to="lemma:auto"></part-ref>逐条套用规则，目标一大就搜不动了。<wiki-ref to="automation"></wiki-ref>走另一条路：要证 C，先假设 \(\lnot C\)，再在已知里找矛盾。Isabelle 的 Sledgehammer 就把目标交给这样的证明器。

value.en: Automatic provers usually bring a sentence to conjunctive normal form before anything else.
value.zh: 合取范式把句子整理成子句的组合，便于自动证明器进一步处理。

value.en: Automatic provers usually bring a sentence to conjunctive normal form before anything else.

value.en: What is left is to bring every “or” under the “and”s.
value.zh: 还差的是让「或者」到「并且」底下去。

value.en: <wiki-ref to="cnf"></wiki-ref>: negation normal form, with every “or” under the “and”s, a few strings of “or” joined by “and”. Each string of “or” is a <wiki-ref to="clause"></wiki-ref>.

value.en: <wiki-ref to="cnf"></wiki-ref>: negation normal form, with every “or” under the “and”s, a few strings of “or” joined by “and”. Each string of “or” is a <wiki-ref to="clause"></wiki-ref>.

value.en: \mark{iff} is the two directions of \mark{implies} joined by “and”.

value.en: The simplifier has no rewrite rule for \mark{iff} yet, and in the islander puzzles \mark{iff} is just what joins an islander’s kind to his words.

value.en: As in <level-ref to="sp-repeat"></level-ref>, the rewriting goes on until nothing fits.

value.en: Design a proof assistant that rewrites each goal with the equations and equivalences among the givens until none of them fits.
value.zh: 设计一个证明器，用已知的等式和等价式把目标改写成要求的样子。

value.en: Design a proof assistant that rewrites each goal with the equations and equivalences among the givens until none of them fits.
value.zh: 设计一个证明器，用已知里的等式和等价式把每个目标一直改下去，直到哪一条都对不上。

value.en: The givens hold equations and equivalences. Several rewrite rules used together, each time whichever fits, until none fits: this is simplification. The proof assistant you design becomes a new part, .

value.en: The givens hold equations and equivalences. Several rewrite rules used together, each time whichever fits, until none fits: this is simplification. The proof assistant you design becomes a new part, .

value.en: A rewrite card replaces one place.

value.en: This time the goals have one, two or three places to replace, or none at all, and this level takes at most three cards.

value.zh: 设计一个证明器，用已知的等价式改写每个目标，变成要的样子。

value.en: A given is an equivalence: its two sides are equally true. A rewrite replaces a place that matches one side with the other side.
value.zh: 你已经用等价关系证明过句子。这里已知给出一个等价式，目标和要求的结果里出现的是它不同的两边。

value.en: A given is an equivalence: its two sides are equally true. A rewrite replaces a place that matches one side with the other side.

value.zh: 公交和骑车两种情况下，要证的句子有什么共同点？
value.en: What do the bus and bicycle cases have in common in the sentence to be proved?

value.zh: 看分类讨论的两个框：各自的假设与哪条已知条件句有关？
value.en: Look at the two case boxes. Which given conditional relates to each assumption?

value.zh: 比较两个框的结论和目标：它们是否说同一件事？
value.en: Compare the conclusions of the two boxes with the goal. Do they say the same thing?
Once both boxes prove “I arrive on time”, the output at the Case analysis part’s top right gives “I arrive on time”: wire it to the goal.
value.zh: 两个框都证出「我准时到」以后，分类讨论元件右上角的输出就是「我准时到」，接到目标。

value.en: In case one’s box put an Apply: “\(I\; \text{take the bus}\to I\; \text{arrive on time}\)” into its “\(A\to B\)” input, the box’s “Assume” at its top left into its “A” input, and the result into “Conclusion” at the box’s top right. Do the same in case two.
value.zh: 情况一的框里放一块套用：「\(\text{我坐公交}\to \text{我准时到}\)」接「\(A\to B\)」口，框左上角的「假设」接「A」口，结果接到这个框右上角的「结论」。情况二照样做。

value.en: Place a Case analysis and wire the given “\(I\; \text{take the bus}\lor I\; \text{cycle}\)” into the input marked “\(A\lor B\)” on its part. The lower half of the part holds two boxes: case one’s “Assume” is “I take the bus”, case two’s “I cycle”.
value.zh: 放一块分类讨论，把已知「\(\text{我坐公交}\lor \text{我骑车}\)」接进元件上标着「\(A\lor B\)」的输入口。元件下半部分有两个框：情况一的「假设」是「我坐公交」，情况二的是「我骑车」。

value.en: First use “Today is Saturday” to introduce \(\text{Today is Saturday}\lor\text{Today is Sunday}\). Set Added disjunct to “Today is Sunday” and Position to Right. Use the resulting disjunction as the input to the next part and set Position to Left.
value.zh: 先用「今天是周六」引入 \(\text{今天是周六}\lor\text{今天是周日}\)。「补充」选「今天是周日」，「位置」选「右」。再以所得析取式为输入，这次将「位置」选为「左」。

ops.value: 在<level-ref to="mergeUse"></level-ref>里，你把证过的结果接入新的证明。元件的输入口接收前提，输出口给出结论。规则写作「\(\llbracket\text{前提}\rrbracket\Longrightarrow\text{结论}\)」。A、B、C 可以代表任意命题，同一个字母始终代表同一句。

In <level-ref to="mergeUse"></level-ref>, you connected a proved result to another proof. A part receives premises at its inputs and gives a conclusion at its output. A rule is written \(\llbracket\text{premises}\rrbracket\Longrightarrow\text{conclusion}\). A, B, and C can stand for any propositions; each letter keeps the same meaning within a rule.
观察两句条件句：第一句的结果与第二句的条件有什么关系？
Look at the two conditionals. How does the result of the first relate to the condition of the second?
比较规则板上的前提和假设框内的证明：哪一个体现了假设？
Compare the premise on the rule board with the proof inside an assumption box. Which one shows the assumption?
检验条例能暴露规则与预期行为之间的差别。假设框接收的是一段在假设下进行的证明，不能只看它的结论。
A test case can expose a difference between a rule and its intended behavior. An assumption box takes a proof under an assumption, so its conclusion alone does not describe the input.

value.en: The correct rule is \(\llbracket\llbracket A\rrbracket\Longrightarrow B\rrbracket\Longrightarrow A\to B\). Its input is a derivation of B under assumption A, so it also works when B depends on A.
value.zh: 检验条例能暴露规则与预期行为之间的差别。假设框接收的是一段在假设下进行的证明，不能只看它的结论。

value.en: The correct rule is \(\llbracket\llbracket A\rrbracket\Longrightarrow B\rrbracket\Longrightarrow A\to B\). Its input is a derivation of B under assumption A, so it also works when B depends on A.
value.zh: 正确规则是 \(\llbracket\llbracket A\rrbracket\Longrightarrow B\rrbracket\Longrightarrow A\to B\)。它接收一段在假设 A 下证出 B 的推理，因此也适用于 B 依赖 A 的情况。

value.en: Replace B with a derivation of B under A. Use the \(\llbracket\Box\rrbracket\Longrightarrow\Box\) part and fill in A and B.
value.zh: 比较规则板上的前提和假设框内的证明：哪一个体现了假设？

value.en: Replace B with a derivation of B under A. Use the \(\llbracket\Box\rrbracket\Longrightarrow\Box\) part and fill in A and B.
value.zh: 把 B 换成「假设 A 并证出 B」。用 \(\llbracket\Box\rrbracket\Longrightarrow\Box\) 元件填入 A 和 B。

value.en: Start at A and go through B. What do you reach? Write the implication from start to finish.
value.zh: 观察两句条件句：第一句的结果与第二句的条件有什么关系？

value.en: Start at A and go through B. What do you reach? Write the implication from start to finish.
value.zh: 从 A 出发，经过 B，最后得到哪一句？把起点和终点连起来。

value.en: Inputs take premises and the output gives the conclusion. A rule is written \(\llbracket\text{premises}\rrbracket\Longrightarrow\text{conclusion}\). A, B, and C can stand for any propositions. Each letter keeps the same meaning within a rule.
value.zh: 在<level-ref to="mergeUse"></level-ref>里，你把证过的结果接入新的证明。元件的输入口接收前提，输出口给出结论。规则写作「\(\llbracket\text{前提}\rrbracket\Longrightarrow\text{结论}\)」。A、B、C 可以代表任意命题，同一个字母始终代表同一句。

value.en: Inputs take premises and the output gives the conclusion. A rule is written \(\llbracket\text{premises}\rrbracket\Longrightarrow\text{conclusion}\). A, B, and C can stand for any propositions. Each letter keeps the same meaning within a rule.
value.zh: 元件输入口接收前提，输出口给出结论。规则写作「\(\llbracket\text{前提}\rrbracket\Longrightarrow\text{结论}\)」。A、B、C 都可以代表任意命题，同一个字母始终代表同一句。

ops.value: 在<level-ref to="decl-or"></level-ref>里，你声明了「或者」，也看到了它生成的规则。这一关用这些规则证明含「或者」的句子，并从这样的已知出发推理。
In <level-ref to="decl-or"></level-ref>, you declared “or” and saw the rules it generated. Here you will prove sentences containing “or” and reason from such givens.
比较已知和目标：「并且」两边的句子有什么变化？
Compare the given with the goal. What has changed about the two sides of “and”?
这次目标是一句条件句，它的条件和上一题的已知有什么关系？
The goal is a conditional. How does its condition relate to the given in the previous task?
比较两条关于门的已知：如果门锁着，另一条已知会得到什么？
Compare the two givens about the door. What would the other given imply if the door were locked?
目标说的是月亮；哪条已知与门是否锁着相矛盾？
The goal is about the moon. Which given conflicts with the door being locked?
比较目标的条件和已知：它们能同时成立吗？
Compare the condition in the goal with the given. Can both hold?
目标否定了哪句话？两条已知分别说明这句话会带来什么？
Which sentence does the goal negate? What does each given say follows from it?
比较已知和目标中被否定的句子：它们有什么关系？
Compare the given with the sentence negated in the goal. How are they related?
比较已知中等价式的两边和目标：已知的另一句话是哪一边？
Compare the sides of the given equivalence with the goal. Which side is the other given?
比较这次目标和上一题：否定分别落在哪一边？
Compare this goal with the previous one. Which side is negated in each?
观察原句中可选的位置：哪一部分与等价式的一边相同？
Look at the selectable positions in the original sentence. Which part matches one side of the equivalence?
等价代换保留已证句子的其余部分。
Equivalence substitution leaves the rest of the proved sentence in place.
比较已知条件里的「并且」和目标的两层条件：涉及哪些相同的句子？
Compare the “and” in the given condition with the two conditions in the goal. Which sentences do they share?
比较目标的条件和已知的两层条件：周六和下雨分别出现在哪里？
Compare the goal’s condition with the two conditions in the given. Where do Saturday and rain appear?
目标的条件里有「或者」；已知分别对它的两边说了什么？
The goal’s condition contains “or”. What do the givens say about its two sides?
目标里有几层条件句？每层的条件分别是什么？
How many nested conditionals are in the goal? What is the condition in each?
比较「地不湿」和「下雨，地就湿」：下雨会与哪句话冲突？
Compare “it is not wet” with “if it rains, it is wet”. Which sentence would rain conflict with?
比较已知和目标：两边的句子分别移到了哪里？
Compare the given and the goal. Where has each alternative moved?
比较「坐公交」这一情况与另一条已知：它们能同时成立吗？
Compare the bus case with the other given. Can they both hold?
比较两条条件句与「路不滑」：路滑与下雨之间隔着什么？
Compare the two conditionals with “the road is not slippery”. What lies between rain and a slippery road?
观察整句最外层的「若…则…」：哪种真假组合会使它为假？
Look at the outermost “if … then …”. Which truth values would make it false?
在<level-ref to="notI"></level-ref>里，你在证明板上证明过否定。这次目标和一条已知都含否定，另一条已知则是条件句；这样的关系叫<wiki-ref to="contrapositive"></wiki-ref>。

In <level-ref to="notI"></level-ref>, you proved a negation on the proof board. Here both the goal and a given contain negation, while another given is conditional. This relationship is called the <wiki-ref to="contrapositive"></wiki-ref>.

value.en: In <level-ref to="notI"></level-ref>, you proved a negation on the proof board. Here both the goal and a given contain negation, while another given is conditional.
value.zh: 在<level-ref to="notI"></level-ref>里，你在证明板上证明过否定。这次目标和一条已知都含否定，另一条已知则是条件句；这样的关系叫<wiki-ref to="contrapositive"></wiki-ref>。

value.en: In <level-ref to="notI"></level-ref>, you proved a negation on the proof board. Here both the goal and a given contain negation, while another given is conditional.
value.zh: 在<level-ref to="notI"></level-ref>，你在证明板上证明过否定。这次目标和一条已知都含否定，另一条已知则是条件句。

value.en: For the whole to be false, its “if” part must be true and its “then” part false.
value.zh: 观察整句最外层的「若…则…」：哪种真假组合会使它为假？

value.en: For the whole to be false, its “if” part must be true and its “then” part false.
value.zh: 整句为假，前件就得为真、后件为假。

value.en: “\mark{not}it’s slippery” is “slippery \mark{implies} \mark{bottom}”, and “\mark{not}it rains” is “it rains \mark{implies} \mark{bottom}”. Three parts meet end to end.
value.zh: 比较两条条件句与「路不滑」：路滑与下雨之间隔着什么？

value.en: “\mark{not}it’s slippery” is “slippery \mark{implies} \mark{bottom}”, and “\mark{not}it rains” is “it rains \mark{implies} \mark{bottom}”. Three parts meet end to end.
value.zh: 「\(\lnot \text{路滑}\)」就是「\(\text{路滑}\to \bot\)」，「\(\lnot \text{下雨}\)」就是「\(\text{下雨}\to \bot\)」。三段首尾相接。

value.en: Take cases. On the “I take the bus” side it runs into “\(\lnot I\; \text{take the bus}\)” and gives \mark{bottom}; from a contradiction, anything.
value.zh: 比较「坐公交」这一情况与另一条已知：它们能同时成立吗？

value.en: Take cases. On the “I take the bus” side it runs into “\(\lnot I\; \text{take the bus}\)” and gives \mark{bottom}; from a contradiction, anything.
value.zh: 分情况。「我坐公交」那一边撞上「\(\lnot \text{我坐公交}\)」，得到 \mark{bottom}；矛盾推出一切。

value.en: Not knowing which side, split into cases. In each, Add alternative puts it in the right place.
value.zh: 比较已知和目标：两边的句子分别移到了哪里？

value.en: Not knowing which side, split into cases. In each, Add alternative puts it in the right place.
value.zh: 不知道是哪一边，就分情况。每种情况里，用补充换到对的位置。

value.en: The inner box sees “\(\text{it rains}\to \text{it’s wet}\)” and “\mark{not}it’s wet”, that is “wet \mark{implies} \mark{bottom}”.
value.zh: 比较「地不湿」和「下雨，地就湿」：下雨会与哪句话冲突？

value.en: The inner box sees “\(\text{it rains}\to \text{it’s wet}\)” and “\mark{not}it’s wet”, that is “wet \mark{implies} \mark{bottom}”.
value.zh: 里面的框看得见「\(\text{下雨}\to \text{地湿}\)」和「\(\lnot \text{地湿}\)」，也就是「\(\text{地湿}\to \bot\)」。

value.en: Two \mark{implies}s, two boxes, one inside the other.
value.zh: 目标里有几层条件句？每层的条件分别是什么？

value.en: Two \mark{implies}s, two boxes, one inside the other.
value.zh: 两个 \mark{implies}，两个框，一个套一个。

value.en: The goal is an “if … then …”: open an assumption box first; with an \mark{or} inside it, split into cases.
value.zh: 目标的条件里有「或者」；已知分别对它的两边说了什么？

value.en: The goal is an “if … then …”: open an assumption box first; with an \mark{or} inside it, split into cases.
value.zh: 目标是「若…则…」，先开一个假设框；框里有了一句 \mark{or}，再分情况。

value.en: One box will do: assume “\(\text{today is Saturday}\land \text{it rains}\)”, split it, then Apply twice.
value.zh: 比较目标的条件和已知的两层条件：周六和下雨分别出现在哪里？

value.en: One box will do: assume “\(\text{today is Saturday}\land \text{it rains}\)”, split it, then Apply twice.
value.zh: 一个框就够：假设「\(\text{今天是周六}\land \text{下雨}\)」，拆开以后套用两次。

value.en: Two boxes assume “it rains” and “it’s windy” in turn; inside, join the two assumptions into one \mark{and} and hand it to the given.
value.zh: 比较已知条件里的「并且」和目标的两层条件：涉及哪些相同的句子？

value.en: Two boxes assume “it rains” and “it’s windy” in turn; inside, join the two assumptions into one \mark{and} and hand it to the given.
value.zh: 两个框依次假设「下雨」和「刮风」；在里面把两句假设拼成一句 \mark{and}，交给已知。

value.en: Eq. substitution leaves the rest of the proved sentence in place. Next, you will use the same rule to rewrite a goal.
value.zh: 等价代换保留已证句子的其余部分。

value.en: Eq. substitution leaves the rest of the proved sentence in place. Next, you will use the same rule to rewrite a goal.
value.zh: 等价代换保留已证句子的其余部分。接下来，你会用同一条规则直接改写待证目标。

value.en: Connect \(A\leftrightarrow B\) to Equivalence and \(\neg A\) to Original sentence. Then select the boxed \(A\) in the original sentence.
value.zh: 观察原句中可选的位置：哪一部分与等价式的一边相同？

value.en: Connect \(A\leftrightarrow B\) to Equivalence and \(\neg A\) to Original sentence. Then select the boxed \(A\) in the original sentence.
value.zh: 把 \(A\leftrightarrow B\) 接到「等价式」，把 \(\neg A\) 接到「原句」。连好后，点原句里框起来的 \(A\)。

value.en: This time it takes the other direction: assume “I rest” and see whether it runs into a contradiction.
value.zh: 比较这次目标和上一题：否定分别落在哪一边？

value.en: This time it takes the other direction: assume “I rest” and see whether it runs into a contradiction.
value.zh: 这回要用另一个方向：假设「我休息」，看能不能撞出矛盾。

value.en: <part-ref to="part:andE"></part-ref> splits \mark{iff} too: into the two “if … then …”s; use the right one.
value.zh: 比较已知中等价式的两边和目标：已知的另一句话是哪一边？

value.en: <part-ref to="part:andE"></part-ref> splits \mark{iff} too: into the two “if … then …”s; use the right one.
value.zh: <part-ref to="part:andE"></part-ref>也能拆 \mark{iff}：拆出两个方向的「若…则…」，用对的那一个。

value.en: “\mark{not}\mark{not}it rains” is “\mark{not}it rains \mark{implies} \mark{bottom}”. Assume “\mark{not}it rains”; it clashes with the given.
value.zh: 比较已知和目标中被否定的句子：它们有什么关系？

value.en: “\mark{not}\mark{not}it rains” is “\mark{not}it rains \mark{implies} \mark{bottom}”. Assume “\mark{not}it rains”; it clashes with the given.
value.zh: 「\(\lnot \lnot \text{下雨}\)」是「\(\lnot \text{下雨}\to \bot\)」。假设「\(\lnot \text{下雨}\)」，它和已知撞出矛盾。

value.en: “\mark{not}it rains” is “it rains \mark{implies} \mark{bottom}”: assume “it rains” and reach \mark{bottom} inside the box.
value.zh: 目标否定了哪句话？两条已知分别说明这句话会带来什么？

value.en: “\mark{not}it rains” is “it rains \mark{implies} \mark{bottom}”: assume “it rains” and reach \mark{bottom} inside the box.
value.zh: 「\(\lnot \text{下雨}\)」就是「\(\text{下雨}\to \bot\)」：假设「下雨」，在框里推出 \mark{bottom}。

value.en: The goal is an “if … then …”: assume “it rains”. Inside the box it clashes with the given and gives \mark{bottom}.
value.zh: 比较目标的条件和已知：它们能同时成立吗？

value.en: The goal is an “if … then …”: assume “it rains”. Inside the box it clashes with the given and gives \mark{bottom}.
value.zh: 目标是「若…则…」：假设「下雨」。框里它和已知撞出 \mark{bottom}。

value.en: Once you have \mark{bottom}, use <part-ref to="part:botE"></part-ref> and choose “the moon is made of cheese” on its part.
value.zh: 目标说的是月亮；哪条已知与门是否锁着相矛盾？

value.en: Once you have \mark{bottom}, use <part-ref to="part:botE"></part-ref> and choose “the moon is made of cheese” on its part.
value.zh: 得到 \mark{bottom} 以后，用<part-ref to="part:botE"></part-ref>，元件上拼出「月亮是奶酪做的」。

value.en: “\mark{not}the door is locked” is “the door is locked \mark{implies} \mark{bottom}”: wire it into Apply’s “\(A\to B\)” input and “the door is locked” into its “A” input, and you get \mark{bottom}.
value.zh: 比较两条关于门的已知：如果门锁着，另一条已知会得到什么？

value.en: “\mark{not}the door is locked” is “the door is locked \mark{implies} \mark{bottom}”: wire it into Apply’s “\(A\to B\)” input and “the door is locked” into its “A” input, and you get \mark{bottom}.
value.zh: 「\(\lnot \text{门锁着}\)」就是「\(\text{门锁着}\to \bot\)」：把它接进套用的「\(A\to B\)」口，「门锁着」接进「A」口，得到 \mark{bottom}。

value.en: The proof you just made can move into a box whole: assume “\(\text{it rains}\land \text{it’s windy}\)”.
value.zh: 这次目标是一句条件句，它的条件和上一题的已知有什么关系？

value.en: The proof you just made can move into a box whole: assume “\(\text{it rains}\land \text{it’s windy}\)”.
value.zh: 刚才的证明可以整个搬进一个框里：框的假设拼成「\(\text{下雨}\land \text{刮风}\)」。

value.en: Take it apart, then put it back together in the new order.

value.zh: 先拆开，再按新的顺序拼起来。

value.zh: 在<level-ref to="decl-or"></level-ref>里，你声明了「或者」，也看到了它生成的规则。这一关用这些规则证明含「或者」的句子，并从这样的已知出发推理。

On the <part-ref to="part:orI"></part-ref> part, enter the Added disjunct and set its Position to select the corresponding rule.
value.zh: <level-ref to="decl-or"></level-ref>声明了「或者」，并给出了两条析取引入规则。已证得命题 A 时，可以补充任意命题 B，得到 \(A\lor B\) 或 \(B\lor A\)。在<part-ref to="part:orI"></part-ref>元件中，填写「补充」，再设置「位置」，即可选择相应的引入规则。

In truth circuits, an “or” is true when at least one side holds, including when both hold. Does the declaration on the board match that meaning?

You just proved \(\neg B\) from \(\neg A\). Now look at how the equivalence relates to the \(A\) inside the original sentence.

value.zh: 在<level-ref to="machine-cite-first"></level-ref>，两个案例用同一台证明器，一个能直接引用已知，另一个要先拆开条件。这里也要让同一台证明器证完所有案例，只是每个案例需要的改写次数不同，有的连一次都不用。
value.en: In <level-ref to="machine-cite-first"></level-ref>, one prover handled two cases. One could cite a given immediately, while the other had to unpack a conditional first. Here, one prover must again prove every case, but each case needs a different number of rewrites, and one needs none.

t.zh: <part-ref to="part:repeat"></part-ref>会反复运行框内的改写，直到证明状态不再变化。同一台自动证明器就能按每个案例的需要改写，然后引用已知来完成证明。
t.en: <part-ref to="part:repeat"></part-ref> keeps running the rewrite inside it until the proof state stops changing. The same automatic prover can then rewrite each case as many times as it needs and finish by citing a given.

value.en: In <level-ref to="machine-rewrite-twice"></level-ref>, the same sentence appeared twice in a goal. Here it appears a different number of times across cases, and one needs no rewriting. The new <part-ref to="part:repeat"></part-ref> part can run the steps inside it repeatedly.
value.zh: 在<level-ref to="machine-rewrite-twice"></level-ref>里，目标中同一句话出现了两次。这次各案例中它出现的次数不同，有的无需改写。新元件<part-ref to="part:repeat"></part-ref>可以反复运行框内的步骤。
